Searching for answers, Murdock went to Rikers Island to meet with Benjamin Poindexter. When Poindexter began expressing his gratitude for the meeting, Murdock immediately shut him down and demanded to know why Wilson Fisk had arranged his transfer, effectively signing his death sentence. Murdock also pressed him on if Fisk had hired him to kill Foggy Nelson. Poindexter deflected the accusations, stating he would only answer if Murdock helped secure his release, as remaining in the general population would lead to his death, and Murdock would never learn the truth.
Murdock had no issue with Poindexter being killed, and mocked his request for release. Poindexter remarked that Murdock would have defended him in another life, stating that good men defended their worst enemies. Enraged by the request and by Nelson's murder, Murdock slammed Poindexter's head against the table multiple times, injuring him. Murdock called in the guard and claimed that Poindexter's injuries were self-inflicted. As Poindexter was dragged away, he mockingly thanked Murdock.

titulo: Daredevil — Born Again › Black & White Ball
texto:
Later that night, Murdock attended Wilson Fisk 's Black & White Ball, and searched for Wilson, but was stopped by Heather Glenn, who had been trying to reach him. Glenn confronted Murdock about his erratic and distant behavior. During their conversation, Murdock overheard Fisk speaking with Jack Duquesne and learned that Wilson was extorting New York 's elite. Murdock argued with Glenn, insisting that Fisk had involved her to monitor him.
Frustrated by Glenn's refusal to believe him, he brought her along to confront Wilson, but before he could speak to him, the ballroom dance began, and Wilson took to the floor with Vanessa Fisk. Moments later, Murdock joined the dance with Glenn. While dancing, Murdock overheard Wilson taunting him about the consequences of returning to vigilantism. Sensing danger, he quietly instructed Glenn to contact Kirsten McDuffie and Cherry if anything happened.
During the event, Buck Cashman approached Wilson to inform him of Benjamin Poindexter 's escape from prison. When Murdock heard Vanessa begin to confess something to Wilson, he realized she was responsible for hiring Poindexter to assassinate Foggy Nelson. Murdock quickly swapped partners with Wilson and confronted Vanessa. Although he demanded answers, Vanessa deflected his questions and countered by asking if Glenn knew about Murdock's secret identity.
Before their confrontation could escalate any further, Murdock discovered that Poindexter had arrived at the gala and positioned himself on a balcony with a rifle. When Murdock sensed Poindexter taking aim at Wilson, so he quickly moved in front of the shot and was hit in the shoulder, saving Wilson's life. Murdock was dropped to the floor, where Glenn rushed to his side as he bled out, and the Ball descended into chaos.

titulo: Daredevil — Fisk's Anti-Vigilante Campaign › Pursued by Kingpin
texto:
Murdock woke up in a hospital bed in Metro-General Hospital. As he regained consciousness, he called out for Karen Page, much to the dismay of Heather Glenn, who was at his side. He then spoke with Kirsten McDuffie, who was also in the room to visit him, and asked about the case Foggy Nelson had been working on a year earlier. McDuffie informed him that Nelson had been filing a motion to dismiss a case, which led Murdock to believe it was the key to understanding the motive behind Nelson’s murder. Before leaving with McDuffie, Glenn spoke with Murdock once more, during which he insisted that Wilson Fisk was responsible and dangerous, which she did not believe.
While recovering in the hospital, Murdock sensed the arrival of Buck Cashman. Realizing Cashman had been sent to assassinate him on Fisk’s orders, Murdock prepared to escape. As New York plunged into darkness due to a citywide power shutdown orchestrated by Fisk, Murdock evaded Cashman and fled the hospital.

titulo: Daredevil — The Masked Vigilante › Attack on Karen Page
texto:
During the rainy night, Karen Page snuck out of Matt Murdock's Apartment, unaware that he was still awake and had followed her to her home where she was collecting the hard-drive she had taken from Union Allied Construction. Murdock discovered Page moments before she was attacked by Rance, who slammed her head against a wall and prepared to cut her throat. Murdock engaged Rance in a fight, throwing himself and his enemy out the window.
Although Rance proved to be a highly dangerous enemy, using his knife to attempt to cut Murdock's flesh and kill him, Murdock was able to use his heightened senses to predict when the attacks were coming and fight back against Rance. Murdock eventually used his strength and determination to defeat the assassin, wrapping a chain around his neck and knocking him out with a final kick in front of the shocked Page. Murdock first promised to take the hard-drive to the New York City Police Department, but Page warned him that this would not work as the police were clearly far too corrupt.
Believing that Page was correct, Murdock took the assassin to the offices of the New York Bulletin along with the hard-drive in order to expose Union Allied Construction's corruption to all of New York City in one go. This caused Page to be set free and all charges against her to be dropped, for which she thanked Nelson and Murdock by cooking them a meal that was a family secret recipe. Both Foggy Nelson and Murdock then happily agreed to hire Page to work as a secretary for their new law firm as she promised she would work for free to begin with at least, which pleased them all greatly.

titulo: Daredevil — Fisk's Anti-Vigilante Campaign › Battle at Matt Murdock's Apartment
texto:
Returning to his apartment, Murdock found Frank Castle waiting for him, much to his surprise. Castle informed him that he was there to get him to safety, as Kingpin’s Anti-Vigilante Task Force was on its way to kill him, a threat Murdock had already sensed. Castle demanded to know why Murdock had protected Fisk, but Murdock was unable to answer. When Murdock sensed the task force, led by Cole North, approaching, he left to put on his Daredevil's Suit.
As the AVTF officers entered the apartment, Daredevil descended through the rooftop window and ambushed them. During the confrontation, Punisher emerged from hiding to assist, opening fire on the officers with lethal force. Despite Daredevil's pleas for him to stop, Castle continued his assault, and as the intense and violent battle came to an end, both vigilantes emerged victorious.
Punisher found a bullet marked with his signature skull logo and informed Daredevil that they had found Hector Ayala’s killer, North. Enraged, Daredevil confronted North, who expressed no remorse for his actions or fear toward Daredevil. In response, Daredevil knocked him unconscious. When Punisher urged him to kill North, Daredevil refused, stating he was not worth it. Tensions escalated when Punisher shot another defeated officer on the ground, prompting an argument over their conflicting methods. However, Daredevil cut the exchange short after hearing the sound of a grenade.
Both men leaped from the balcony, with Daredevil grabbing onto Punisher and using his billy club to swing them to safety as the apartment exploded behind them. Upon landing on a car, Daredevil and Punisher began their retreat but were soon met by Karen Page, who revealed she had called Castle to help. As they walked toward Page's car, Daredevil insisted on taking the front seat, to Punisher’s annoyance.

titulo: Daredevil — Fisk's Anti-Vigilante Campaign › Reunion with Karen Page
texto:
Murdock and Frank Castle were brought to Knickerbocker Village by Karen Page. At the hideout, Page provided first aid to Murdock. As she tended to his injuries, Murdock spoke with her about her connection to Castle and her hesitation to reach out to him. While listening to their conversation, Murdock noticed the mutual attraction between them by sensing their heartbeats.
Page questioned Murdock about why Kingpin targeted his public persona instead of Daredevil. Murdock revealed that Vanessa Fisk had hired Bullseye to assassinate Foggy Nelson due to his legal case. Knowing that Nelson’s case files were in storage, Murdock asked Page to assist him as his eyes, which she agreed to do. Before leaving the hideout, Murdock warned Castle about possible retaliation from Kingpin.
At the storage facility, Murdock and Page searched for the files. During the search, Murdock asked about her relationship with Castle and the apparent attraction between them, which Page dismissed as adrenaline. When she asked if he had sensed her heartbeat toward him, Murdock responded with a sad smile, suggesting it must have been adrenaline as well.
As they continued searching, they briefly came across a package from Nelson and Murdock before finding Nelson's files regarding Red Hook Port. They discovered that the port was exempt from federal oversight, allowing the Fisks to build a city-state where their criminal operations could be legalized.

titulo: Daredevil — Fisk's Anti-Vigilante Campaign › Building an Army
texto:
Daredevil and Karen Page arrived at Red Hook Port, where they found the area heavily fortified by the Anti-Vigilante Task Force. As Daredevil prepared to infiltrate the pier to confront Kingpin, he instructed Page to stay behind. However, Page persuaded him that the move was reckless, reminding him that he was still recovering from a gunshot wound inflicted by Bullseye and was severely outnumbered. She argued that Kingpin controlled the entire city, and they could not defeat him in Daredevil’s current condition. Acknowledging her concerns, Daredevil stated that they needed an army to stand against Kingpin.
Next morning, Murdock and Page regrouped at Josie's Bar, where they had a private conversation. Murdock admitted that since losing his sight and gaining heightened senses, he believed he had been given a divine purpose, to become a vigilante. He confessed that he never truly needed that purpose and that his mistake was believing he was immune to the violent impulses that led him to nearly kill Benjamin Poindexter. Murdock further admitted that he had lost himself after the death of Foggy Nelson.
Page comforted him, expressing her belief that Nelson had understood and accepted both the light and darkness within him. She also reaffirmed her own belief in Murdock. With renewed resolve, Murdock fully embraced his identity as Daredevil once again. Daredevil joined Page as he addressed their allies, including Angie Kim, Cherry, Josie, and several uncorrupted members of the New York City Police Department. Standing before them, Daredevil vowed to take back New York from Kingpin.

titulo: Daredevil — Fisk's Anti-Vigilante Campaign › Establishing the Resistance
texto: With a hideout established in the upper floors of the building of Josie's Bar, Murdock spent six months working alongside Karen Page to engage in guerrilla tactics against Kingpin and his Anti-Vigilante Campaign, with Fisk having established martial law within New York City. During this time, Murdock had his Daredevil suit, including the cowl and billy club, spray-painted black, with a red "DD" emblem added onto the torso of his suit. Murdock also reconnected with Jessica Jones, who worked with him and Page to investigate targets, while Murdock re-entered into a romantic relationship with Page.

titulo: Daredevil — Fisk's Anti-Vigilante Campaign › Attack on the Northern Star
texto:
Daredevil was notified by Karen Page via her source that there was a cargo ship called the Northern Star that was sailing into Kingpin 's Red Hook Port. Daredevil made his way to the Brooklyn Bridge and waited for the ship to pass beneath the bridge on the East River below. When the ship did so, Daredevil used his billy club to rappel onto the ship and began stealthily taking out any guards he encountered as he made his way below deck.
Below deck, Daredevil quickly dispatched one of the guards, who fired a gunshot that alerted the others. Ambushing the guards, Daredevil brutally defeated them one by one, and managed to break one of the gunmen's arms badly enough for the broken bone to rip through his skin. With the men defeated, Daredevil used his fingers to sense something behind a wooden wall, Daredevil realized punched through and found a room with several crates filled with weapons and ammunition. The ship's captain and first mate noticed Daredevil through a security camera, which Daredevil used to focus on his "DD" chest symbol before he waved to the camera and destroyed it.
The men then began to sink the ship, which Daredevil realized by focusing his senses. He quickly grabbed a ticking wristwatch from one of the defeated guards and planted it in one of the weapon crates in order to locate it later. As the ship took on water and began to sink, Daredevil tried to run out of the ship, although he found his path blocked by the rising water. The Northern Star began to rise vertically, and having no choice, Daredevil plunged into the water and swam his way out of the ship.
Daredevil swam his way through the East River to shore, and as he emerged out of the water, the Northern Star capsized a short distance away, blocking the entrance to Fisk's Freeport. Daredevil then returned to Josie's Bar, and upon entering the abandoned location, took off his helmet. He sensed Page practicing her punches upstairs on a training dummy and made his way toward her. She informed him that news coverage was reporting on the Northern Star, and he in turn notified her of the weapons and ammunition that had been on the ship, and believed that stopping the ship from reaching the port had put a crack in Fisk's operations. He told Page the weapons were military grade and from Europe, and the two discussed Fisk's arms smuggling operations. Murdock stated that they needed to prove Fisk's crimes to the public and asked Page to contact her source to learn about the intentions behind the weapons. The two then spent the night together, celebrating their victory.

titulo: Daredevil — Fisk's Anti-Vigilante Campaign › Searching for Kyriaco and Savva
texto:
The next morning, Murdock learned from Karen Page about Wilson Fisk intensifying the manhunt on them. Murdock listened to Page expressed her frustration that their effort to disrupt Kingpin's dealings did not amount to results. Murdock stated that they had to keep trying in order expose his arms smuggling, as he believed that once the truth was revealed, Fisk be held accountable. Page looked at him with chagrin, to which Murdock iterated that he needed to believe that Fisk could be held accountable for his actions. Page then informed Murdock that Jessica Jones had found the Northern Star manifest which identified Cypriot nationals Achilleo Kyriaco and Christofi Savva as the captain and the first mate, and that they both had families in Astoria. Knowing that they needed to be found to prove Fisk's crimes, Murdock began his search while Page went to meet with her source.
Murdock messaged Cherry to meet their predeterimined location. There, Murdock informed Cherry about the weapons on the ship and that they could be used to link Fisk to arms smuggling. Cherry warned Murdock that Fisk would only act more erratically, a danger which Murdock acknowledged. When their conversation turned to Kirsten McDuffie, Murdock asked Cherry how she was doing. Cherry suggested that Murdock call her, because she had been worried about him since his public disappearance. Murdock affirmed that it was best to stay away to ensure her safety, expressed his trust toward Cherry, who had been keeping his identity as Daredevil a secret ever since the attack on Josie's Bar. Murdock asked Cherry to help him look for Kyriaco and Savva, which he agreed to do, and Murdock departed.
That evening, Murdock went to Queens to visit the Greek Cypriot restaurant Aegean Gardens, which had been forced to close early due to a visit by the AVTF which resulted in property damage. Murdock spoke to the restauranteur, a woman named Ariana Iacovou, whom Murdock knew by reputation to run an operation to smuggle people out of New York. Murdock asked if the AVTF had been responsible and offered to help her, and Ariana realized that he was Murdock, whom she also knew of by reputation. Ariana agreed to speak with him, and the two sat down, where Murdock asked about Kyriaco. Ariana confirmed that Kyriaco had sought her out to be smuggled out of the city, and Ariana informed Murdock that Kyriaco had been captured by the AVTF and that stated that people who were taken by the AVTF did not resurface. Murdock stressed that he would try and find Kyriaco anyway, which Ariana accepted.
The next morning, back at the hideout, Murdock trained while Page watched him. Page remarked that she would never figure out how Murdock had mastered such skills, and Murdock explained that it was due to the brutal training that he endured under his late mentor, Stick. While practicing with Page, Murdock informed her about Ariana was willing to help their resistance. Page noticed his distress during their combat practice and asked if he missed his civilian life and their time working at Nelson, Murdock & Page. Murdock thought about Foggy Nelson and their final moments together before telling Page that he did miss it but that he was focused on moving on.

titulo: Daredevil — Fisk's Anti-Vigilante Campaign › Attack on Cherry
texto:
Daredevil received a text message from Cherry indicating that he could not meet, which signified that Cherry was in danger. Daredevil swiftly made his way to Cherry's Apartment and managed to stop the two AVTF officers from executing Cherry. Daredevil quickly knocked them unconscious and made his way to Cherry and asked him if he was okay when he suddenly heard Cherry's heart beating erratically. Daredevil notified Cherry about his heart, although Cherry merely stated that he could take a punch better when he was younger as he winced in pain. Daredevil suddenly sensed more AVTF officers making their way toward them and moved away from Cherry in order to hide in the adjacent hallway.
As several other AVTF officers entered, Daredevil ambushed them and began to take them down. However, Cherry started to undergo cardiac arrest, which Daredevil noticed, and the sounds of Cherry's heartbeats triggered Daredevil's trauma of hearing Foggy Nelson 's final heartbeats, which caused him to briefly pause, giving the AVTF an opening to strike Daredevil on the side of his face and knock him down. The AVTF officers subdued him and removed his cowl, causing Murdock to be recognized and identified. One of the AVTF agents pulled out his gun and prepared to execute Murdock when he and all other remaining AVTF agents were suddenly shot and killed in quick succession. The unknown assailant then threw a knife which ricocheted and embedded itself in the floor in front of Murdock much to his surprise, with the knife having "You're welcome" along with a bullseye symbol etched onto it.
In the aftermath of the fight, Daredevil observed from the rooftop as Cherry was taken to the hospital by EMS and the bodies of the dead agents were loaded into a van by other AVTF personnel. Daredevil examined the knife with a bullseye symbol etched on it, then returned to the hideout.

titulo: Daredevil — Fisk's Anti-Vigilante Campaign › Surveying Red Hook Port
texto:
Returning to Josie's Bar, Murdock and Karen Page discussed the attack on Cherry and Bullseye having saved him. Murdock was relieved to learn that Cherry was in stable condition at Metro-General Hospital, but was concerned that the AVTF could go after Cherry there. When Page asked about Poindexter's intentions, Murdock stated that he did not know, and that the assassin could have killed him if he wanted. Murdock theorized that Poindexter's actions would only inflame the conflict between him and Wilson Fisk. When Page expressed her wish that the task force would kill Poindexter, Murdock reminded her that this was not the right approach. Returning to the topic of exposing Fisk, Murdock stated that they needed to prove his crimes and remove him from his position as mayor. Murdock suspected that the Christofi Savva was still alive because Cherry had been attacked after the Achilleo Kyriaco had been captured. Murdock stated that they needed to reach Ariana Iacovou, and he and Page decided to go to her together.
While covertly walking through the streets with Page, Murdock learned to his dismay that Fisk had called a search for his public identity as Matt Murdock, ostensibly due to Murdock having taken a bullet for Fisk during the Attack on the Black & White Ball, while in actuality intending to limit Murdock's activities by ensuring he was hunted day and night. Seeing the missing person posters on the streets, Murdock and Page quickly returned to their hideout to avoid being discovered.
Eventually leaving their hideout to resume their tasks, Murdock and Page made their way to Red Hook Port and began observing the compound from a hidden vantage point. They watched as cargo from the ship was loaded into the port. When one of the crates broke and revealed diapers, Murdock mused that it was a setup to fool the public about what the Northern Star had actually carried.
Remaining at their vantage point, Murdock and Page continued to observe Red Hook Port until nightfall, when more AVTF agents arrived to guard the port. They watched as new cargo was loaded in, including caches of weapons that Murdock had discovered onboard the ship. Knowing that the weapons would disappear once they entered the port, Murdock stressed that he had to infiltrate it. Page disagreed, stating that it was reckless due to the heavy fortification. Murdock told Page that this might be their only opportunity to expose Fisk.

titulo: Daredevil — Fisk's Anti-Vigilante Campaign › Battle at Josie's Bar
texto:
Returning to Josie's Bar, Murdock and Karen Page were drinking with Josie, who mused about the good days when Foggy Nelson was still with them. Murdock heard someone approaching the bar and warned Josie. While Murdock and Page hid, Josie went to greet the new arrivals, who turned out to be Angie Kim. Kim had come to check up on Josie and informed them that Cherry was safe, subtly letting Murdock and Page know as well. Before leaving, Kim warned them that Fisk was hunting for those who resisted him.
Retiring to bed, Murdock and Page continued their discussion about Red Hook Port. Page informed Murdock that she had no idea how to get him to the port. Murdock stated that there must be a way, and Page replied that she preferred one where he lived. While cuddling, Page asked Murdock about their past home in Brooklyn. Murdock mused that he missed his records, to which Page surprised him by revealing that she had recovered some and turned on the music for him. While dancing with Page, Murdock heard the Anti-Vigilante Task Force arriving before becoming disoriented by a high-pitched ringing caused by speakers from the AVTF van outside the bar. When Murdock heard that Josie was being arrested, he quickly left to rescue her, telling Page to remain in their room.
Donning his suit, Daredevil swung down from the roof and ambushed the agents who were arresting Josie. Knocking out the two agents before destroying the AVTF speakers, Daredevil told Josie to get to safety. Entering the bar and finding more agents, Daredevil began attacking them. Using his billy club to swing out of the line of fire, Daredevil defeated both agents inside the bar before heading further in to pursue the two remaining agents who had gone toward his hideout. Ambushing them as they entered, Daredevil engaged them in combat. When the agents briefly managed to land punches on him, he grabbed a rifle and held them at gunpoint. When they stopped, Daredevil smirked and furiously resumed his assault, brutally defeating them using the rifle as a makeshift melee weapon combined with his martial arts. When the fight was over, Daredevil discovered to his dismay that Page was missing.

titulo: Daredevil — Fisk's Anti-Vigilante Campaign › Interrogating Alan Saunders
texto:
Daredevil waited for Karen Page at Panna II Garden Indian Restaurant. When she arrived, he he asked where she had been, Page stated that she had something to show him and brought him to Knickerbocker Village. Page led Daredevil to the building complex, where she revealed that she had captured an AVTF officer.
Daredevil rebuked Page for recklessly doing recon and asked what was going on with her. Page stated that she did it to defeat Fisk, but Daredevil disagreed with her method of kidnapping the agent. Page insisted that their captive was different from the rest. Daredevil and Page began interrogating him, and the officer insisted that he had been looking for them. He stated that Powell and the rest of the Task Force were psychos and that he had no choice but to join them. Daredevil tested the captive's sincerity and sensed that he was telling the truth.
When Page inquired about how their captive could assist them, Saunders disclosed that he was part of the security detail at Red Hook Port and possessed a card key that could get them inside. Daredevil tested him further and asked for his name; the agent identified himself as Alan Saunders. Daredevil informed Saunders that they would put the hood back on him and that Daredevil would knock him out to give him a cover story to tell the Task Force, and warned Saunders that he would find him if Saunders had lied to him.

titulo: Daredevil — The Masked Vigilante › Meeting Claire Temple
texto:
Having trained at Fogwell's Gym for a while, Murdock put on his suit and stood on his rooftop, where he heard the cries of a kidnapped boy. However, Murdock was surprised by an ambush arranged by Russian Mafia, who had lured him into a warehouse, where they ambushed him. Despite putting up his best fight while escaping, Murdock still came out with several knife wounds and ended up falling unconscious into a dumpster, unable to move from his injuries sustained in their fight.
Murdock remained hidden inside the dumpster, bleeding out from his wounds, until he was found by Santino, who called Claire Temple for help. Temple took Murdock upstairs into her apartment and tried to help him. Being a nurse at Metro-General Hospital, Temple quickly diagnosed all of Murdock's knife wounds and tended to them while she quickly discovered that he was blind by shining a light in his eye. Murdock woke and tried to leave, claiming the Ranskahovs would kill everyone to get to him, but Temple still insisted that he had to stay as his wounds were too severe.
Before he could leave, however, Murdock collapsed on the floor and lost consciousness, recalling memories of his own father as he slept. Eventually, Murdock awoke on the sofa to find Temple watching over him, who introduced herself as the "lucky" girl who had pulled him out of the garbage. While Murdock was horrified that Temple had seen his face, she questioned how a blind man had now ended up in this condition. Noting that most people would have called the New York City Police Department upon finding him, Murdock questioned why Temple had helped him, which she did not answer.
As Murdock refused to give her his name, Temple called him "Mike" before advising that he got some sleep to try and recover from his wounds. While dreaming of the night he had been blinded, Murdock suddenly awoke to find himself unable to breathe. Desperately calling on Temple for help, she discovered he had air in his chest and managed to expel it, saving Murdock's life. Temple demanded a reason to keep him there, so he explained how Veles Taxi had kidnapped a boy whom he had just failed to save, admitting he had walked into the Ranskahovs' trap, deeming himself stupid.
After a while, Murdock smelled someone wearing strong aftershave and cologne coming up the stairs looking for him. While Murdock got a kitchen knife, Temple told him to not attack the man coming and let her talk to him, as he was not strong enough to stand straight, let alone fight. Temple answered the door while Murdock hid against the wall, and the man claimed to be a police officer looking for the suspect of a robbery, in which a masked man was responsible. Temple, however, told the man that she had not seen anything like that.
The mobster left, but Murdock heard him on the phone and knew that he had not believed her and was currently informing the Ranskahovs of where he believed the Masked Man was hiding. Seeking to stop the mobster as soon as he could to ensure Temple's safety, Murdock chased him down and used his enhanced senses to precisely drop a fire extinguisher down onto the mobster's head, knocking him out without killing him. Murdock noticed that Santino had witnessed the attack and ran away back into his own apartment. Together, both Murdock and Temple dragged the unconscious mobster up to the roof.

titulo: Daredevil — Fisk's Anti-Vigilante Campaign › Preparation and Planning
texto:
Having released Alan Saunders, Murdock and Karen Page began planning in their new hideout. While watching Page work, Murdock remarked that she was turning into Frank Castle. Page replied that they needed to know their enemies. When Page asked if Castle was dead, Murdock believed that he was not, as Fisk would have made it known. Page commented that they could use Castle's aid, finding his methods effective, but Murdock disagreed and reminded her that she was talking about murder. When Page fell silent, Murdock pressed her further. Page clarified that she was not suggesting killing AVTF agents, but rather killing Wilson Fisk, who was the head. Murdock retorted that killing Fisk would not bring Foggy Nelson back, but Page reminded Murdock that the Fisks had committed crimes and no justice had been given, despite all of their efforts. Murdock stated his faith in the justice system and asked again if Page had delivered the Charter of the Port of Red Hook to the governor, to which she confirmed that she had.
Murdock and Page continued planning to get inside Red Hook Port, finding the task difficult due to a lack of construction plans and insider knowledge. Page asked Murdock what he would do when he got inside, to which he answered that he would torch the weapons and expose Fisk's crimes. Page was unsure about the certainty of their plans and wanted Murdock to come back safely. Murdock and Page later watched Kirsten McDuffie defend Jacques Duquesne in his trial, which Murdock remarked was a mockery due to everyone lining up to pronounce Duquesne guilty. As they watched, they heard McDuffie make a remark that indicated she had been inside Red Hook. Realizing that they needed McDuffie's aid and after the trial ended with Duquesne being declared guilty for vigilantism, Murdock and Page made plans to contact her.
In the evening, after Page covertly gave McDuffie a message at Franklin 820, Daredevil met McDuffie at the Murdock & McDuffie Law Office. When McDuffie remarked that she had had a bad day and had no desire to join the resistance, Daredevil stated that her actions had already made her part of it. Daredevil asked McDuffie how she had met Duquesne and what she had seen inside Red Hook. McDuffie replied that they had covered her eyes when she was led inside and that she had seen nothing. Daredevil smiled and assured her that he could work with whatever information she could provide.

titulo: Daredevil — Fisk's Anti-Vigilante Campaign › Liberation of the AVTF Detainees
texto:
Having obtained information from Kirsten McDuffie about the layout of Red Hook Port, Daredevil began his infiltration of the compound. Following the intel given to him by McDuffie, Daredevil entered the building through the rooftop window. Once inside, Daredevil retraced the path through which McDuffie had been taken. Eventually, Daredevil reached a door that required a key card and used the one provided by Alan Saunders. Having sensed two guards on the other side of the door, Daredevil attacked them the moment he entered. Quickly defeating the guards without alerting others, Daredevil continued forward into Fisk Freeport Complex. He heard the wristwatch that he had planted on one of the weapon caches back on the Northern Star, but he also heard the cries of the prisoners in their cages. Ultimately, Daredevil chose to rescue the captives over getting rid of the weapons.
Reaching the prison, Daredevil found the detainees and began freeing them, with Swordsman, Ariana Iacovou, and Soledad Ayala among them. When Daredevil heard more AVTF agents approaching, he ripped off a bar and gave it to Swordsman as a makeshift weapon. The agents arrived and began forcing the freed detainees back to their cells, prompting Daredevil to attack while defending them. Fighting alongside Swordsman, Daredevil battled fiercely against the AVTF agents and protected the detainees.
When Daredevil heard that the agents intended to use lethal force, he ordered everyone to get down and launched his billy club at the smoke pipes, rupturing and pulling them down so the escaping smoke could disorient the agents and prevent them from aiming at the detainees. With the agents distracted by the smoke, Daredevil launched his billy club at one of them, using its cable to drag the agent close and beat him. Daredevil then quickly dealt with the remaining agents, ending the fight within the dungeon. He ordered the detainees to move quickly, and Swordsman began leading the group out.
While leading the escape, Daredevil heard Karen Page 's voice from the radio of a defeated AVTF agent. Daredevil informed Page that he was leading the people out. Outside the building, Daredevil and Swordsman encountered Connor Powell and Cole North leading a group of AVTF agents. Having heard the agents intended to shoot them with lethal force, Daredevil commanded the detainees to take cover. Pinned down by gunfire, the situation changed when an AVTF armored van commandeered by Page and Angela Del Toro arrived. Daredevil ordered the detainees to get into the van, protecting them as they climbed inside.
As Daredevil fought the agents, he noticed Page kill one of them. Once they ensured that Swordsman was able to escape with the van of detainees, Daredevil and Page made their escape from Red Hook Port in their car. As they fled, Daredevil informed Page that he had not fulfilled his mission because he could not leave the detainees behind, but she did not fault him. As they continued their escape, Daredevil and Page heard an explosion coming from the Northern Star. Daredevil was horrified as he realized that Kingpin had ordered the destruction of the ship, killing the workers who had been salvaging it.

titulo: Daredevil — Fisk's Anti-Vigilante Campaign › The Resistance Grows
texto:
Daredevil and Karen Page hid with the rescued detainees. While Page collected testimonies from them, Daredevil was informed by Jacques Duquesne that he was leaving. Daredevil respected Duquesne's decision while expressing that they could use people like him. Duquesne responded that Daredevil had become a symbol for New York City. Once Duquesne left, Daredevil spoke to Angela Del Toro about her readiness to inherit the mantle of White Tiger from her uncle, Hector Ayala. When Daredevil sensed someone approaching their hideout, the person turned out to be Christofi Savva.
Savva told Daredevil and the others about his work on the Northern Star and how he and Achilleo Kyriaco had been working on Kingpin's weapon smuggling operation. Knowing that they needed an attorney to make a statement, Daredevil and Page discussed getting Kirsten McDuffie to help them. Daredevil and Page then talked about the upcoming boxing match that would be taking place at Fogwell's Gym. Knowing that Kingpin intended to lure Bullseye out by arranging the boxing match, Daredevil decided to find him before it happened. Before leaving, Daredevil expressed his love for Page.

titulo: Daredevil — Fisk's Anti-Vigilante Campaign › Return to Clinton Church
texto:
Disguised as an AVTF agent, Murdock's search for Bullseye led him to Bel Aire Diner, where the villain had committed a massacre. Murdock dismissed the New York City Police Department and examined the diner for any clues on Bullseye's whereabouts. Using his enhanced senses, Murdock traced where Bullseye had sat and where he had taken cover from the gunfire. Following his senses, Murdock found and recognized a token from Clinton Church.
Following this new lead, Murdock headed to the church. Having returned to a place that held significant meaning to him since childhood, Murdock took a moment to pray. As he prayed, a Seminarian approached him. Believing Murdock to be an AVTF agent, the Seminarian asked about his presence. Murdock showed him the token he had found in the diner. At first, the Seminarian denied knowing anything about the token, but Murdock sensed the man's tension and knew he was lying. Murdock affirmed that the man who had the token was a killer and needed to be found. When the Seminarian asked if Murdock intended to kill the man, Murdock stated that he would not. The Seminarian reluctantly told Murdock what he knew, giving Murdock a lead on where to find Bullseye. Leaving the church to pursue his adversary, Murdock returned the token to the bowl.

titulo: Daredevil — Fisk's Anti-Vigilante Campaign › Duel with Bullseye
texto:
Having located where his enemy lived, Daredevil waited in ambush in the apartment. The moment Bullseye entered, Daredevil moved to attack him. Having noticed his presence, Bullseye ejected a CD from his device and ricocheted it at Daredevil, who caught it and threw it back. The two adversaries engaged in melee combat, with Daredevil having a clear advantage as he repeatedly beat the man who had killed Foggy Nelson. When Bullseye threw objects at Daredevil, he deflected them with his billy club. Daredevil then threw his weapon at Bullseye, who caught it, but Daredevil used this to his advantage to close the distance and continue beating him.
Ignoring the villain's plea that they were on the same side, Daredevil continuously beat him until Smithers entered and witnessed the horrific scene. Momentarily distracted, Daredevil was struck by an object Bullseye threw, allowing the villain to grab Smithers as a human shield and hold a gun to her head. Bullseye told Daredevil that he wanted to do one good deed to make up for taking the deal from Vanessa Fisk to kill Nelson.
Daredevil angrily told him not to bring up Nelson. Bullseye retorted that he had to accept the deal to get out of the mental institution and get his mind back. Seeking to calm the agitated madman to ensure Smithers' safety, Daredevil placated Bullseye and asked what he meant by one good deed. Daredevil learned to his horror that Bullseye intended to kill Kingpin, a plan that he opposed, not wanting Bullseye to make Fisk a martyr. Undissuaded, Bullseye pushed Smithers toward Daredevil and made his escape. Reaching the streets, Daredevil raced to Fogwell's Gym to stop Bullseye's assassination attempt.

titulo: Daredevil — Fisk's Anti-Vigilante Campaign › Attack at Fogwell's Gym
texto:
Daredevil arrived at Fogwell's Gym and found Bullseye attacking Kingpin and his AVTF. Having already killed many of the agents, Bullseye threw a paperweight at Kingpin to kill him, only for Kingpin to shatter it. Injured by a gunshot from Vanessa Fisk, Bullseye managed to kill two agents protecting Kingpin but was left helpless as the mayor prepared to shoot him with a handgun. Daredevil used his billy club to disarm Kingpin. When Bullseye pulled out his knife to attack, Daredevil threw his billy club at his enemy's face to disorient him before grabbing him and pulling them both out by smashing through the gym's window. Once outside, Bullseye made his escape and Daredevil pursued him.
Chasing the wounded Bullseye to the kitchen of a restaurant, Daredevil caught up to him. Slamming him against the wall, Daredevil disarmed him of his remaining knives. Despite Bullseye's insistence on being left to die, Daredevil intended to rescue his enemy from the AVTF now hunting them. As they began escaping through the underground boiler tunnels, Daredevil talked to Bullseye, who insisted that the scales had been settled with Vanessa's death, a view that Daredevil opposed. When Bullseye mentioned Foggy Nelson, Daredevil angrily grabbed Bullseye by the throat and told him not to say his late friend's name again. They continued to make their escape in the tunnels.
As they continued down the tunnels, weakened by his gunshot wound, Bullseye struggled to walk and refused Daredevil's aid, reminding him that they were enemies. When questioned about his intentions, Daredevil answered that this was an act of repentance for his attempt to kill Bullseye during their fight years ago. Daredevil supported Bullseye as they continued their escape.
Daredevil managed to bring Bullseye to Clinton Church, where they had a brief respite. Daredevil and Bullseye discussed Vanessa's fate and how her potential death would cause Kingpin to go on a vengeful hunt for them. The Seminarian approached to inform them that the AVTF led by Powell were coming and that they had to hide while he stalled them. Daredevil carried Bullseye to a storage room in the church. Realizing the precarious position he was in, Daredevil apologized to Bullseye as he made his escape, leaving him behind.
On the streets, Daredevil began making his escape from the church when he remembered Nelson and his friend's view on mercy. Changing his mind, Daredevil returned back to the church and rescued Bullseye. Avoiding the AVTF, Daredevil managed to bring Bullseye back to Knickerbocker Village, where Karen Page was shocked by this turn of events.

titulo: Daredevil — Fisk's Anti-Vigilante Campaign › Destroying the Weapons
texto:
Daredevil called Soledad Ayala and Angela Del Toro to come to Knickerbocker Village to help the wounded Bullseye. Once they finished providing first aid to Bullseye, they left the hideout. Murdock asked Karen Page about the whereabouts of Christofi Savva, and Page replied that they had heard nothing, but the resistance kept growing daily regardless. The topic turned toward the unconscious Bullseye, and Page reminded Murdock of the Duel at Clinton Church and the death of Paul Lantom, for which Bullseye was responsible.
Murdock recalled their past discussion, when he had told Page that he intended to kill Fisk and she had stopped him. Page was now reconsidering her past ideals, and Murdock pleaded with her to stop thinking this way. Murdock stated that their stance was what separated them from Wilson Fisk. Page told Murdock that she might have been wrong and that their war would never end until either he or Kingpin was gone. Their argument was interrupted when Jessica Jones messaged for Murdock to meet her. Before leaving to meet his old friend, Murdock told Page that vengeance was not justice.
Later, Daredevil surveyed the AVTF Storage Facility and met with Jones, who told him about the attack on her house. She stated that the attackers were not the AVTF and informed Daredevil that Mr. Charles and the CIA were displaying interest in her and other enhanced individuals. Jones also shared her discoveries regarding Kingpin's connections to the CIA. Daredevil used his enhanced hearing to pick up the sound of the wristwatch he had planted in one of the weapon caches, confirming that the weapons were there.
The two then decided to launch their attack. Daredevil and Jones broke into the facility and began attacking the AVTF agents who were handling the weapons. During the battle, Daredevil and Jones coordinated to deal with their opponents. When Jones fought Powell, her powers gave out, allowing the agent to knock her down. Daredevil intervened and saved his friend from Powell. As some of the explosives in the cache caught fire and caused explosions, Daredevil escaped the burning facility with Jones.

titulo: Daredevil — Fisk's Anti-Vigilante Campaign › Duel in Wilson Fisk's Dungeon
texto:
Daredevil returned to Knickerbocker Village and found Karen Page about to execute Bullseye. Before she could shoot him, Daredevil disarmed her by throwing his billy club at her weapon. Daredevil pleaded with her, saying he could not allow her to kill him. Page was furious and demanded to know what was wrong with him. She was frustrated that Daredevil continuously chose his enemies over his loved ones. Page criticized Daredevil's choices, which led to more people dying. Daredevil refused Page's plea for permission to kill Bullseye and softly asked what had happened to her. Daredevil learned from Page that Christofi Savva had never reached his destination or her source never broadcasted, which made Page conclude that they were both dead, fueling her rage and desperation. Page angrily left their hideout.
Realizing that their war was destroying everyone they loved, Daredevil visited Kingpin in his dungeon. Having lost Vanessa Fisk due to Bullseye's attack, Daredevil gave his condolences to the grieving Kingpin. Daredevil offered a solution to end their war: they would both leave New York City and never return. However, Kingpin refused to consider it, saying there was nothing that could be given or taken away to make him stop. Daredevil invited his adversary to imagine if they had never met, Foggy Nelson and Vanessa would still be alive. At the mention of his dead wife, Kingpin became furious and attacked Daredevil.
At first, Daredevil evaded and dodged Kingpin's furious punches, until he was grabbed and thrown at Rabbit in a Snowstorm, destroying the painting. Once he endured several punches, Daredevil asked his enemy if this was what he wanted, and Kingpin replied that it was what they both wanted. Daredevil focused and began fighting Kingpin seriously. Using his weapons and martial arts skills, Daredevil managed to defeat Kingpin, finishing the fight with a knee strike to the head. The defeated Kingpin taunted Daredevil, reminding him that he could not imprison him and had refused to kill him, meaning that their conflict was at an impasse once again. Realizing that his enemy was right, Daredevil could do nothing but wordlessly leave the dungeon.

titulo: Daredevil — Fisk's Anti-Vigilante Campaign › The People v. Karen Page
texto:
Murdock learned that Karen Page had been captured by Powell during the Attack at New York City Hall. Meeting with his allies, Jessica Jones and Cherry, Murdock was notified about CIA agent Mr. Charles and his connection to Kingpin from Jones, and about Page's whereabouts from Cherry. Cherry warned Murdock that Kingpin intended to put Page on trial and that he was putting himself at risk if he tried to get her out. Jones informed Murdock that she was taking a step back from the fight to take care of her daughter, Danielle Cage-Jones.
Knowing that Marge McCaffrey was in danger, Daredevil returned to Knickerbocker Village and made the choice to free Bullseye. Daredevil told his enemy that he still hated him for the people he had killed— Ray Nadeem, Paul Lantom, and Foggy Nelson —but he was willing to forgive him and allow him to do his one good deed: protect Governor McCaffrey. Bullseye agreed.
Daredevil was able to get in contact with his old friend and ally, Brett Mahoney, and asked for his aid to speak to Page. Mahoney managed to sneak her out of her cell and bring her to Daredevil, who waited outside the precinct. Daredevil and Page apologized for their spat and forgave each other, then discussed what they were going to do. Daredevil informed her that they had to cross some lines to defeat Kingpin and assured her that he was with her.
Murdock reunited with Kirsten McDuffie, and together they began making plans to defend Page. On the day of Page's trial, Murdock showed up at the courtroom and acted as McDuffie's co-counsel. He helped McDuffie by cross-examining the testimonies of Connor Powell and Cole North, trying to establish the illicit nature of Kingpin's reign.

titulo: Daredevil — Fisk's Anti-Vigilante Campaign › Shot by the AVTF
texto:
As the trial was adjourned for the day, Murdock and Kirsten McDuffie began to leave the building. Murdock noticed that Powell, Cole North, and other AVTF agents were not leaving. As Murdock and McDuffie were escorted out by Cherry, Angie Kim, and other NYPD allies, Murdock heard the AVTF approaching in a vehicle with the intention to attack them. Murdock warned his allies to take cover as their attackers opened fire.
Murdock managed to get McDuffie to Cherry and Kim so they could evacuate safely, but stayed behind and sustained a gunshot to the leg. Murdock threw his walking stick into the AVTF vehicle, shattering the windshield and causing them to crash. With his attackers dealt with, Murdock began painfully walking out of the parking lot.
Arriving at Clinton Church, Murdock managed to get himself to a seat and began praying. As he prayed, Jessica Jones arrived to assist him and get him to safety.

titulo: Daredevil — The Masked Vigilante › Questioning Semyon
texto:
Once onto the roof, Murdock tied up Semyon for interrogation while asking Claire Temple if she had found anything on his phone. Temple explained the phone had been smashed when Semyon was hit with the extinguisher. Murdock and Temple debated why she chose to help him, with Temple explaining that she had tried to help a man in need and found a man clearly capable of much more than a normal man. Murdock quipped that his ability to take punishment without complaining was more likely due to his Catholicism.
When Murdock noted that nobody would take in somebody like him purely out of faith, Temple admitted that while working at Metro-General Hospital as a nurse, she had been hearing even more stories recently of the New York City Police Department bringing in criminals who had been stopped by a masked man, as well as a nineteen-year-old waitress who had been saved from an attempted rape. While Temple claimed to want to believe in Murdock's mission, he confessed to knowing that she was afraid. He encouraged Temple that she must not give into the fear that she was feeling or the men like Semyon and those he worked for would win against them.
Murdock provided Temple with a mask and began questioning the mobster on the location of the missing boy, threatening that he would hurt him when he lied. Murdock demanded to know where Anatoly and Vladimir Ranskahov were keeping the kidnapped boy, to which Semyon claimed the boy was dead. Murdock then hit Semyon for lying but still failed to get the truth from him, with Semyon mocking Murdock for falling for his plan. Desperate to find the boy, Temple suggested that Murdock should stab Semyon just above his eye-socket, causing him incredible pain.
When that still did not work, Murdock admitted that Semyon was right in that if he killed him, then another Russian thug would take his place. However, he promised that sooner or later, one of them would talk. Cutting Semyon free, Murdock then dragged him across the roof and threatened to throw him off the edge. As Murdock claimed to enjoy the fear this put in him, Semyon eventually gave in and told him exactly where the boy was: underneath the Troika Restaurant in New York City which was controlled by the Russians. Semyon claimed the Ranskahov brothers would kill Murdock as soon as he arrived at the restaurant.
Sick of hearing his mockeries, Murdock still threw Semyon off the roof, letting him fall into the same dumpster he had been pulled out from earlier. When Temple asked if Semyon was alive, Murdock assured her he was, having heard his faint heartbeat. Murdock advised Temple to temporarily relocate from her apartment as when Semyon awoke, he would be back with more enemies. As Temple confirmed she had somewhere to go, Murdock requested the address in case he needed her help later on. As he prepared to leave, Temple stated she did not believe Murdock enjoyed what he did.

titulo: Daredevil — Fisk's Anti-Vigilante Campaign › Sacrifice
texto:
Taken back to Knickerbocker Village by Jessica Jones, Murdock had his wounds tended to by her. Murdock mused that Jones had said she did not want to get involved in the conflict anymore, but she stated that it had gotten out of hand. She asked Murdock if they could stop Kingpin, and Murdock stated that he could not without help. Murdock was certain that Kingpin would not kill Karen Page without him being there, which he intended to use to his advantage.
While Jones moved to retrieve Marge McCaffrey, Murdock headed to New York State Supreme Court Building and arrived in the middle of the session while Heather Glenn was being examined by the court and Benjamin Hochberg. When asked about his condition, Murdock assured Kirsten McDuffie and Page that he was alright. Both Murdock and McCaffrey questioned and challenged Glenn's testimony on Page. In particular, Murdock questioned his ex-girlfriend's views on vigilantism and how she was hiding behind the Fisk Administration, highlighting her hypocrisy.
Murdock called his witness, Wilson Fisk, to the stand, and Fisk entered with his AVTF. As Fisk was questioned about his policies such as his Safer Streets Initiative and his actions of bringing vigilantes to justice, Murdock challenged him. Fisk stated that Murdock should know that vigilantes were dangerous, reminding him of the Attack on the Black & White Ball, but Murdock reminded him that he had taken a bullet for him. Murdock further challenged Fisk on the effectiveness of his policies, which included actions like taking people from the streets. When the questioning turned to the Northern Star, for which Page was charged with aiding Daredevil in sinking, Murdock challenged Fisk about his involvement with weapon smuggling through his free port of Red Hook Port.
Murdock asked Fisk if Daredevil had sunk the Northern Star. Fisk said that the evidence showed he did, but Murdock countered that the evidence came from people under Fisk's employ. Murdock challenged Fisk's claim by presenting video testimony from Christofi Savva. This revelation caused an uproar, and Murdock and McDuffie had to convince the judges in their office. During their talk, Fisk whispered to Murdock and warned him that the evidence would ruin his life, threatening him with prison. Murdock was not deterred, and the judges accepted the evidence.
As the court was shown the video testimony, with Savva revealing Fisk's involvement with weapon smuggling and that Daredevil had been there but had not sunk the ship, Murdock countered Hochberg's argument that the evidence was immaterial by stating that he could corroborate someone had been on the Northern Star. Murdock established through questioning that Daredevil had been on the ship, so all they needed was to ask Daredevil himself. As Murdock questioned Fisk about what a hero was, Jones and McCaffrey arrived at the court. When Hochberg tried to question the relevance of Murdock's line of questioning since Page was the one on trial, Murdock reminded the court that the trial was happening because of Fisk.
Murdock continued to press Fisk, forcing him to admit that Daredevil had been on the Northern Star and was in fact in the courtroom. Knowing that this was the only way to save Page and deliver justice to Fisk, Murdock revealed to the audience that he was Daredevil. Amidst the uproar and rebuke from Hochberg, Murdock demonstrated his secret identity by displaying his enhanced senses to the people, by throwing his walking stick at the wall and catching it as it bounced back.
Using his revealed identity as Daredevil, Murdock exposed Fisk's crime of smuggling weapons into New York and arming his militia, and explained that he and Jones had worked together to destroy the weapons. By proving that the court did not have the ability or mandate to decide justice, Murdock was able to convince the judges to deem Page not guilty of the charges against her. Victorious, Murdock rejoined his allies.

titulo: Daredevil — Fisk's Anti-Vigilante Campaign › Battle for New York
texto:
Murdock headed to the courthouse lobby to confront Wilson Fisk and make him accept his defeat. Fisk refused and retorted that Murdock had only weakened himself by revealing his secret identity. As they confronted each other, Powell ordered the planned assassin to shoot Murdock; however, this plan was sabotaged by Bullseye, who intended to shoot Fisk instead. When Powell warned Fisk about the trap, Buck Cashman reacted by pulling his weapon. Murdock tried to stop him, but Cashman was shot by Bullseye. The courthouse erupted in chaos as people took cover inside the building. The AVTF secured the building, locking everyone inside with the explicit intention of not allowing Murdock to leave.
As evening came, Murdock stayed with his allies, Karen Page, Kirsten McDuffie, Jessica Jones, and Marge McCaffrey, as they waited in the judges' office. When McDuffie asked about Fisk's motive for locking everyone inside the building, Murdock believed that Fisk, in his current mental state, wished to tear everything down with him. Murdock watched the news broadcast as Fisk tried to win the public back to his favor by framing the assassination attempt as a siege to stay in power, but his broadcast was sabotaged by BB Urich 's City Without Fear, which detailed every crime Fisk had committed as mayor. As New York City erupted in uprising, the resistance began marching toward the courthouse to oust Fisk from power. Electing to join them, Murdock was given his suit by Jones and donned it.
Daredevil heard the task force approaching the office with orders from Fisk to kill them. Daredevil and Jones went to confront their attackers. Finding the AVTF in the midst of hurting and apprehending people, Daredevil and Jones engaged in a fierce fight against them in a hallway. Together with his old comrade and eventually joined by White Tiger, Daredevil battled his way through the AVTF and managed to reach the lobby, where they were joined by Page, Brett Mahoney, Cherry, and the rest of the resistance.
In the lobby, Daredevil and his resistance confronted a bloodied Kingpin who had been brutalizing and killing protestors along the way. Kingpin furiously roared that they were all wrong about him and that he had had good intentions for the city. Enraged by his words, the protestors began charging at him despite Daredevil's attempts to stop them. Daredevil and Jones made their way through the mass of protestors as Kingpin was overwhelmed and beaten. Eventually reaching his enemy, Daredevil pulled Kingpin free and made the protestors stop attacking. Daredevil urged Kingpin to stand down, stating that the fight was over for both of them. He urged Fisk to take the deal from Alan Steverud and leave the city. Daredevil warned Kingpin that if he went to prison, his memories of Vanessa Fisk would be gone forever, and his refusal would only continue their conflict. Kingpin accepted defeat and agreed to leave the city.

titulo: Daredevil — Imprisoned › Arrested for Vigilante Crimes
texto:
With Wilson Fisk gone and ousted as mayor, New York began returning to normal. Having lost his license as a lawyer, Murdock went on a date with Karen Page to Panna II Garden Indian Restaurant. They spent hours there, enjoying their time and talking about returning to a normal life after the conclusion of the Anti-Vigilante Campaign. Both Murdock and Page laughed over the difficulty of returning to normalcy after their war with Fisk, with Murdock uncertain how to return to daily life without being hunted and hiding all the time.
Murdock heard the sirens from a New York City Police Department car and knew that his time as a free man was over, surrendering peacefully. Before being taken away, Murdock kissed Page and declared his love for her. Murdock was taken to Rikers Island, passing by Cole North, who gave him a nod of respect, Connor Powell, and other ex- Anti-Vigilante Task Force officers who were also arrested. Sitting on the bed inside his cell, Murdock smiled in contentment, knowing that his loved ones and his city were safe.

titulo: Daredevil — Early Life › Accidentally Blinded
texto:
In 1994, Matt witnessed the RAND Oil & Chemicals truck getting into an accident, as it was about to hit an elderly man. Matt rushed to save the man, but got into an accident himself, as hazardous chemicals from the truck splashed into his face. Jack rushed there and tried to comfort his son, while he felt immense pain in his eyes due to the chemicals. His father's face was the last thing he saw before his vision dimmed and Matt realized that he was blinded, screaming in despair. Matt was taken to a hospital and upon waking up, he found out that he could hear every sound in the nearby area, which caused him pain, while Jack was by his side, trying to calm him down.
Matt kept his heightened senses in secret, struggling to comprehend them, and learned to read Braille to cope with his blindness. Jack continued his boxing career, earning enough to support them despite losing most of his fights. Matt still looked up to his father, who repeatedly told him to do whatever he could to not wind up like him. One day, Matt was reading Thurgood Marshall in Braille at Fogwell's Gym, while Jack was training for an upcoming match. With his enhanced hearing, Matt was able to overhear Jack talking to Roscoe Sweeney and Sammy Silke, who instructed him to throw the match against Carl Creel in exchange for money.
When Jack left the house for the match, Matt listened to it on the TV, cheering for his father who overcame the odds and defeated Creel. He waited for Jack to return but when he did not come home, Matt went out to look for him, until he reached an alley which was sealed off by the New York City Police Department. Matt pushed through Ray Peters and kneeled over the dead body in the alley, touching it, and realizing that it was Jack, who had been killed for not losing the fight. Matt fell to his knees and begged his father to wake up, crying over his father's lifeless body, as he was left all alone.

titulo: Daredevil — The Masked Vigilante › Rescue of the Kidnapped Boy
texto:
Murdock then went to Troika Restaurant where the boy was being held hostage, silently getting past any guards and preparing to fight to protect the boy from any harm. He arrived and immediately began walking down the hallways and began listening closely to get a sense of where all the Veles Taxi mobsters were positioned, ensuring that he had the best tactical position to try and help the boy however he could, hearing multiple men in two different rooms who were within the hallway.
Despite all of the pain he was still in, Murdock gathered all of the strength he had left and began fighting the mobsters hired by Anatoly and Vladimir Ranskahov, while using the element of surprise to his advantage. Charging into the room, Murdock was sure to disarm the men from the guns first, forcing them to fight with their fists where Murdock was at a clear advantage, easily subduing the men during the brawl. Even when the other room came out to help in the fight, Murdock heard them coming and then threw a large safe at one man, knocking him unconscious as the fight continued in the hall.
Despite more mobsters coming out and trying to stop his attack, Murdock continued fighting with all of his might against the criminals, determined to beat them back so that he could rescue the child Semyon had told him they were planning on selling. Murdock came out as the winner with all the mobsters lying unconscious on the floor or in too much pain to move as Murdock got to his feet and unlocked the kidnapped boy's door. Murdock then removed his mask and freed the boy, telling him that he was now safe. Murdock carried him from the restaurant and later returned him to his family.

titulo: Daredevil — The Masked Vigilante › Conversation with Father Lantom
texto: The next morning, Murdock visited Clinton Church and spoke to Paul Lantom. Lantom told him that he was aware he was Jack Murdock 's son but assured him that through the seal of confession he could not tell anyone what they had spoken about. He asked if Murdock was there for confession, but he told him he was not. Lantom then suggested that Murdock should join him for a cup of coffee, but Murdock replied that perhaps they would do so some other time.

titulo: Daredevil — The Masked Vigilante › Meeting James Wesley
texto: Back at the law office, Murdock and Foggy Nelson were visited by James Wesley, who asked them to represent his client John Healy, who had just brutally murdered Prohaszka. When Wesley left the office, having insulted Karen Page, Murdock followed him, tracking him by the tick of his watch. Murdock heard Wesley enter a limo, where he spoke to his employer, before being driven away. Murdock considered following him, but had felt a pain in his side and felt blood running from an open wound. Although he showed initial uncertainty towards the case, Murdock decided to take the case in an attempt to learn who was behind the criminal activity in Hell's Kitchen.

titulo: Daredevil — The Masked Vigilante › The People v. John Healy
texto: Meeting him at the 15th Precinct Police Station, Murdock and Foggy Nelson had cross-examined John Healy, who clearly was experienced in court proceedings. They began working out a strategy to get Healy off by claiming self-defense. During the trial, Murdock noticed a female juror's heart begin to beat faster when James Wesley entered. Murdock later found Oscar threatening her and forced him to leave her alone. Murdock later gave a speech during the trial claiming that there was not enough evidence to convict Healy. As the result was being read out, Murdock noticed that another juryman's heart raced as Wesley entered; the jury announced a hung jury, resulting in Healy's freedom.

titulo: Daredevil — The Masked Vigilante › Learning of Wilson Fisk
texto: Murdock later tracked down and confronted John Healy. The pair began to fight, Healy using objects around him to attack Murdock. After an exhausting fight, Murdock came out as the victor and began questioning Healy on who his employer was. Eventually, Healy told him the name: Wilson Fisk. Healy told Murdock that now that he had revealed his name, he, his family and his friends would all become targets. Seeing no alternative, Healy called Murdock a coward for not killing him before he slammed his own face into an iron spike, killing him instantly.

titulo: Daredevil — The Masked Vigilante › Pursuing the Russians
texto:
Murdock later attacked Anatoly Ranskahov and his men, although Anatoly escaped with only minor injuries, Murdock was able to throw one of his men out of a window and onto his car. After escaping, Murdock went to Claire Temple to treat his injuries. Later, he received a phone call from Temple just as she was being kidnapped by Russian Mafia. Murdock ran to her aid but was too late. He spoke to Santino who was able to reveal that she had been taken away in a taxi driven by the Russians.
Murdock arrived at the taxi's firm where he found Temple being beaten and tortured by the Russians. Murdock switched off the lights in the room and managed to fight off the Russians in the dark and rescued Temple. He took her back to his apartment and tried to comfort her. Temple asked him to feel her heart and tell her how she was feeling; Murdock knew then that she was terribly afraid for her life. However, Temple assured him that he could do something about that fear. Murdock then revealed to her his real first name.
Murdock tended to Temple's wounds and explained that his other senses, such as balance and direction, were enhanced, allowing him to detect micro-changes in air density, vibrations and temperature, which made his impressionistic radar/sonar-like sense. He asked her to stay at his apartment for her safety and they ended up sharing a kiss. The next night, Murdock followed a taxi carrying a blind man to a warehouse. Once there, he attacked the Russians guarding the man, although the blind man was killed after being shot in the cross-fire, Murdock was able to catch one of the gangsters, Piotr.
Now confronting Piotr and closely picked him up while he was on the ground, Murdock tried to learn the location of Vladimir Ranskahov, who Temple had heard about when she was captured, but Piotr begged him not to cut off his head. Confused on the remark of killing him, Murdock asked what Piotr meant for having his head decapitated and was told that everyone knows that the masked man had took the head of Anatoly. Before he could learn any more, Murdock threatens Piotr on the accusation of cutting heads before the police arrived, leading Murdock to make his escape and leaving Piotr to be arrested.
Back at the office, Murdock began to ask Foggy Nelson and Karen Page whether they had heard about a Russian gangster having his head cut off before they were interrupted by the arrival of Elena Cardenas. Cardenas explained that she needed legal help as her landlord was attempting to kick her out of her property and demolish her home after failing to finish repair work to the property. They agreed to take the case and Murdock told Cardenas that Nelson would speak to her landlord's lawyer while he went to the NYPD. Nelson complained, knowing that the landlord was represented by their former employers Landman and Zack.
Murdock arrived at the 15th Precinct Police Station and spoke to Brett Mahoney. Murdock explained the situation to Mahoney and asked to see the complaint files against Armand Tully, who owned Cardenas' home. Mahoney agreed and asked Murdock to wait. While he was waiting, Murdock overheard the questioning of Piotr, the mobster he had attacked the night before. Using his enhanced hearing, Murdock heard Piotr asking for a deal in exchange for information on his employer, Wilson Fisk. However, Christian Blake and Carl Hoffman turned out to be under Fisk's pay and pretended to be attacked by Piotr, killing him before Murdock could do anything.
Knowing that the detectives were working for Fisk, Murdock tracked down and attacked Blake. Blake tried to stick to his story that Piotr had attacked his partner, until Murdock began breaking his arm. Murdock asked him why Fisk had Prohaszka murdered; he refused to answer, so Murdock knocked him out and stole his phone. Murdock later called Temple and had her help him look at the phone. Temple told Murdock the phone had a list of four locations which Murdock recognized the addresses as locations under the control of the Russian Mafia. Murdock went to go after the locations, but Temple told him that she could not fall in love with someone who puts his life in danger.

titulo: Daredevil — The Masked Vigilante › Saving Vladimir Ranskahov
texto:
Murdock traveled to a location from the list on Blake's phone and found a pair of mobsters standing by the door. Murdock began fighting them. During the fight he overheard panic inside the building and knew a bomb was about to be set off. Murdock was shielded by his opponent as the door was blown off towards them as the building exploded, killing the Russians inside. When he awoke, Murdock caught Vladimir Ranskahov attempting to escape the wreckage. He attacked him and knocked him out, but before he could do anything, the police arrived and attempted to arrest him. Murdock was able to fight off the police, who mentioned killing them as they were "told" to leave "no witnesses," meaning that they were corrupt. He was unable to stop Ranskahov from being shot in the side, although he managed to escape with Ranskahov's unconscious body.
Murdock carried Ranskahov to an Abandoned Building and began questioning him. Ranskahov claimed that Murdock was responsible for the Murder of Anatoly Ranskahov and that he had been working with Wilson Fisk. Murdock told him that he had been played by Fisk, who was responsible for Anatoly 's murder and the destruction of his warehouses. Murdock offered to help him escape from Fisk's men, in exchange for information that would help him make Fisk pay for everything he had done, Ranskahov crudely refused before losing consciousness.
Knowing that Ranskahov would die without medical attention, Murdock called Claire Temple for assistance. Murdock explained the situation to Temple and asked her to walk him through saving Ranskahov's life, but when he explained who it was they were helping, Temple was furious. Temple agreed to help and asked Murdock to tell her what tools he had available. Murdock used his heightened senses to detect a flare in the warehouse. Under Temple's instruction, Murdock lit the flare and used it to burn Ranskahov's open wound, sealing it. Ranskahov screamed in agony until he lost consciousness again.
Murdock heard Sullivan arriving in the warehouse, after hearing Ranskahov's screams. Murdock attacked him and began questioning him. Murdock realized that the officer was a new cop who had not been paid off by Fisk. Murdock ordered the man to call off backup, but instead, the officer told them that he had been taken hostage. Murdock was unable to knock him out in time to stop him. Murdock tied up the officer before pulling the officer's gun apart and throwing it away. Murdock began questioning Ranskahov again, who asked him about his morals on not killing people but being willing to let people die.
Murdock reminded Ranskahov that Fisk had taken down his operation and had enough police in his pocket to ensure that Ranskahov was killed before he could leak information. Ranskahov agreed and told the man about his first encounter with Fisk and how their operation first came about. Murdock learned that Fisk was working with the Chinese. Ranskahov told him there was one name he needed to know, the name of Fisk's money man. When Murdock leaned in to hear it, Ranskahov attacked him, causing them to fall through the floorboards.

titulo: Daredevil — The Masked Vigilante › Speaking with Wilson Fisk
texto:
The pair survived the fall and Murdock told him that it was not a smart thing to do. Vladimir Ranskahov then lost consciousness again, and this time, he went into cardiac arrest, before Murdock performed CPR and saved his life. Afterwards Murdock began to look for a way out, finding a sewage manhole cover but finding it was too hard to lift alone. He was interrupted when Wilson Fisk used Sullivan 's radio to contact them. Murdock picked up the radio and spoke to his enemy for the first time. Fisk told him that they had a lot in common, but Murdock assured him that they did not and would brought down.
Fisk told Murdock that his part in the drama would end that night, as he would be blamed for the bombings. Fisk had then offered Murdock the chance to kill Ranskahov and go free, noting all of the crimes Ranskahov was guilty of. When Murdock refused, Fisk ordered his men to open fire at the New York City Police Department and release footage of Murdock attacking police. Fisk then hung up his radio contact, believing Murdock to be killed that night. Murdock called Claire Temple to say goodbye and began searching for a way out. However, Ranskahov helped Murdock to show him the way through the sewer.
Once in the sewer, they were attacked by a small team of ESU officers, Murdock was able to beat them but found the wounded Ranskahov had taken one of their guns and was aiming it at him. Ranskahov told him that he planned on staying behind and fighting to the death, as his testimony would not lead to Fisk's arrest and only death would stop Fisk. Murdock insisted that he was not a killer. Ranskahov told him that Fisk would destroy his life and his family. He then told him that Fisk's money man's name was Leland Owlsley. Murdock then escaped as Ranskahov fought until his death.

titulo: Daredevil — The Masked Vigilante › Devil of Hell's Kitchen
texto: At the office, Murdock, Foggy Nelson and Karen Page discussed the Bombing of Hell's Kitchen and the masked man they held responsible, whom had been dubbed the "Devil of Hell's Kitchen." Due to the narrative that the Devil had murdered NYPD officers and had committed the bombings, Nelson had become convinced that the Devil was a terrorist while Page insisted he was not. Murdock claimed that while he was angry about Nelson and Elena Cardenas being hurt, he did not wish to condemn the actions of vigilantes straight away and that as lawyers they need to think differently. Murdock even stated that he would represent the vigilante, as was his right, although Nelson strongly disagreed. Page left, not saying where, so Nelson brought up her not telling them something, which Murdock responded by saying that everyone had secrets. Murdock stayed after Nelson left and read up on Leland Owlsley.

titulo: Daredevil — The Masked Vigilante › Reunion with Stick
texto:
Murdock later tracked down and attacked Leland Owlsley who had just had a meeting with Nobu Yoshioka about transporting something secret that night. Murdock pinned Owlsley against his own car and demanded to know for whom he worked; when Owlsley lied and claimed he worked for Silver & Brent, Murdock punched him and explained that he knew he worked for Wilson Fisk and demanded to know what Fisk's upcoming plans were for New York City. Before he could get any more information from him, however, he was distracted by the sound of a man with a stick approaching; Owlsley used this moment to stun Murdock with a taser before escaping.
As Murdock lay on the ground and recovered from the shock of the taser, the man with the walking stick revealed himself to be Murdock's own former mentor Stick, who arrived and berated him for being beaten by an old man despite all the training they had done when Murdock was a child. Murdock rose to his feet and questioned what Stick was doing in Hell's Kitchen to which he claimed that he was there to save Murdock and everyone else in New York City from a horrible death, although Murdock remained somewhat skeptical of his true motives for returning to the city and seeking him out.
Murdock brought Stick back to his apartment, where Stick began to immediately insult his comfortable lifestyle. Murdock argued that Stick was just pissed off he had made something of his life without his help. Stick told him he should abandon his life and live as a warrior, but when he insulted Jack Murdock 's legacy, Murdock attacked him but was only able to break his hold. Stick revealed he was there to continue his war by fighting the Japanese and wanted the weapon Nobu Yoshioka was transporting, known as the Black Sky. Murdock agreed to help if Stick promised not to kill anyone, to which Stick agreed.

titulo: Daredevil — Early Life › Living at the Orphanage
texto: Losing his father, Murdock was taken to Saint Agnes Orphanage, living under the care of nuns and Maggie Grace, unaware of her being his mother. Murdock suffered from terrible nightmares, which caused him to wake up screaming, and Grace would sit by his side and hold his hand to help him. However, one night, after Murdock had a nightmare, Grace did not come as she was tending to other children, leading to Murdock never asking for help again. Being raised at Saint Agnes, Murdock became a Catholic, holding a record for the most Hail Marys for five years in a row and frequently praying to Saint Lucia in the times of struggle.

titulo: Daredevil — The Masked Vigilante › Attack on Black Sky
texto:
The pair arrived at the dock that same night and soon discovered Yoshioka and his soldiers moving a Asano Robotics container from a cargo ship.
