titulo: Gorr — Early Life › Disciple of Rapu
texto: Gorr was given a daughter, and they both constantly prayed to their planet 's god Rapu, with his daughter drawing pictures of him while Gorr prayed. He had his head tattooed with symbols of his devotion to Rapu. However, despite Gorr's continuous prayers to Rapu, the people of Gorr's planet died from the heat and lack of food and water, leaving only Gorr and his increasingly weakening daughter left.

titulo: Gorr — Cosmic Killing Spree › The Ultimate Wish
texto:
Now before Eternity, Gorr prepared to complete his mission by making his wish. Thor told Gorr to stop, but he felt that he owed it to his daughter to finish what he started. Thor appealed to Gorr, claiming that he knew his pain and that he wasn't seeking revenge, but love.
Gorr was confused by Thor's suggestion, and when Thor walked away, Gorr was angered at him. Thor stated that Gorr had won so he was going to spend his last moments with Jane Foster, who was now in a weakened state. Gorr listened as Thor told him that he could bring his daughter back. But, as he felt the effects of All-Black the Necrosword wearing off, Gorr noted that he was dying and would not be able to look after his daughter. Foster assured Gorr that Thor would care for her, which he agreed to do.
Convinced by Thor and Foster, Gorr made his wish to Eternity to bring his daughter back to life. As Gorr laid in the water, he was overcome with happiness to see his daughter returned. The two hugged and Gorr began to cried over how much he had missed her. Gorr then told his daughter that he was sorry. As Foster died, Gorr turned to Thor, extended his arm out to him, and asked him to protect his daughter. Thor nodded to Gorr, who then died in his daughter's arms.

titulo: Gorr — Losing Everything › Demise of His Daughter
texto: Sometime later, Gorr was forced to carry his daughter up to their altar, with Gorr pleading to Rapu to provide them sustenance. However, when Gorr noticed his daughter was on the verge of death, he cradled her, telling his daughter that there was going to be a great land and water for them, but his weakened daughter just told Gorr that she was tired before passing away in his arms.

titulo: Gorr — Losing Everything › Gaining the Necrosword
texto:
Awaiting his own death, Gorr mourned for his daughter until he heard a voice beckoning for him. Confused, Gorr followed the voice into a lavish forest, where he gratefully submerged himself in the stream, replenishing his body with water after a long time going without.
As Gorr crawled out of the stream, he cut his hand on a sword, but the cut instantaneously healed. Noticing fruit before him, Gorr desperately began to eat it until he heard a voice. Recognizing the person as the god Rapu, Gorr immediately bowed in front of him, before introducing himself as the last of his Disciples. Gorr explained that his people's faith in Rapu never wavered and they now awaited the "eternal reward" that Rapu had promised, which was what Gorr thought the fruit was for.
Mocking Gorr, Rapu clarified that there was no eternal reward, and that they were celebrating the death of the Dark Shadow Lord, who had been the last wielder of All-Black the Necrosword, whom was threatening his empire. Gorr pointed out how there's no empire left, but Rapu answered, stating that there will always be more followers to replace him. Saddened, Gorr told how his kind have suffered, and how they and his daughter died in his name. Rapu was not empathetic and claimed that they deserved to die in his name.
The now enraged Gorr stated that Rapu was not a god and therefore was unworthy of worship, tearing off his medallion. Rapu grabbed Gorr by the throat, proclaiming that Gorr now had a purpose, to be sacrificed to Rapu by his hand. However, the shadow that Gorr and Rapu cast, allowed the Necrosword to rise into Gorr's hands, telling him to find Eternity by using a Bifrost Bridge, where he could exact his revenge against the gods. Accepting this, Gorr proceeded to stab Rapu in the throat.
Putting him down, Rapu explained to Gorr how the Necrosword had chosen him, and that now Gorr will be cursed by the sword. However, as the Necrosword physically changed Gorr, he told Rapu and the other gods that it didn't feel like a curse, but a promise, before stating that his vow was to kill all of the gods. Gorr then beheaded Rapu, marking the first kill of his campaign to achieve his revenge.

titulo: Gorr — Cosmic Killing Spree › Slaughtering the Gods
texto: Taking on the Necrosword 's goal, Gorr traveled the cosmos through the Shadow Realm, and with the help of the Shadow Monsters, they slayed any gods he could find until he found Eternity. This violent massacre eventually led to Gorr being known as the God Butcher, and he became feared by the likes of Zeus, among others. On his journey, Gorr killed the Sky Lords of Indigarr, leaving the Indigarrians unprotected, allowing Habooska the Horrible and his army to invade the planet.

titulo: Gorr — Cosmic Killing Spree › Attack on Falligar the Behemoth
texto: During this time, Gorr would be challenged by Falligar the Behemoth and Lady Sif on Falligar ; however, with it being a trap, Gorr killed Falligar and cut off Sif's arm in battle, leaving her alive to warn Thor. Gorr proceeded to travel to New Asgard, where he intended to lure Thor so that he could obtain Stormbreaker so that he could open to Gates of Eternity.

titulo: Gorr — Cosmic Killing Spree › Attack on New Asgard
texto:
Gorr traveled to Earth and went to New Asgard, Norway. He stared out at New Asgard, before sending the Shadow Monsters to attack the Asgardians. Gorr stayed back and waited until he witnessed Thor arrive on the Bifrost Bridge, which made him smile. Gorr made his approach towards Thor, utilising the shadows to disappear so that he could sneak up on him.
After ambushing him, Gorr used the Shadow Monsters to pin Thor to a car and threatened him with All-Black the Necrosword. Gorr attempted to steal Stormbreaker, but Thor fought back. Now cornered by Thor, Mighty Thor, and Valkyrie, Gorr realized that he was not going to be able to steal Stormbreaker and retreated into the shadows. Instead, Gorr came up with a new plan to kidnap all of the Asgardian children and put them in a cage. Thor and Mighty Thor chased after Gorr, but he escaped with the children.

titulo: Gorr — Cosmic Killing Spree › Threatening the Children
texto:
As Gorr flew the cage to the Shadow Realm, he overheard Axl Heimdallson recounting the story of how Thor went to Nidavellir to forge Stormbreaker, and then used it to decapitate Thanos. Wanting to intimidate the children, Gorr teleported into their cage suddenly, startling them. He told them what a nice story that was, before introducing the children to Octy, who he then proceeded to tear the head off of, frightening the children.
Gorr mockingly asked why they were upset as they had liked the decapitation story earlier. He then threw Octy's head at them. Gorr then noticed a young girl and told the rest how he had a daughter, telling them how she liked to draw but that the gods were not there to protect her. When he stated they were alone, Axl reassured the children that Thor was on his way to rescue them, which Gorr menacingly told them that he was counting on it, before leaving the kids by themselves.

titulo: Gorr — Cosmic Killing Spree › Ambush at the Shadow Realm
texto:
Returning to the Shadow Realm, Gorr waited for Thor to arrive. Once Thor, Mighty Thor, and Valkyrie entered Gorr's hut, he engulfed the room with shadows and revealed himself. Mighty Thor threw Mjølnir at Gorr, but he dodged it and proceeded to restrain the three heroes with tentacles. Gorr told Thor to summon Stormbreaker, but he refused.
Gorr noted how Thor was denied help from the gods, something they had in common, but Valkyrie insisted that they were nothing alike. Gorr pulled Valkyrie closer to him and responded that he, unlike Thor, was not a hypocrite as he felt that he was creating peace. Gorr was then excited when he realized Valkyrie was a member of the Valkyrie, and stated that the gods had failed her, too, as her sisters-in-arms had all been killed. Gorr taunted Valkyrie over her losses, deeply upsetting her, before moving her aside.
Gorr directed his attention to Mighty Thor, sensing that she was different from Thor and Valkyrie, as she was dying. Gorr explained that much like how All-Black the Necrosword empowered him, Mjølnir empowered her, but it did not save her from what was killing her. Gorr reiterated how the gods would use them, but would do nothing to help them, and that there would be no eternal reward for their service. Gorr then moved Mighty Thor away, telling Thor that she would be dead soon.
Returning to Thor, Gorr stood behind him as he presented Mighty Thor and Valkyrie still restrained before them. Gorr confessed that he understood Thor's pain, revealing he had a daughter and that he had hoped the gods would save her, only for her to die. But, Gorr had now come to the mentality that his daughter was lucky as she did not have to live in a world run by wicked gods. Gorr once more told Thor to summon Stormbreaker while strangling Mighty Thor and Valkyrie to motivate him.
Thor eventually gave in and summoned Stormbreaker, but used its power to destroy the hut, freeing all of them from Gorr's hold. In return, Gorr summoned many Shadow Monsters to help him fight against the heroes. Gorr stared down with Thor and gestured towards Stormbreaker before running at each other. As Mighty Thor and Valkyrie were distracted with the Shadow Monsters, Gorr battled against Thor, but was still unable to defeat him and claim Stormbreaker.
Mighty Thor and Valkyrie soon joined the fight and teamed up against Gorr, managing to overpower him, allowing Valkyrie to stab him in the back with Thunderbolt. Thor and Mighty Thor went to fight off more of the Shadow Monsters, leaving Valkyrie alone with Gorr as they fought. Gorr used the shadows to appear behind Valkyrie and stabbed her, badly injuring her. Thor went to help Valkyrie, but Gorr had him restrained. Thor broke free and blasted lightning at Gorr, forcing him to retreat. As the heroes accessed the Bifrost Bridge to escape, Gorr reappeared and stole Stormbreaker from Thor.

titulo: Gorr — Cosmic Killing Spree › Reaching Eternity
texto:
With everything he needed, Gorr headed for the Gates of Eternity, still keeping the children captive. Once they arrived, Gorr planted Stormbreaker to the ground, using the Shadow Tentacles to force it in place, and summoned the Bifrost Bridge towards the entrance to open the passageway to Eternity.
Noticing Thor 's arrival behind him, Gorr summoned more Shadow Monsters to protect him so that his mission would not be interrupted. Thor got pass the Shadow Monsters and confronted Gorr, so the two fought. Gorr managed to disarm Thunderbolt from Thor and was able to overpower him, beating Thor to the ground. To finish Thor off, Gorr went to stab him through the chest with All-Black the Necrosword, but Thor managed to catch the sword. As Gorr pushed the Necrosword downwards, he was knocked away by Mjølnir.
Mighty Thor arrived, and she teamed up with Thor to fight against Gorr, who found himself quickly outmatched. As Thor went to stop Stormbreaker, Gorr continued fighting Mighty Thor. As they clashed, Gorr told Mighty Thor that she had lost, mockingly calling her "Lady Thor." As Mighty Thor corrected him, she repeatedly attacked him with Mjølnir. When the two collided their weapons, Mighty Thor created a powerful burst of energy that sent them backwards, weakening the Necrosword.
Gorr went to attack Mighty Thor, but was blocked by Thor. Gorr violently swung at Thor to kill him until the Necrosword was caught between Thunderbolt. With Gorr's sword stuck in place, Mighty Thor threw Mjølnir at it, shattering it into pieces and knocking Gorr to the ground. Gorr reclaimed the hilt and attempted to reforge the sword, but Mighty Thor captured the shards inside of Mjølnir and summoned lightning to destroy them. The Necrosword turned to dust, stripping Gorr of his power, so he hurried to the opened gateway.

titulo: Grandmaster — Early Life › Fascination with Champions
texto: Grandmaster was born shortly after the beginning of the universe alongside his brother, Taneleer Tivan. While his brother became obsessed with collecting objects of all kinds, Grandmaster became obsessed with manipulating life-forms into fighting each other nearly to death.

titulo: Grandmaster — Contest of Champions › Ruling over Sakaar
texto:
Grandmaster became the ruler of the planet Sakaar and became a tyrant. He presided over the Contest of Champions, a gladiatorial event held in an arena where slaves would be subject to battle. Grandmaster later hired a surviving Asgardian Valkyrie designated as Scrapper 142, who became a bodyguard of his alongside Topaz.
Amongst those Grandmaster imprisoned for his Contest of Champions included Beta Ray Bill, Ares, Bi-Beast, Dark-Crawler, Man-Thing, Korg, Miek, Biff, Hajo, Roscoe, Tasba, and Doug. In 2015, Hulk arrived on Sakaar. Hulk later was recognized as one of the new champions in the contest, he would then become truly beloved although remaining a prisoner.

titulo: Grandmaster — Contest of Champions › Enslaving Thor
texto:
Following Odin 's passing in Norway, resulting in the liberation of his firstborn Hela from Hel and the destruction of Mjølnir in her hands, Loki asked Volstagg to transport them back to Asgard. However, Hela kicked Loki and Thor out of the Bifrost Bridge, causing them to crash land on Sakaar. Because time flows differently in Sakaar, Loki arrived two weeks before Thor, even though, to Thor, it had been less than a day.
Loki managed to win Grandmaster's favor over time, becoming his new ally. When Scrapper 142 discovered Thor, he was taken through a tunnel before being jolted from seeing Grandmaster and Topaz. Grandmaster asked Scrapper 142 if he was any kind of a fighter, prompting Thor to demand his release as he stated that he is not for sale. However, Grandmaster proceeded on taking Thor for ten million units and was pecked on the cheek.
Looking for any abilities, Grandmaster inquired information on Thor and who he was. Thor would then rip off his handcuffs again and proclaim himself as the God of Thunder. Grandmaster then ridiculed Thor commenting on the absence of thunder and appearance of sparkles. Grandmaster would then took Thor to meet his cousin Carlo, who attempted to make his escape from Sakaar only to be captured. Momentarily making Carlo desperately begged for his life, Grandmaster pardoned him, only to reveal that he was being pardoned from life. He was then killed using the Melt Stick.
While having properly introduced himself and explained the Contest of Champions, Grandmaster was throwing a party, serving as a DJ. Thor would then notice Loki and promptly whisper concern to him. Loki would explain that he has already been here for two weeks. Grandmaster asked why Loki was whispering to Thor then explain to them that time worked differently around Sakaar, citing his millions of years of age. Loki then insisted that he had never met Thor before being interrupted with the fact they were brothers. Loki then added that he himself was adopted.
Grandmaster then inquiring Thor on his fighting ability, was threatened by a freedom-wanting Thor. Grandmaster mocked him then explained that the only way he could have his freedom was if he was able to defeat the Contest of Champions' ultimate champion. Thor was confident in his ability and was swiftly taken to the cell where the gladiators were located.

titulo: Grandmaster — Contest of Champions › Hulk vs. Thor
texto:
With the audience cheering, Grandmaster introduced Thor as the Lord of Thunder while his champion prepared to arrive. As he built up his entrance, Grandmaster had finally introduced his fellow champion as none other than Hulk, whom Thor had not seen since the Battle of Sokovia in 2015.
Loki watched from above as, to his shock and horror, the Hulk appeared. He then started to walk out due to the fear of their previous encounter. The Grandmaster forbade this act and commanded Loki stay and watch. Grandmaster became aware of Thor's close ties with the Hulk and attentively continued watching the fight as Thor and Hulk furiously battled each other.
When Thor had managed to land a heavy blow against Hulk, he attempted to use Black Widow 's lullaby to calm him down, only for Hulk to smash Thor into the ground, much to Loki's delight. Grandmaster kept on watching as Thor and Hulk continued fighting, until Thor unexpectedly gained a sudden surge of his power, allowing his entire body to be engulfed with lightning as he struck Hulk and damaged his Sakaaran Battle Armor.
Unwilling to watch his beloved Champion be defeated, Grandmaster activated Thor's Obedience Disk, causing Thor to fall to the floor, allowing Hulk to finally win the duel. After the arena fight, Thor continued to be held captive by the Grandmaster, sharing room with Hulk. He would then hear news of Thor's escape. He then feared Thor had captured his beloved champion.

titulo: Grandmaster — Contest of Champions › Hunting Thor
texto:
Grandmaster then ordered a celebration of his champion to hopefully draw him out. Furious, Grandmaster ordered Scrapper 142 and Loki to find the two. The two come to blows when Loki started inquiring about the deaths of her fellow Valkyries. 142 would then assist Thor, holding Loki hostage as a sign of her allegiance.
Unbeknownst to Grandmaster, a certain group then liberated the other gladiators who, led by Korg and Miek, staged a revolt. Discovering the news of a revolution, Grandmaster questioned Topaz of how something of this scale could happen. He was then notified that the Obedience Disks had been deactivated. Grandmaster then ordered his troops to escape quickly.

titulo: Grandmaster — Contest of Champions › Revolution in Sakaar
texto:
Using a holographic projection, Grandmaster announced that Thor had escaped and ordered the people and his bodyguards to not let him leave the planet. Meanwhile, Thor used the Commodore to head to the Devil's Anus. Topaz and the Grandmaster's bodyguards swiftly chased them as they managed to avoid Grandmaster's guards and escape from Sakaar. Loki was soon found by the gladiators.
After the great uprising, Grandmaster was ultimately defeated by the people, and he confronted his subjects, who were still fighting the revolution started by the gladiators. Trying to set the record straight, Grandmaster claimed that the revolution was a tie, noting that he was an integral part of their uprising since without him, they would have nothing to rebel against.

titulo: Gravik — Early Life › Escaping the Kree
texto: When he was young, Gravik's parents were killed during the Destruction of Skrullos, but he managed to escape behind enemy lines and piloted a ship on his own, which he used to go to Earth. Once arriving on Earth, Gravik was found and aided by Varra, who brought him to Talos ' sanctuary for the surviving Skrulls who had been able to escape the Kree. Despite his grief, Gravik took comfort in believing that his parents had died well during the war.

titulo: Gravik — Secret Invasion › Returning Victorious
texto:
Back at New Skrullos, the Skrull crowd applauded Gravik for his efforts as he made his way through the compound. Kreega thanked Gravik and shook his hand, so Gravik said that it would not be possible without her. Gravik then told Pagon to continue their research involving the Harvest and walked away. Gravik then learned from the Skrull impersonating Derrik Weatherby that Brogan was being held at an FSB site disguised as a butcher shop.
Gravik found G'iah studying something on a computer, so he asked what she was doing. G'iah claimed to be checking Beto 's progress, commenting on his loyalty. Gravik told G'iah that he initially thought she had been sent to him by Talos to kill him before realizing Talos would not have done so. Gravik told G'iah that Brogan had been found and told her to join him in rescuing Brogan.

titulo: Gravik — Secret Invasion › Rescue of Brogan
texto:
Gravik went to the FSB black site where Brogan was held along with Pagon, G'iah, and Beto. Gravik and Pagon armed themselves, and Gravik told G'iah and Beto to wait in the car while he and Pagon rescued Brogan. The pair discretely entered the butcher shop before throwing flash bombs at the Russian authorities. They entered the kitchen area and started shooting, killing the guards. Once all the guards were killed, Pagon retrieved Brogan. Gravik stopped them before they could and asked what Brogan revealed, but Brogan insisted that he did not reveal anything. Gravik then found the open escape hatch in the room where Pagon was being held.
As G'iah drove the group toward their safe house, they found it surrounded by the authorities, so they were forced to keep driving. Gravik suspected Brogan of having revealed the location, so G'iah drove the car into the woods. Gravik handed Pagon a gun, which he used to bring Brogan into the woods and kill him. Pagon then returned the gun to Gravik, who looked to G'iah as they drove away.

titulo: Gravik — Secret Invasion › Council Invitation
texto: Gravik returned to New Skrullos and invited the Skrull Council to brief them on his plan for domination. He sent Pagon, Beto, and Zirksu to infiltrate the Royal Navy with the mission of destroying a United Nations plane in order plunge the world into war. He went to the Super Skrull Machine and examined the progress being made before the Council walked in. Gravik explained the plan regarding the United Nations' plane to the Council, revealing that he had created a way to give superpowers to Skrulls, calling them "Super Skrulls." He said that once the humans weakened each other, the Skrulls would attack, inviting the Council to the extinction of humanity. Gravik was turned into a Super Skrull, giving him powers beyond those of an average Skrull.

titulo: Gravik — Secret Invasion › Suspecting G'iah
texto:
Gravik began to suspect that G'iah was a mole, so he approached her and asked how Brogan could have revealed the location of the Skrulls ' safe house without knowing it. G'iah said that Brogan likely guessed due to the torture he endured, saying that Brogan was weaker than Gravik believed. Gravik then told G'iah that they would be leaving together early in the morning.
G'iah and Gravik then flew to England together, where G'iah drove Gravik to a meeting which had been set up between Gravik and Talos. Gravik told G'iah that they were going to talk about her and took a call, saying the details of their planned attack on a United Nations plane. G'iah then parked the car, and Gravik entered the National Portrait Gallery.

titulo: Gravik — Secret Invasion › Meeting with Talos
texto:
Gravik was joined by Talos, to whom he talked about the painting Statesmen of World War I highlighting that while statesmen posed for pictures, soldiers fought and died, claiming to prefer to have his story written blood rather than ink. Talos sarcastically called him brave, and the two sat down to meet. Talos asked Gravik to stop killing humans, and Gravik commented that he would be doing them both a favor by killing Talos. Talos suggested they duel, but Gravik said that it would not be right due to the power imbalance created by Gravik's position as General. Gravik mentioned G'iah being with him and teased him about her presence in New Skrullos, causing Talos to attack him. The rest of the Skrulls in the room revealed themselves, forcing Talos to stand down.
Talos threatened to reveal the existence of Skrulls to the public, which Gravik claimed would spell the extinction of the Skrulls. Gravik made another comment about G'iah, prompting Talos to stab his knife into Gravik's hand before walking away. Gravik pull his hand out from under the knife, and the Extremis powers given to him by the Super Skrull Machine allowed the wound to heal. Gravik left the museum and joined G'iah in the car.

titulo: Gravik — Secret Invasion › Confronting G'iah
texto:
As Gravik's plan to attack a United Nations plane was stopped, Gravik received word that G'iah had been the one to stop the attack. As G'iah attempted to flee, Gravik cut her off in his car. Gravik asked where G'iah was headed, so G'iah claimed to be retrieving their soldiers after what she referred to as a failed strike. However, Gravik explained that he did not fail, since although the plane was not attacked, he discovered that G'iah was the mole in the Skrull Resistance. He told G'iah to turn around while pointing a gun at her, but G'iah refused, wanting Gravik to look at her while he killed her. Gravik then shot her and drove away, leaving G'iah for dead.
As Gravik prepared his next attack, Pagon confronted Gravik about G'iah's absence, prompting Gravik to reveal that he had learned she was a mole and killed her. Gravik returned to preparing for the attack, telling the Skrulls to remember that their goal was for people to believe Russia was responsible for the attack.

titulo: Gravik — Secret Invasion › Attack on President Ritson
texto:
Gravik watched from a helicopter as United States President James Ritson was driven through England. Gravik ordered for a missile to be launched at the motorcade, and it was. The Skrulls then descended from the helicopter to engage in a firefight with the United States Secret Service. As the Skrulls started to dominate the battle, Nick Fury and Talos arrived, crashing the Skrulls' helicopter. Pagon told Gravik that Fury had arrived, causing Gravik to pause. He went into the fight and used his Flora colossi abilities granted to him when he became a Super Skrull to take out one of the Secret Service agents.
Gravik saw that Talos was attempting to get to Ritson, so Gravik ordered Pagon to take care of him. Pagon shot Talos while Gravik took cover. He saw Talos successfully break through the reinforced glass guarding Ritson and started going to where the President was. Gravik disguised himself as a Secret Service agent and told Fury to put Ritson in his car, but Fury refused, saying that he had his own ride. Gravik then went to Talos and pretended to be helping him get to Fury's car, but stopped in the middle of the fight when Fury saw them. Fury demanded Gravik release Talos, but Gravik instead revealed himself and killed Talos. Fury shot Gravik's face, but Gravik's Extremis abilities allowed him to heal. Pagon then arrived with a motorcycle and took Gravik away from the fight as reinforcements arrived.

titulo: Gravik — Secret Invasion › Setting a Trap
texto:
Pagon, Gravik, Beto, and Kreega returned to New Skrullos from the attack and exited the car together, returning to the facility. As they entered, Gravik ordered Kreega and another Skrull to assemble their operatives. At the meeting, Gravik expressed frustration that President Ritson was still alive, saying that their war would have been able to start had Pagon successfully stolen the Harvest. Pagon accused Gravik of wanting Nick Fury alive, so Gravik said that Fury had what they needed. Pagon demanded an explanation, saying that the Harvest not being in any of the locations indicated that Fury never trusted Gravik. Pagon suggested that the Skrulls should not trust Gravik, but Gravik interrupted Pagon by killing him. Gravik announced to the Skrulls that they were faceless and nameless soldiers and ordered the Skrulls to kill Varra, declaring her to be a traitor.
Gravik then called Raava, who said that she was going to the hospital to ensure their outcome was favorable. However, Gravik told Raava to keep Ritson alive and tell him that Russia and Skrulls were responsible for the attack and that the Skrulls needed to be killed. Gravik explained that the attack would provide leverage, since Fury did not want to see World War III or for innocent Skrulls to die. Raava asked what would happen if it did not go well, but Gravik simply stated that they would sacrifice themselves for their cause.

titulo: Gravik — Secret Invasion › Attacked by the Skrulls
texto:
Beto approached Gravik and asked about Pagon, saying that he was confused since Pagon was loyal to their cause. Gravik claimed that Pagon had failed them and received a call from Raava, confirming that James Ritson was out of surgery and promising to send confirmation of the strike once Ritson launched it. Gravik threatened Raava and the two hung up when the Skrulls in New Skrullos ambushed Gravik. Beto held a plastic bag over Gravik's face, attempting to suffocate him. Gravik fought free of the Skrulls, who continued trying to hold him down. Several Skrulls held Gravik on a table and beat him while Beto held the plastic over his face, but Gravik channeled Cull Obsidian 's strength to overpower them and kill several Skrulls.
Zirksu attempted to stab Gravik, but Gravik grabbed his arm and stabbed Zirksu in the neck, killing him. Gravik maanged to right himself and punched Beto down, screaming. Gravik defeated another Skrull before approaching Beto and throwing him out of the door, frightening the other Skrulls outside the room. Gravik joined the Skrulls and boasted loudly before grabbing Beto by his jacket. Beto called Gravik a monster, so Gravik slit Beto's throat and looked to his people.

titulo: Gravik — Secret Invasion › Obtaining the Harvest
texto:
Gravik called Nick Fury and offered him to call his attack off if Fury delivered the Harvest. Fury asked what attack he was referring to, so Gravik explained his plan to have U.S. President James Ritson bomb New Skrullos. He told Fury to bring iodide pills to combat the radiation before hanging up.
Fury approached Gravik and asked where the rest of the Skrulls were, so Gravik said they were hiding. Fury struggled to take iodide pills and dropped them into a grate, so Gravik stomped them down and mocked him, giving him a drink and toasting to his last stand. Gravik mocked Fury about his radiation poisoning killing him, asking if he had the Avengers ready as a backup plan. Fury simply commented that Gravik was busy using human skin as a costume, but Gravik reminded Fury that he was disguised as the first human Fury ordered him to kill. Gravik scolded Fury for having him kill people, claiming that he became colder with each kill. He insisted that Talos was weak, blaming him for the Skrulls' thirty years of exile.
Gravik became angry, saying that he would kill Fury, followed by the rest of humanity, blaming Fury for his actions. He told Fury that he should have kept his promise, and Fury agreed, confessing that he gave up searching for a home for the Skrulls after a few years and that he hoped to build them a home on Earth. Gravik asked why he did not do that, so Fury explained that it was easier to save lives than to change their minds. Fury said that the last thing he felt before dying in the Snap was relief that he no longer had to fight, agreeing that he was not brave. Fury said that he returned to Earth because he felt responsible for not teaching Gravik well enough. Fury said that since he failed the Skrulls, he wanted to give Gravik what he wanted, offering to hand over the Harvest in exchange for him invading a different planet.
Gravik took the Harvest and checking it while Fury had a coughing fit. Satisfied that the Harvest was pure, Gravik commented on Fury's desire to die. Gravik then activated the Super Skrull Machine with himself and Fury inside, granting him abilities from every individual who bled in the Battle of Earth. Gravik admired his new strength as Fury righted himself and punched Fury to the ground. Gravik went to punch Fury, who caught the punch and used strength gained from the Harvest to punch Gravik out of the building. Fury followed Gravik and revealed himself to have been G'iah the entire conversation.

titulo: Gravik — Early Life › Nick Fury's Promise
texto:
Seeking to find him a new purpose in the wake of his parent's deaths, Varra brought Gravik to a meeting organized by Nick Fury and Talos. Varra introduced Gravik to Fury, who attempted to greet Gravik. However, the young boy stepped back, prompting Varra to pull Fury aside and tell him about his parents. Fury returned and offered his condolences about Gravik's parents, so Gravik commented that they died a good death.
Fury warned Gravik that their work was dangerous, but Gravik said that he was not afraid. Fury said that he could see that, as they exchanged a touching of foreheads, a sign of respect amongst the Skrulls, and Gravik joined the crowd of Skrulls. Gravik stood by Varra and watched as Talos discussed their losses since losing Skrullos and Fury promised to find the Skrulls a new home in exchange for them acting as his spy network.
As Fury asked the Skrulls to live as Humans while he and Carol Danvers searched for their new home, Gravik had then watched Soren be the first Skrull to agree to Fury's request, but looked away as Soren's daughter, G'iah, turned to face him. The rest of the Skrulls agreed to Fury and Talos' request, and Fury assured them that he would keep his word, turning to Gravik as he did so, who took Fury's promise to them all seriously.

titulo: Gravik — Secret Invasion › Duel at New Skrullos
texto:
G'iah called Gravik weak and charged at him, so Gravik threw a car at G'iah. G'iah avoided the car, so Gravik used his enhanced strength to attack G'iah, who countered with an ice blade she had summoned. G'iah stabbed Gravik into a dumpster, so Gravik used Ebony Maw 's abilities to attack her with a large slab of concrete, hitting her into the ground and a crane and kicking her through a wall.
The pair summoned Captain Marvel 's abilities and flew into the air, struggling against each other as they flew toward the ground. Gravik started choking G'iah, but she used Mantis ' abilities to make Gravik fall asleep and crash onto the ground. Gravik recovered and fired several blasts at G'iah, who dodged them and landed on the ground. G'iah punched Gravik several times and started choking him, and Gravik taunted G'iah by comparing her to Talos and humans. However, G'iah blasted a hole in Gravik's chest, killing him as he fell to the ground.

titulo: Gravik — Legacy › Anti-Skrull Sentiments
texto: Gravik's failed plan resulted in U.S. President James Ritson declaring all species not born on Earth to be enemy combatants, causing raised stakes as humans started attacking Skrulls and people they suspected of being Skrulls.

titulo: Gravik — Early Life › Nick Fury's Hitman
texto: Gravik was assigned to kill a man who had a wife and kids as his first mission for Nick Fury when he was still young. Wanting to impress Fury, who he considered a hero, Gravik finished the mission. Having killed a man with a family, Gravik became more ruthless, and continued to become colder as Fury ordered him to kill more people.

titulo: Gravik — Early Life › Collecting Avengers DNA
texto: Nick Fury discovered that most Avengers, including Carol Danvers, had spilled their blood during the Battle of Earth. Knowing that all of the superhuman DNA would be dangerous if acquired by other parties, Fury sent in a team of Skrulls led by Gravik to collect the DNA for him, which was then consolidated into a single vial known as the Harvest and hidden in an undisclosed location.

titulo: Gravik — Rising Tensions › Joining the Skrull Council
texto:
Shortly after the Blip, Fury could not bring himself to address any of the Skrulls ' concerns and instead chose to leave Earth and relocate to outer space, having taken a job from S.A.B.E.R. to build up their space station. Angered at Fury's abandonment, Gravik took over an abandoned nuclear facility in Russia and renamed it as New Skrullos, which he presented to the Skrulls as a safe haven.
In order to get revenge on Nick Fury for leaving him, Gravik convinced the Skrulls to forcibly seize Earth for themselves as their new home planet by eradicating humanity, Gravik initiated the Secret Invasion, where Skrulls would kidnap humans of high rank or importance and then impersonate them. Additionally, Gravik took advantage of the rage and anger possessed by displaced Skrulls to form the Skrull Resistance, who were willing to serve as killers and field operators. With this newfound stature as a leader, Gravik was elected to the Skrull Council, who chose to participate in the Secret Invasion and stripped Talos of his rank as General for failing to secure them a home.

titulo: Gravik — Rising Tensions › Plans for War
texto: Wanting humanity to be eliminated, Gravik decided that World War III was the solution, and planned to spark a nuclear conflict between Russia and the United States using false flag attacks. To this extent, Gravik arranged for Americans Against Russia to be formed, with memberships comprised of American humans who could be kidnapped and impersonated so that the Skrull Resistance could attack Russia and have their terrorism publicly seen as the actions of Americans. In order to acquire a dirty bomb, Gravik led a raid on a weapons cache in Kazakhstan and later that day learned that a CIA agent named Donald Prescod had discovered the plans. He then sent a Skrull to retrieve the plans and kill Donald Prescod, though the Skrull he sent was intercepted and killed by Talos and Maria Hill.

titulo: Gravik — Secret Invasion › Nick Fury's Return
texto: Gravik oversaw Brogan 's impersonation of Martin Wallace. Later that day, Pagon approached Gravik and told him that Nick Fury had returned to Earth, but that their spy told him he was too out of shape to be a threat. Pagon commented that they were keeping the information private, and Gravik challenged whether Pagon saw it as protecting Gravik as the cause. He explained that the cause was home, which Pagon agreed to. He resolved to leave the next day and not stop until they had Earth.

titulo: Gravik — Secret Invasion › Unity Day Bombing
texto: Gravik went to Vossoyedineniye Square the next day and confronted Nick Fury, leading him through the crowd using all the forms his spies had taken since his return to Earth, which Fury recognized from seeing them. Gravik then showed the form Fury recognized as he activated the bombs, causing panic at the festival. Gravik took advantage of the panic and impersonated Fury, shooting Maria Hill in the chest. As Hill fell, Gravik aimed his gun at Hill, then at Fury. Another bomb exploded, so Gravik changed his form back and left, smiling at Fury. He was joined by G'iah, and the two calmly left the square together.

titulo: Gravik — Secret Invasion › Meeting with the Council
texto:
G'iah drove Gravik toward their meeting with the Skrull Council, but Gravik explained that it was more hope, wanting to see what was left of Fury. He claimed that Fury was simply old, and that he could have killed him but did not want to give Fury what he wanted. He told G'iah to get him to the Council meeting as he wanted to see their reactions in the immediate aftermath of the attack. Gravik entered the meeting and saw that G'iah was denied entry. Gravik gave G'iah his gun and told G'iah to kill the guard if he did not return to her within an hour.
Gravik entered the meeting, where he greeted the Council. The Skrull impersonating Sergio Caspani commented on Gravik's attire, but Gravik countered by pointing out that he was not invited to the meeting before personally greeting the Skru lls impersonating Pamela Lawton and Shirley Sagar. "Sagar" greeted Gravik, telling him to sit. Gravik sat and commented on the Skrulls acting humans, saying that he preferred dogs due to their loyalty and lack of harmful actions toward each and their habitat. "Caspani" said that his reading of human history was naïve, but Gravik said that it was the only correct reading.
"Sagar" started talking about the purpose of the meeting, saying that they needed to determine how to punish Gravik for the bombing and endangering Skrulls. Gravik reminded the Council of Fury breaking his promise to find them a new home, promising to take Earth and make it their home. Gravik insisted that they were at war with humans, refusing to lose it. He said that humans were destined to destroy themselves, assuring the Council that they were hastening what he deemed inevitable. "Caspani" asked what would happen if the Avengers were to return, but Gravik said he had a contingency plan for that. He turned to "Lawton," who nominated Gravik to be the new Skrull general. The Council all agreed except "Sagar," who scolded the rest of siding with Gravik, reminding them that the whole reason they had lost their planet and became homeless was because the Skrulls had been too willing to wage a war. Gravik complimented "Sagar" on staying unwavering in her beliefs and allowed her to leave peacefully. Gravik left the meeting and G'iah returned his gun as he exited the building.
