titulo: Jessica Jones — Saving New York › Final Battle at Midland Circle
texto:
The Defenders used the elevator to head down to the cave to face the Hand. As Daredevil suggested using Jones as a distraction. When the elevator arrived at the bottom, Jones greeted the Hand alone and provided Daredevil and Luke Cage an opportunity to ambush the Hand. During the fight, Jones rescued Iron Fist and helped him get back to the team. With the Defenders reunited, the team went and fought against the Hand, who is now led by Elektra, who had killed Alexandra Reid and usurped her position.
Jones and the Defenders defeated the majority of the Hand. When only Elektra remained, they defeated her and began retreating. Daredevil chose to stay behind to try and save her despite Jones' protest. As they escaped on the elevator, they were followed by the surviving Hand members led by Murakami. Another battle ensued as the remaining Defender fought off the Hand. During the battle, the elevator was damaged. Fortunately, Jones saved Cage and Rand by jumping and grabbing the broken cable, holding the elevator with her super-strength.
They managed to return to the surface and reunited with their remaining allies. They made their escape from Midland Circle just in time before the bomb exploded and level the building. Jones returned to the precinct to reunite with Trish Walker and Malcolm Ducasse. The remaining Defenders mourned for their fallen teammate.

titulo: Jessica Jones — Reopening Alias Investigations › Daredevil's Sacrifice
texto: Days after the final battle, Jones asked Walker to make sure that no one knew about their heroics. Taking Murdock's apparent death hard, Jones returned to the bar to drown her sorrows. Cage went to meet her. The former couple talked through their issues and about what happened beneath Midland Circle. Cage assured Jones that she had friends and that he was one of them. Jones returned home and found Ducasse fixing the place. With her determination reignited, Jones reopened Alias Investigations to continue her work and help people.

titulo: Jessica Jones — Reopening Alias Investigations › Back to Work
texto:
In 2017, Jones accepted another job, taking photos of a pizza delivery man, Rafi, hooking up with a woman ordering pizza. Jones later met with her client Mavis at Slice City and showed her the pictures. Just as Mavis was about to pay Jones, Rafi walked in, and Mavis offered Jones triple her fee if she would murder him. Jones informed Rafi of Mavis' request, and he ran out of the store while Mavis asked her why she told him. She cited that Jones already killed someone, a fact she heard on Trish Talk, which infuriated Jones. Showing restraint, she told Mavis that she was not a murderer and left, although not before taking a box of pizza.
Jones met Trish Walker in a private auditorium while being stalked by an unknown figure. Jones talked about the annoying clientele she had been getting lately after what happened with Kilgrave, as people now viewed her as some sort of vigilante, and that Walker was escalating the situation by discussing it on Trish Talk. Walker said she should face what happened and pulled out the file. She said Jones was not assigned a hospital bed until 20 days after her family's car accident, and speculated it was due to IGH experimenting on her. Walker encouraged her to investigate IGH more, as knowing what IGH did to her might help her.
Malcolm Ducasse woke Jones up in her apartment and they met with new potential clients. One of them wanted to find her son, whom she put up for adoption years ago, one of them was concerned about lizards taking over, and the other claimed that someone was trying to kill him because he had super-speed powers, and was called "the Whizzer." Ducasse wanted to take the adopted son case, but Jones was concerned it would just attract more sob-stories. Ducasse wrote down what she said, but Jones said it wasn't a lesson.

titulo: Jessica Jones — Reopening Alias Investigations › Jones v. Cheng
texto:
They met with another client, Pryce Cheng, who desired to absorb Alias Investigations and hire Jones. Jones refused, saying he just wanted to eliminate her competition, which he didn't deny, and he said that if she didn't accept his offer, he would run her out of business. Cheng left, and Jones attempted to follow him, but was stopped by a large fridge, which was getting to be moved into an apartment for new residents Oscar Arocho, and his son, Vido. She moved the fridge with her super-strength when Arocho was having trouble lifting it, much to Vido's awe.
Jones took pictures of Cheng meeting with clients, hoping to dig up dirt on him, but he noticed her. Ducasse was fixing up the Alias Investigations Office, while Walker waited with him for Jones. When Jones arrived, Walker said she found something of hers, and placed a box on Jones' desk. Jones was angry, and when Ducasse asked why, she said the box contained her family's ashes.
After drinking to her family's ashes, Jones woke up at her desk the next morning with Malcolm in her kitchen, who gave her a package from Cheng Consulting that a messenger dropped off. She answered a knock at the door, only to find Whizzer, who was spouting more tales about people trying to kill him, and she shut the door in his face. Jones examined the message from Cheng, which contained all info on him, and read, "I am an open book." They also found that a potential client had hired Cheng instead.
Jones visited Cheng and his client from before, and returned his missing dog. Jones said she found his dog, Felipe, at his ex-wife's boyfriend's place. Cheng's client was angry at him, because Cheng went to look there already. Cheng defended himself, saying the boyfriend wouldn't let him in. Jones told the client she would go to lengths, Cheng wouldn't and handed him her card as he left.
Cheng get in her way when she attempted to leave, and provoked her. She knocked him to the floor and warned him to stay away from her and her clients when he pulled out a taser. It had no effect on her, and she threw him through a glass door. She was going to push him more, but backed away, and Cheng called her "the weakest human being [he has] ever met." She was restrained by security as Cheng's co-workers called the police.
Later, at a courthouse, Jones was released after Walker bailed her out. She was also court-ordered to take anger management classes, and had to pay property damage. Walker and Jones talked about facing her past and IGH. Jones said she thought facing it would make her worse, as she had already killed someone. Walker and her boyfriend, Griffin Sinclair, left for a charity gala. Jones was attacked by Whizzer from behind while entering her apartment, and she threw him to the floor. He pulled out a gun on her and insisted that someone "like us" was trying to kill him, and wanted Jessica to protect him. He revealed he was on medication, and while Jones thought it was because he was psychotic, he said it was to repress his powers. Jones attacked him so he would drop the gun, and he exhibited super speed as he ran throughout the room. He threw a box containing her brother 's ashes at her, and they flew throughout the room when she deflected the box with her arm.

titulo: Jessica Jones — Reopening Alias Investigations › Chasing Whizzer
texto: Jones chased Whizzer into the street, where he once again demonstrated super speed. A pile of scaffolding fell on him and Whizzer was impaled by a piece of metal. Across the street, Oscar Arocho shielded his son 's eyes from the horrific sight.

titulo: Jessica Jones — Digging Up the Past › Looking for Answers
texto:
That night, Jones was sitting in her office with her brother's ashes still scattered in the floor. Ducasse entered and cleaned the ashes up with a piece of paper. They discussed Whizzer's death, and how Jessica believed it was the work of another powered person. Jones looked through Whizzer's bag that he left there, and found a pill bottle. There was no prescribing doctor, but there was a manufacturer, "Salento." They found Salento's local distributor, and Jones visited the place where they shipped the pills. Inside, Jones found an experimental clinic, and had flashes of memories of when she was experimented on there, including a memory of being attacked by another person. Jones then vowed to open the door into her past.
Jones drank heavily at a bar. She called for multiple shots of whiskey, and attempted to call Trish Walker about her discoveries. Her boyfriend Griffin Sinclair, who was next to her in bed at the time, answered instead, not wanting to wake Walker. He commented on the late hour, and asked Jones to put off the call until morning, and Jones ended the call. She started to leave the bar when a man commented on her ass. She turned around, and the two of them had sex in the bar's bathroom. After the man discovered her powers, he called her a freak and she made him leave.
Jones arrived at Kozlov 's home only to find he had died in a "freak car accident." She entered inside the home to find friends and family attending a mourning. Jones investigated Kozlov's office, noticing Will Simpson in a picture with Kozlov and several other soldiers. Isaiah, a soldier and patient of the deceased Kozlov, entered the room in his wheelchair, stumbling across Jones studying the picture. He took out a baton and demanded who she was working for. Jones was initially hesitant to attack someone in a wheelchair, but Isaiah used her hesitation to attack her, knocking Jones to the floor. She got up and pushed him out of his wheelchair, and the two discussed Kozlov's mysterious death. Both of them thought it wasn't an accident, and he revealed Simpson to be alive, and blamed him for the murder.
Jones went snooping around Whizzer 's apartment hoping to find clues about who was trying to kill him. She trapped his hostile pet mongoose Emil in the bathroom, and found his laptop with a video on it. Jones watched the video, where he described his situation and how he got his powers, explained how he believed his powers were killing him, and how powers could cause mental illness. The NYPD arrived and attempted to get into his apartment. They didn't see her, and she escaped through the window with the computer, letting Emil loose as a distraction. Jones walked to the door of her apartment, and passed her superintendent. Jones asked him why he lied to the police before. He said that he was currently fighting for custody for his son, and getting involved in her "superpower business" would only make things more complicated, something he didn't want for his child.

titulo: Jessica Jones — Digging Up the Past › Return to IGH
texto:
Jones realized that Walker was the connection and left her a voicemail when she didn't pick up. Jones went to Walker's apartment to talk, but Sinclair answered the door instead, saying he didn't know where Walker was. Jones looked into Walker's office and found her files on the floor. Jones looked through them and found crime scene photos from her family's car accident, and her father 's death certificate. Sinclair said he wanted to know what she was working on, but found nothing he understood, and let it slip that Walker and her mother had brunch that morning. Jones called Dorothy, asking where Walker was and what they talked about at brunch, but Dorothy ignored her questions and disconnected the call.
Jones arrived at the Brooklyn movie set, which had closed for the night, and followed a trail of blood to an empty stage, where Walker had tied up a bleeding Will Simpson. Walker showed Jones some drugs she had found on him, commenting on how they were like the pills he had taken before, as they kept him from feeling pain. Jones accused him of killing Whizzer and Dr. Kozlov, but he denied, saying the new drugs he was taking permitted him from losing control like before, and that he only wanted to protect Walker from IGH.
The lights suddenly went out, and Simpson warned them that the assailant was here. He told Jones to take Walker and run. Jones untied his bonds, and Walker gave Simpson her gun, and he struggled to run with his limp in the opposite direction of Walker and Jones. The two women hurried towards an exit and heard Simpson shouting far away. They ran into a shadowy figure, who leapt into the air above them, and exited through a stage door behind them. Jones remarked that they weren't after Walker. They ran and found Simpson dead on the floor with his neck snapped.
Jones and Trish Walker visited a beach vacation spot Jones used to go to with her family to dump Will Simpson's body out at sea. Walker was disappointed that he didn't get a proper funeral, but Jones pointed out that the police had already found her with too many bodies. They prepared to abandon Simpson's stolen car and remove the evidence. Walker found an arsenal of guns and the special drug he always took in the trunk. Jones wanted to dump them, too, but Walker insisted on keeping it. Jessica was returning to her apartment when Malcolm Ducasse approached her about an eviction notice from her landlord. Apparently, it was illegal to run a business out of a living space, which was what Jones went by running Alias Investigations out of her apartment. Jessica suspected who might be behind it, and went to her neighbor Arocho's apartment. Arocho didn't deny her claim, and said it was for the best as she would only bring trouble to the building, saying she had thirty days left before she had to move out.
Jones was working at her office and posted pictures from Walker's files on the walls all around the room while drinking a bottle of whiskey. She suddenly woke in her bed with an IV of whiskey strapped into her and ashes falling from the ceiling. She got up and went to find her front door having been replaced by a hospital door resembling a door from the clinic she saw in the pictures. She was about to open it when once again the red, meaty figure attacked her from behind, and she woke up with Ducasse knocking on her door.

titulo: Jessica Jones — College Years › Relationship with Stirling Adams
texto: By 2005, Jones enrolled in college, paid by Trish Walker against Jones' desires. One night at a bar, Jessica Jones met bartender Stirling Adams, who flirted with her. Later, he called Jessica and asked if she would like to join him for a whiskey. Eventually, they started dating. She dropped out and moved in with Adams who hoped to open his own place called "Club Alias," while Jones used her strength for the occasional shoplifting, including her signature leather jacket, and stealing from automatic teller machines to support herself. Over the next month, she started to drift apart from Walker as she continued to abuse alcohol and drugs, helped by her sister continuing in the artistic life by attempting to become a singer. After Stirling was murdered by someone who repeatedly bashed his head against a wall, Jones decided to go after Walker, and found her about to have sex with Gus before Jones beat him up.

titulo: Jessica Jones — Digging Up the Past › Investigating Leslie Hansen
texto:
Jones and Malcolm Ducasse conversed in her office, where he revealed that he had done research on Oscar and found out that he served time for forgery, meaning he was an ex-con. After Ducasse made a comment about how good the old superintendent was, Jones realized that Arocho must have had something on the landlord, asking Malcolm to find out what it was. Jessica visited the IGH Clinic and went through the door she saw in her dream, but only discovered the name " Leslie Hansen " on the door, with nothing useful inside. She and Walker went to Leslie Hansen's apartment, only to find it empty. However, a man told them that he saw someone taking boxes from the apartment down to the basement the week before. Trish and Jessica went down to the basement, finding that it smelled horrible. They found that the furnace had been recently used, thinking that Leslie had burned all the evidence about IHG. However, Jones soon managed to find a human skull in the furnace.
Jones was inverted to a bar to meet Leslie Hansen. At the bar, "Hansen" defended IGH as heroes, saying that they brought Jessica back from the dead, since she died on the table. "Hansen" claimed that IGH was merely trying to save lives and that the powers were merely a side effect. Jessica said that they should have let her die with her family, which angered Leslie, who said that she should be incredibly thankful to them and that she survived for a reason. Jessica said that, if she did survive for a reason, it was so she could take down Leslie and IGH. Hansen made a run for it, and Jessica attempted to stop her with her powers. However, "Hansen" suddenly displayed similar powers, knocking Jessica across the room and through a wall with incredible strength. When Jessica recovered, she saw "Hansen" jump across the street to the top of a building across the street. Jessica didn't try to follow her, but instead took a photographer's camera, which managed to take several photos of the fake Hansen.

titulo: Jessica Jones — Digging Up the Past › Anger Management
texto:
Jones was forced to partake in an anger management class after she attacked Pryce Cheng. The people attending the class told their stories while bouncing a rubber ball against the wall. Jones asked the head of the class to sign her court order, but he said that she had to stay the full hour, encouraging her to talk with the class. She got up and bounced the ball against the wall while telling the story of how her family was killed in a car accident, how she was experimented on, how she was abducted and raped, and how she was forced to kill someone. She ended by bouncing the ball so hard against the wall that it created a dent, causing pieces of the wall to fly across the room. The man fearfully signed the court order before Jones left.
Jones returned to her office and got angry at Malcolm Ducasse for letting Trish Walker get out of her apartment the night before, as the press, who had obtained photos of Walker and Ducasse together, was now calling Malcolm Trish's new boyfriend. Jessica looked at the photos of the fake Hansen and tried to find something, but found it hard to concentrate, as Oscar Arocho and his ex-wife were arguing above her. Despite this, Jessica noticed she was wearing a wig. Jessica called Trish, who was having to deal with the aftermath of the previous night with the press. She asked Trish about wigs, saying the woman was wearing one. Trish said that it was a good wig, since she didn't notice, and speculated that it was made of human hair, which narrowed down their search, as there were only three human hair wig shops in NYC. Jessica agreed to meet Trish at one of them before hanging up.

titulo: Jessica Jones — Digging Up the Past › Falling in Love
texto:
Oscar Arocho 's son Vido entered Jones' office, not wanting to be around his arguing parents. He questioned Jones about her powers while Jones yelled down the hallway to Vido's parents that he was in her apartment when they started looking for him. He crouched on the outside of her window ledge and asked if she could save him if he fell. She yelled at him to get off, but he fell anyway. Jones managed to pull him up just as his parents arrived. His mother was angry, seeing it as another reason for her to have custody of Vido, and dragged her son away. Arocho angrily told Jones that she had 25 days left before she was evicted before running after them.
Jessica and Trish met up at the wig place, where Trish had to pay the owner, Sally, three hundred dollars to give them info on the woman when the owner confirmed the woman was a customer of her store. Sally told them that the woman came in alone, paid in cash, and had lost all her hair, probably to chemotherapy. Jessica speculated that she probably had cancer and that IGH had saved her. She also said that, if they found her though Metro-General, IGH was probably paying her medical bills, so they needed her hospital records.
Trish showed Jessica the video Malcolm took of her and Max Tatum, saying they could use it as leverage against him and use his clearance at the hospital to get the records. Jessica pointed out that her threats wouldn't hold much water, as Trish gave Max two days and it had been three. Planning on blackmailing him more, Trish and Jessica headed off to his movie set. Trish and Jessica showed a young actress currently starring in Max's film the video of Trish being sexually assaulted by Max, causing her to quit, much to Max's dismay. The two confronted him at his car and, after Jessica threatened him with her powers, he agreed to give them his clearance at Metro-General.
Upon returning home, Jones was met by Arocho, who apologized to her, saying that Vido told him what had happened and that he couldn't express how grateful he was that she had saved his son's life. He said he has dropped her eviction and left her with a bottle of whiskey, but she invited him to drink with her inside. Arocho and Jones shared the whiskey on her couch and discussed her powers. He admitted that he didn't hate people like her, he just hated her in particular. She admitted what it was like to be an outcast and they bonded. Jones started to kiss him and attempted to unzip his pants, but Oscar backed out, saying that things were moving too fast and that the situation was not normal before leaving.
Jones left her apartment the next day and headed for the elevator when Malcolm approached her in the hallway. He told her about how Cheng offered him a place at his firm in exchange for info on her. He told her that he had said no, but that he still wanted more to do at Alias Investigations, demanding 25% of the cases that come in. Jones agreed to give him 20% before leaving. He then went back to his apartment and mixed up the name of one of the girls he met on a dating app.

titulo: Jessica Jones — Digging Up the Past › Meeting Nurse Green
texto:
Jones and Trish Walker asked around the neighborhood and found a man who told them which building Inez Green lived in. Jessica went upstairs to draw her out while Walker waited downstairs with a taser to ambush her. Jones was attacked by Green from behind, but was able to defend herself. Trish, hearing her shouts, took the drugs Will Simpson was using and ran upstairs with her taser before knocking Green out. However, they quickly discovered that she wasn't the woman they were looking for.
Jessica and Trish went to Jessica's apartment with Inez Green in the backseat. Jessica got out of the car to find the New York City Police Department outside her building. Malcolm Ducasse told her to run, as they thought she had killed Nick Spanos, but the police saw her and arrested her for the murder of Pryce Cheng 's friend.

titulo: Jessica Jones — Family Reunion › Mistakenly Arrested for Murder
texto:
Following her arrest, Jones paced back and forth inside her cell, punching the wall in anger. She was taken into an interrogation room, where she received counsel from Jeri Hogarth. The police suspected that she was keeping something from them and decided to hold her. She later learned from Malcolm Ducasse that all her files had been taken. Ducasse believed that Pryce Cheng must have been casing Jones' apartment when he came to recruit him. She then asked that Ducasse find out everything that Inez Green knew about her former employers and her co-worker who suddenly left the company. Jones then left Ducasse in charge of Alias Investigations while she was away.
Jones and Hogarth agreed to make a statement, but she required her phone, as it had a photo of Nick Spanos and Whizzer 's actual killer. Jones went on to explain that the woman who had killed them had abilities that far surpassed her own and that she and Whizzer were both patients at an off-the-grid experimental program called IGH that tried to heal people using genetic editing, although there were side effects. After giving her statement, Jones and Hogarth remained in the interrogation room while the detectives processed what they had just learned. Detectives Eddy Costa and Ruth Sunday returned after running the photo of the mystery woman, though they did not turn up anything. Fortunately, Costa believed Jones after finding a couple stills that were taken from a network of security cameras in the surrounding area that were taken just before Spanos’ death. Given her cooperation, Jones was released. Detective Costa then proposed an alliance of sorts, as he and several others still remembered what Kilgrave had done in the precinct and were grateful to Jones for taking him out.

titulo: Jessica Jones — Investigating Karl Malus › Investigating Octopuses
texto:
When Jones got home, she was called by Griffin Sinclair, who told her that Trish Walker was in trouble. Jones rushed to the location only to find Sinclair was lying and he was just getting Jones there to see him propose to Walker, who said yes. Jones talked with Walker afterwards and was happy for her sister. Later, Jones talked to Inez Green, who told her that David Kawecki was framed for a doctor's murder. Jones asked Oscar Arocho for a favor: to create a fake ID for her. She then took that ID and infiltrated a psychiatric prison where she found Kawecki, who was mentally challenged and incapable of murder.
She talked to him some more until he told her about his friend, Karl Malus, who loved watching the octopuses at the aquarium. Jones went to said aquarium and found Malus there. The woman who went by Leslie Hansen was also there. The two kissed while Jones took pictures. The woman then saw Jones and proceeded to punch the aquarium glass, releasing the water. Jones ran out of the aquarium only to find that her phone got wet.

titulo: Jessica Jones — Investigating Karl Malus › Talking with Justis Ambrose
texto:
Jessica Jones went back to her apartment and put her phone in rice. She then heard Oscar Arocho 's loud music and went downstairs to get him to turn it down. He apologized, not realizing how loud it was. She walked in and talked about his bad day before they started kissing. She accidentally knocked over purple paint that he had lying out. She went to pick it up, but Arocho kept kissing her, the two of them fell into the paint and had sex. The next day, Jones woke up to find Arocho painting a picture of her sleeping. She left quickly and she was worried about getting into a relationship.
Along with Trish Walker, Jones went to a pawn shop across the street from the aquarium to find security footage of the flood. Jones immediately noticed Walker's sunglasses and realized she took some drug, but did not push further because she had broken up with Griffin Sinclair. The man was very stubborn, but only because he was not a citizen and did not want to get deported. They convinced him to show Jones the footage. There, she saw Malus and the woman right after the incident. Malus drugged the woman and put her in his car before driving away.
With her phone finally dried out, she looked at the pictures and found a wedding ring on Malus' finger; however, Malcolm Ducasse told her it was not a wedding ring, but a university ring from his old college. Jones tasked Ducasse with finding more information. Meanwhile, Walker and she found a man named Justis Ambrose who gave financial aid to Malus for years. They visited him at a golf course only to be denied entry due to their gender. Walker distracted the men while Jones infiltrated the golf course to find Ambrose.
The two talked, but Ambrose did not believe her allegations against Malus because Malus saved his son from a facial disease. Failing, the two returned to their apartment, but Walker grew sick. Jones wanted to stay by her bed, but Walker told her it was fine. Jones then found Ambrose's son and facetimed Ambrose, threatening the son until Ambrose gave her a location. With this, she went to the Malus Residence and looked around. She found many weird items, but eventually locked her eyes on a photo, which was of herself and her brother, Phillip Jones. Shaken up, she turned around to see the woman, Leslie Hansen. However, the woman revealed to Jones that she was her mother and survived the crash. Jessica sat through a story that her mother told her about what happened after the crash, including that she killed Stirling Adams. Jessica punched her in retaliation before being seduced by Malus.

titulo: Jessica Jones — Investigating Karl Malus › Joining Her Mother
texto:
Jessice woke up restrained to a bed. Karl Malus talked to her about his life with Alisa Jones, but Jessica did not want to hear it. Suddenly, Trish Walker called and Malus let Jessica answer as to not cause suspicion. Jessica diverged Walker away from Malus. She then convinced Malus to break her free so she could help him. When he complied, she turned on Malus and grabbed him by the shirt, only to hear Alisa making breakfast above. She then pushed Malus out the door and held it shut as she texted a picture of the address and sent it to Eddy Costa.
Alisa barged in and attacked Jessica, pinning her to the wall. She then told Malus to run so that he could get away. After slight arguing, he did so. Alisa then gave herself up and decided to wait for the police. While waiting, Alisa and Jessica remarked certain stories from the past before Jessica finally understood it was truly her mother. Jessica then packed a bag with Alisa's restraints, and they broke out just before the police arrived.
They took a cab back to Jessica's apartment, but the driver was texting, causing Alisa to almost lash out at him. Jessica had him stop the car so they could get out before anything bad happened. They got back to their apartment, but Costa arrived having found nothing at the location. She escorted them out after giving information and walked back to find Alisa with Oscar Arocho. Jessica got Alisa inside and talked to Arocho, who asked if she liked the painting. She told him she did. She then talked to Alisa who explained that she escaped into the stairwell to avoid the cops, but found Arocho.

titulo: Jessica Jones — Investigating Karl Malus › Stopping Pryce Cheng
texto:
While talking with her mother in her apartment, Jones was shot by Pryce Cheng from across the street in a neighboring building, though she was not the intended target. It was in fact Alisa that Pryce was after. After failing to kill Alisa, Pryce made a run for it, but he is cut off in the stairwell by Alisa and Jones. Alisa caught up to him on the steps, disarmed him, and threw him up against the wall. Jones exclaimed "mom," to gain her mother's attention and keep her from killing Pryce, who then reached for his gun. However, before he could use it, Jones injected him with a syringe filled with tranquilizer, that rendered Pryce unconscious.
After capturing Pryce, Jones put him in her bathtub and taped his hands and feet. She then took his phone and broke it. The following night, when Pryce finally woke, Jones asked if he remembered trying to kill them. He replied that he was only trying to kill Alisa. Jones then cut him free and took him into a room. She informed him that he could go away for attempted murder. Or they could overlook her kidnapping him and go their separate ways. Once she reminded him that he also shot her, he agreed to her terms. However, he can't look the other way in Alisa's case, as she's a dangerous killer. Pryce convinced Jones that her mother had to be stopped. And so, Jones called detective Eddy Costa and reported her mother. Unbeknownst to Jones, Alisa had been listening in. She broke the door down, knocking Jones to the ground and attacked Pryce. Jones held her mom back long enough for Pryce to make it out the apartment, though physically, she was outmatched. She was beaten to the ground and was only spared when she reminded Alisa of who she was. Alisa then continued her purist of Pryce, however, by the time she made it outside, he was long gone, and NYPD were locked on her, guns drawn.

titulo: Jessica Jones — Investigating Karl Malus › Finding Vido Arocho
texto:
Jones learned from Arocho that Sonia took Vido. When Sonia didn't pick up her phone, Arocho stopped by her place, where her neighbor informed him that Sonia and Vido left with big suitcases. She'd been wanting to take Vido to Peru. Arocho said no, thinking he'd never see his son again. And now, it seemed as if she did just that, so Arocho looked to Jones to find them.
Jones and Alisa met Arocho at Sonia's place. Jones broke the doorknob and forced her way into the apartment. She looked for Sonia and Vido's passports, but couldn't find them, which suggested Sonia intended to leave the country. With a custody hearing just a couple weeks off, Arocho blamed himself for not seeing this coming as Sonia's afraid she might lose. Jones discovered that all of Sonia's notices are past due, which meant it might've been difficult for her to get plane tickets. Jones asked if Arocho and Sonia still shared a credit card, which they did. So, he decided to check recent transactions and learned that she just bought two bus tickets.
They arrived at the bus station and realized that she must be taking the nus to Montreal in order to escape the country. Jones ran up and grabbed a kid who she mistook for Vido, apologizing to the parent and child immediately after making the mistake. Jones then had to pull Alisa off of an employee who got smart with Alisa when she asked for directions to the bus to Montreal. Jones and Alisa chased after the bus as it pulled off. Jones grabbed the moving bus by its bumper, an unsuccessful attempt to try and stop it. However, with help from Alisa, between the two of them, they managed to bring the bus to a halt. Arocho reunited with Vido and Jones advised Sonia to be a responsible mother to Vido.

titulo: Jessica Jones — College Years › Crappy Jobs
texto:
Jones began working at an office job within New York City for a few weeks and despised it. When her boss continued to discredit her work and make sexist remarks towards her, Jones used her detective skills to then blackmail her fraud-committing boss into giving her six months' severance and a glowing recommendation for her next job. As she was leaving, the boss insulted her, and in the process mentioned her parents. Out of rage, she knocked over the many filing cabinets and walked out of the door.
Later at the bar, Trish Walker tried to convince her to use her gifts to become a real superhero and protect innocent people, but Jones remained reluctant at the idea. As they were speaking, a man came over and tried to flirt with Walker, noting he remembered her as a child star on It's Patsy. When the man then made crude sexual jokes towards Walker, Jones challenged him to a strength competition, agreeing if she won, he would buy all of their drinks and if he won, she would have sex with him. Jones then won the challenge and got the money, while also forcing the man to apologize. Jones then used the money to buy shots for everyone in the bar.
Jones got another job, working at a cheap sandwich shop where she was forced to wear a large sandwich costume and hand out fliers to the uninterested bypassers. Clearly hating the job and feeling utterly humiliated by the stupid uniform, Jones put little effort into her work. However, while on the street, Jones witnessed a young girl run into the road and into the path of a taxi; Jones ran out and used her own strength to stop the taxi and saved the girl. Hearing the girl's gratitude and knowing she had made a difference had a big impact on Jones' mentality towards becoming a hero and saving more lives.
Back at Trish Walker's Apartment, Jones continued to be pushed about the idea of her becoming a superhero like the Avengers, with Walker even having mock-up costumes made and pitching the new moniker "Jewel" as her own superhero name; however, Jones only mocked the idea more and refused to get involved. When Walker put on the mask to show it off, Jones simply turned it around to prove how easy it was to be blinded, so Walker suggested she fight crime naked instead. In the back of Jones' mind, she did consider the idea and decided to help people whenever she could, but didn't intend to take on an alter ego to do so.

titulo: Jessica Jones — Investigating Karl Malus › Dale Holiday's Holiday
texto: Jones began looking into the background of correction captain Dale Holiday after learning that he had been torturing her mother. She started with former co-workers, herself posing as a board member for the New York Board of Prisons. She claimed that they were giving a career achievement award to Holiday and wanted a few colorful anecdotes for their tribute. She learned that Holiday was fired for suspicions of his possible connection to prisoner suicides. As she continued this discussion, Holiday boarded a bus, which Jones followed. She tracked Holiday back to his home. She broke in through the window once he left again. Hidden within a bear's head mounted on the wall, Jones found the patches belonging to the prisoners who allegedly committed suicide. She is then maced by Holiday and beat by a baton. Jones managed to gain control of the situation, grabbing the baton and bashing Holiday on the head, killing him with a single blow.

titulo: Jessica Jones — Investigating Karl Malus › Reencountering Kilgrave
texto:
After killing Dale Holiday in self-defense, Jones found herself haunted by visions of Kilgrave. In her head, she even heard his voice telling her to stage Dale's death as a suicide. After cleaning up the mess, Jones staged the scene, writing a suicide note and tossing Holiday's body off the rood. Afterward, Kilgrave appeared and applauded Jones for her actions. He appeared again in the shower with Jones to express his pleasure, caressing her shoulders as she bathed.
Kilgrave continued to harass Jones, bringing up her past of extortion and forgery. And now adding murder to the list of her crimes. Jones attempted to make him go away, but to no avail, as he knew all the quaint side streets of Jessica's mind. He assured her that not even in her dreams could she escape him and that he's inside her forever.
He followed Jessica to Karl Malus ’ hotel room, where he remarked killing Karl would’ve been much more effective as he laid spread across the bed. He claimed him being there is to simply ease Jessica’s mind. Knowing that Kilgrave was simply a figment of her imagination, she turned her attention back towards finding Karl, to which Kilgrave loan a hand in. He pointed out that the bed was still made, meaning Karl hadn’t slept there and that his coat was still in the closet. They then found Karl’s journal, detailing his plans to make more enhanced individuals. Kilgrave questioned if Jones would kill Malus once she found him.
Kilgrave rejoined with Jones outside the prison following her visit her with her mother. He agreed that Trish had been acting strange lately, which Jones attributed to drugs. Jones returned home to find Kilgrave in her chair. He antagonized Jones, stating that Karl is safer with Trish considering that she’s not a killer. It’s not in her DNA, but it is in Jones and Kilgrave wanted her to embrace it. Dale Holiday deserved it. Admittedly, so did Kilgrave. Jones opened her laptop to find Malus, only to discover that someone’s been using it. She kicked in Malcolm Ducasse 's door to find his apartment empty. In his bed, she finds a pair of sunglasses. Kilgrave remarks that Ducasse and Trish are together. Romantically. He noted that it reminded him of his and Jones’ time together. Jones then opens Ducasse's laptop, and a dating app pops up. He sarcastically recommended that Jones sign up.
After finding Ducasse but failing to stop Trish, Malcolm proposed that he and Jones work together to find Trish, but neither knew where she was headed. Kilgrave told Jones that Ducasse should’ve been left in the streets, where Kilgrave put him with a needle in his arm as he's useless. Kilgrave added that Trish doesn't want to be saved and that she's a terrible friend. A second Kilgrave appeared and the two spoke to Jones simultaneously. The delusions only dispersed when Ducasse yelled out to her. Kilgrave then started to belittle Jones, stating that with powers, Trish would be a better hero than she ever was, though he didn't stop there. He continued to push Jones to embrace her inner killer. She then found herself surrounded by several Kilgraves, all pushing her to become a killer.
Jones does eventually find Trish, but Karl Malus had already begun the process to giving her powers, though the process seemed to leave Trish more damaged than anything, to which Kilgrave encouraged Jones to make Malus pay. He told her over and over to do it, but Jones refused.
Jones sat in the hospital waiting room, where she reminded Kilgrave that she won. Not that he cared, as Malus was dead either way. Nevertheless, he didn't believe her mother would forgive her for allowing it to happen. However, Jones argued that she's all her mother needed. Kilgrave continued anger Jones, referring to her once more as a killer and insisting that she'll kill again. He felt her shutter when she almost killed Malus and it terrified her. Jones admitted that this is true. Because she's not a killer and she can control herself, meaning she's more powerful than Kilgrave ever was. He then disappeared.

titulo: Jessica Jones — Investigating Karl Malus › Attack on Riverbank Medical Center
texto:
Jones is forced to protect a wounded and unconscious Trish Walker from her mother, who blamed Walker for Karl Malus ’ death. Jones entered into Walker's hospital room just as her mother climbed through the window. Alisa looked over to Walker, blaming her for having taken everything from her, though Jones insisted that this was false. She attempted to convince Alisa that this was merely a story she made up in her head, while Jones pulled out a syringe, hoping to subdue her mother.
Jones failed to inject her mother with the drugs, as those syringes were swiftly knocked out of her hand. Instead, Alisa overpowered her and used Jones' own body to suffocate Walker, all while Jones desperately begged her to stop. Eventually, Jones managed to keep Alisa at bay, hitting her then pushing her away. Finally, Jones managed to get through to her mother after pleading with her to stop, as Alisa finally relaxed. Detectives Eddy Costa and Ruth Sunday then barged into the room, guns drawn. Alisa attempted to make a break for the window but was shot in the leg.
Although Jones attempted to offer aid to her mother, Costa ordered her to stand back, while Sunday attempted to put Alisa in handcuffs, despite Jones insisting that they be careful around her. When Sunday stepped up to arrest her, Alisa grabbed her and held her in a headlock, with Jones desperately attempting to convince her to let Sunday go. However, to Jones' horror, her mother than pulled Sunday out the multiple story high window along with her. Jones and Costa then looked out the window and confirmed that Sunday was killed, while Alisa was able to escape.

titulo: Jessica Jones — Investigating Karl Malus › Going on the Run
texto:
Jones woke up in Alisa ’s camper, parked in the middle of the woods. She recalled her mother attacking her, to which Alisa reasoned was heat of the moment, as she couldn't allow Jones to turn her in again. Alias then told Jones that they're in transit to wherever Jones would like to go. Jones wanted to go to The Raft, but Alisa refused, having already wasted much of her life locked up. Alisa then revealed that when she attacked Jones, she showed restrained and controlled it. Alisa wanted to run away with her daughter, though Jones was reluctant. As people approached from the nearby path, Jones told her mother to wait in the vehicle as she wished to protect people from her. As a car approached, Jones begged Alisa to get back inside as she's a wanted woman, and so she did.
Jones and Alisa have taken to the road. Alisa found a route out of town via side roads, which would lead them to the boarder. The entire time, Jones eyed the keys in the ignition, which didn't go unnoticed. Jones realized that Alisa intentionally put her in a bind, where she can neither run nor call the police, leaving Jones without many options. Alisa pointed out that Jones had tried everything but joining her. Alisa wanted to come together with Jones in her mission to find meaning and purpose. Jones exclaimed that she wouldn't leave Trish Walker, though as Alisa explained, Walker is destroying herself because of Jones. People will always either resent them or idolize them, which included Karl, Alisa added.
Alisa continued to pitch her idea of her and Jones becoming a team, however, Jones remained reluctant given her mother's murderous past. They suddenly stopped. There had been a car crash ahead of them, in the road, involving a family of three and a truck transporting flammable tanks. Alisa grabbed the young girl out the road while Jones rescued the father, who was stuck in the driver's side. Jones and Alias then lifted the trailer off the mother and carried her to safety. However, the truck driver remained to be rescued. Jones took the mother to the RV while Alisa went to save the man still stuck in his truck. As Jones ran back over to assist, the truck blew up, the explosion knocking Jones off her feet. She got back on her feet and found her mother and the truck driver alive and laying in the grass a few feet away. Jones then hugged her mother closely.
Jones and Alisa immediately got back on track. They needed to get to the boarder as fast as possible while the cops would be on their trail once the family they saved should identify them. They stopped at a restaurant, where Jones met with Oscar to ask for false document papers and to say goodbye, but she is forced to make a run for it after realizing that Oscar was followed by the authorities. Jones returned to her mother and the two headed north. Just eight hours out from Montreal, Jones and Alisa planned their next move, though they were not quite sure what that is. They decided to make a detour as they neared a roadblock. They then discovered that the little girl they had previously refused left her phone in the camper and that Detective Eddy Costa was calling from it. Jones called him back. He knew that she was helping her mother and didn't want to see her get caught up in the crossfire. He informed Jones that she still had a chance to get out, but she didn't want to hear it, crushing the phone in her hand.
That night, Jones and Alisa pulled into a vacant amusement park. Jones found a sailboat at the peer that she wanted to use to escape, but Alisa had another idea in mind. Alisa broke into the amusement park and told Jones to leave without her as she didn't wish to be the cause of Jones' death. Alisa then turned on the ride, the lights of which would attract the cops. Jones and Alisa rode the ride to the top, during which time, Alisa revealed to Jones that she no longer wanted to run. As she said her goodbye to Jones, Alisa is shot in the head and killed by Walker. Jones, angered and distraught, jumped off the ride and attacked Walker. She then took Walker's gun and contemplated killing her, but as the police sirens in the background approached, she let Walker go. Jones returned to the ride, joining her mother, crying alongside her lifeless body. Costa arrived moments later with the NYPD and reassured Jones that she did the right thing, having come to the conclusion that it was her who killed Alisa.

titulo: Jessica Jones — Investigating Karl Malus › Estrangement from Trish Walker
texto: Some time had passed since her mother ’s death, but Jones had not yet gotten over her passing. She had been ignoring Trish 's calls and texts, until she returned home one day to find Trish waiting at her door. She explains to Jessica that she didn't want the situation to go down the way it did at the amusement park, but it had to be done. Jessica argued the opposite. Trish believed that she had to kill Alisa because Jones wouldn't, blinded by the fact that she was her mother. Walker again reminded Jones that they're sisters. Jessica believes she lost the only bits of family she had, again, only seeing Trish as the person who killed her mother. She then shut the door in her face.

titulo: Jessica Jones — Business as Usual
texto: For the next few months, Jones returned to a normal life at Alias Investigations. During this time, she saved a woman from her abusive spouse at a furniture factory and hired Gillian as her new secretary. Walker tried to get back in touch with her while beginning her own career as a vigilante, with little success.

titulo: Jessica Jones — Business as Usual › A Free Trip to Mexico
texto:
In 2018, Jones was contacted by Eddy Costa, who offered her a case in the form of an Amber Alert, stating that Mitch Yasdan had kidnapped his daughter Cassie and taken her to Mexico. Jones traveled there and confronted Yasdan, who had lost custody. He insisted that he had a terrible lawyer and needed to get Cassie away from her mother as she was toxic. Cassie also wished to stay with her dad, but Jones ignored this, pointing out that he had still broken the law. When Yasdan argued that they were no longer under US jurisdiction, Jones replied that they were about to be. Not aware of her powers, Yasdan threatened to get physical. Seconds later, Jones threw him across the beach. This was caught on camera and went viral.
Jones returned Cassie to Cassie Yasdan's Mother, who thanked her. Mrs. Yasdan then expressed her anger at Mitch and resolved to have him put in prison and deny him visitation rights. Jones suggested she let the matter slide for Cassie. Mrs. Yasdan immediately took offense to this, demanding to know if Jones thought she was unfair to her daughter. Jones clarified that she was talking about the situation, but her client was unconvinced. She proceeded to accuse Jones of exploiting her for a free trip to Mexico, displaying signs of victim mentality. She also refused to hire Jones for any future cases after that.

titulo: Jessica Jones — Business as Usual › Jeri's Dilemma
texto: Jones got a call from Hogarth, who was in need of her assistance. When Jones arrived at Hogarth's apartment, she shared with Jones her plan for the future. In her hand, she held the pill bottle from her nightstand. Every day, she asked herself if today was the day she would finally take them. The answer had been no, until that morning, when she felt the first significant symptoms of the ALS, though the symptoms did pass. However, it made her realize that when the day came for her to finally take them, she would not have it in her to do it herself. So, she would need someone to slip her the pills without her knowing, and she wanted that to be Jones. However, Jones was reluctant.

titulo: Jessica Jones — Business as Usual › Stakeout at the Hotel Nouvet
texto:
Jones began an investigation after being hired by Dorothy Walker to find Trish Walker. She tracked her down to Nouvet Hotel, where Walker had been staking out the building next door. While waiting for Walker to return, Jones remained in her hotel room. As night approached, Jones spotted Walker on the street below, following a man into his apartment. Jones watched from the hotel room as Walker began to attack him. Just as he gained the upper hand, Jones came to save her, crashing through the man's window as he pulled out a gun and began firing. Jones disarmed the man and retreated into the bedroom with Walker, who exhibited impressive reflexes and agility before returning to the main room, only to discover that the man and the sculpture that Walker was after, was gone. Walker then jumped out the window and returned to her hotel room, with Jones not far behind.
Jones confronted Walker, referring to her as a cat burglar, but Walker was simply trying to get justice. Jones realized that what she saw Walker doing earlier must've meant that Karl Malus ' procedure worked. Because of Jones, the man got away. The sculpture in his safe would've linked him to an assault. Walker had been tracking him for weeks. She was just trying to be the hero she always wanted to be, and Jones mocked her for it. Jones questioned if it was all worth it to Walker considering that she got what she always wanted. Walker countered that she freed Jones from her responsibilities of helping people, because she can do that now. Before leaving, Jones told Walker that her mother was looking for her.

titulo: Jessica Jones — Business as Usual › Meeting Erik Gelden
texto:
Jones met a guy at a bar, one with whom she made a bet with. The man looked behind him at other men, telling her to guess which one broke their glass first. Jones picked the wrong one, costing her ten dollars. The man joked that he had an instinct for idiocy. It was people like the idiots at the bar that he had never cared for, though Jones couldn't say the same. According to her mother, she cared. He could tell from the look on Jones' face that her mother was dead, to which he offered his condolences. The man continued to share his view of the world with Jones, how everything was terrible, and optimism was a lie. The two of them toasted to having low expectations before received her burger she ordered, causing the man to say how awful it looked. Jones proceeded to eat her burger, attempting to ignore him, but he pushed on. Jones then sarcastically asked when his pick-up line was coming. However, the man just wanted to show her how to make a good burger, betting fifty dollars that she would like it.
They stopped by the store and then headed upstairs to her place, where he introduced himself as Erik. The couple soon kissed but were interrupted by a knock at the door. Jones suspected it was Vido Arocho, continuing on. However, the knocking continued, prompting Jones to open the door. Suddenly, she was stabbed by someone wearing a black ski mask. Jones, bleeding and wounded, shoved her assailant down the hall as she struggled to stay upright. Fortunately, Malcolm Ducasse came out his apartment and tended to Jones as he called the police.

titulo: Jessica Jones — Kilgrave's Influence › Becoming a Sex Slave
texto:
While walking one day in late 2013, Jones came across Malcolm Ducasse about to be killed by muggers, whom she quickly overpowered in order to save him. This action was spotted by Kilgrave with two women turned into his slaves, who clapped enthusiastically, marveled at her powers. Using his own abilities, he enthralled her, and Jones immediately fell under Kilgrave's mind control powers, answering his questions and revealing her name. Kilgrave complimented her on her beauty before ordering her to join him for dinner, with she accepted due to his power.
Over the next few months, Kilgrave kept Jones as his own prisoner, constantly using his powers to force her to spend time and have sex with him, which she always knew was rape despite Kilgrave believing it was a real relationship. When Trish Walker would call Jones to check that she was all right, Kilgrave ensured that Jones explained that everything was fine. Kilgrave would treat her to dinner, specifically at an Italian restaurant called Il Rosso, and use his vast wealth to stay in a five-star hotel ; however, it would constantly be his powers keeping her there, not Jones' own free will.
It quickly became clear that Kilgrave's powers would only last twelve hours until he would need to give a new order. One day, no order was given, and Jones became free of him for a few short seconds, finally offering her a new chance to escape from his power. She considered jumping off the balcony and escaping, as she does that, Jones imagined a white horse below which was there to take her from Kilgrave, but before she could, Kilgrave ordered her to step down, putting her under his control again. When he questioned why she initially had not listened to him, he decided to punish her by ordering her to cut off her own ear, which later was revealed by Jessica to have a scar where he forced her to self-harm. When she began to obey, Kilgrave changed his mind and hugged her.

titulo: Jessica Jones — Business as Usual › Hospitalized
texto:
Jones was rushed into surgery as she asked Malcolm Ducasse to call Trish Walker. When the surgery ended, Jones sat, pale and weak, in her hospital bed as Walker arrived. Walker was happy to see her, thinking Jones finally wanted to talk. However, Jones just asked who the man that Walker went after was. Walker told her the name was Brandt. Jones pushed further, wanting the full name: Andrew Brandt. Jones then turned over onto her side, away from Walker, who was disappointed that it was all Jones wanted.
Jones, all alone in the room, examined her wound, discovering that her spleen was removed. The doctor informed her that if she was a normal human then her injuries would’ve been fatal. Jones had her sights set on Brandt and did not care much for what the doctor had to say. She attempted to stand as she wanted to be discharged, but she found herself too weak to move, and was helped back onto the bed by Purks.
Jones awakened from her sleep, startled by the presence of a man, whom she kicked. However, she soon saw that the man was just Detective Eddy Costa. He was there to take her statement, though Jones wouldn't offer up much and refused to look at herself or even be treated as a victim. Jones was later discharged against medical advice, still weak and wounded from her attack.

titulo: Jessica Jones — Business as Usual › Finding Andrew Brandt
texto:
Returning to her office, Jones ordered Gillian to find out everything she could about Andrew Brandt. However, Gillian's shift was over. Before leaving, she informed Jones that Vido Arocho stopped by to give her a gift and she also gave Jones her medication. Knowing she had to take the medicine with food, Jones went to the refrigerator, only to find the burger that Erik Gelden had made for her. Jones fell asleep at her desk while looking for information on Brandt. She only woke when Malcolm Ducasse knocked at the door. She thanked him for calling the ambulance and he gave her the knife that she was stabbed with, having swiped it before police arrived. He called in a favor and ran the prints. However, the knife was clean and too common to trace. He figured Jones would say that she did not need any favors, so he billed her to his services.
Jones broke into Brandt's apartment and looked through his home for any clues. Trish Walker was there as well, though she didn't come up with any leads. Brandt was her target first, and she wanted to be the one to bring him in, though Jones wanted vengeance after he stabbed her. Walker was concerned that Jones would take this from her and advised Jones to go home to take care of herself, so she could handle Brandt.
Jones made a series of calls regarding potential auctions for the stolen sculpture, but each call led nowhere. However, she did get the names of galleries to survey from Jeri Hogarth. The following day, Jones broke into the Cassaro Gallery auction. Walking around the building to the back alley, she jumped up onto the roof and found the sculpture inside. Unfortunately, Walker was at the auction as well, posing as a buyer. She hacked into their computer and took a photo of their sellers' contact information. Outside, Jones waited for Walker. Once Walker came, Jones explained that she wanted Brandt's contact info. However, Walker wanted the sculpture. Jones proceeded to take Walker down and called Brandt from Walker's phone, posing as an assistant for the gallery. She informed him that his lot had sold and asked where he'd like the check delivered.
Jones broke into Brandt's hideout and took his gun. He was visibly afraid, telling her to take whatever she wanted, though Jones was not interested. She pinned Brandt to the wall with a car as he told her he believed that Jones was hired by his sister. However, Jones informed him that she couldn't care less about the sculpture. What she was angry about that he hired someone to stab him. Brandt claimed that he did no such thing. He had been hiding out ever since she and Walker broke into his apartment. Realizing that he was telling the truth, Jones pulled the car off of him and called Walker, telling her that Brandt was not her attacker. However, she did give the location for her to find Brandt.

titulo: Jessica Jones — Business as Usual › Gelden's Abilities
texto:
Returning back to her apartment, Jones found Erik Gelden and gave him fifty dollars, owning her bet she made about the burger. She then started getting flashbacks of her stabbing, realizing that if it was not Andrew Brandt, who stabbed her, it must have been someone going after Gelden. She pulled Gelden inside, asking who would try to kill him.
Gelden told Jones about Sal Blaskowski, whom he owed money to. However, he still had twelve hours to get it to her, so he doubted she would try to kill him yet. He then explained that he was super like her. His powers were that he could sense who was a bad person, which gave him a migraine. He went further, saying that he had used this to blackmail people into giving him money, which were now in drop boxes around the city. Jones and he decided to pay these people a visit.
At the first drop box, they got the money and saw it was from Todd White. Jones wanted to look further and visited White. Gelden immediately got a headache, stepping away from White. Jones believed it was insurance fraud, but Gelden did not confirm this. Seeing White's neck cast, Jones ripped it off, only to see the injury was real. She then stepped inside and immediately saw a barbie doll despite the fact that he had no family. As White yelled at her, she looked in a closet and saw a pink room fit for a child and a camera. Disgusted, she locked the man in a closet and called the police.
They went to more drop boxes and got more money while paying visits. Jones described it as the only good thing she had done all year. They then visited Reyna Pincer who claimed she took money out of the company to pay for her mother's operations and even sold her wedding ring to pay Gelden. Jones did not buy it and threatened Pincer until she admitted that she took money out of the employees for her own benefit. Jones then left the building, telling the employees the truth.
Gelden was tired and needed to get the money to Blaskowski, so he left. Jones wanted to search further and went to another apartment, only to find it empty. She broke in and looked around, seeing many different awards to Gregory P. Sallinger. She then saw a knife rack on the wall with one missing, so she knew he was the stabber. She took pictures until Sallinger suddenly returned to his home. However, he was not alarmed and instead put back his knife casually, showing Jones that he broke into her apartment. As Jones approached him, Sallinger let out a cry, saying she was attacking him. This was so he can get her on camera "threatening" him. He then called the police claiming for a restraining order. Jones ran out.
Jones returned home and found Gelden at her door, tired. He explained he wanted to make sure she was okay. They then walked in and saw a bag from Sallinger with money in it. However, the money was all bloodied and had the word "fraud" on it.

titulo: Jessica Jones — Business as Usual › Team up with Trish
texto:
Jones called into Style by Trish, claiming that she was calling about the sweater that Trish Walker had previously tried to sell her. Jones had changed her mind and wanted to buy it. The clingy, smothering, and tenacious sweater. The one that wouldn't quit even when she asked it to. Lastly, Jones said that she needed Walker's help to stop Gregory Sallinger, to which Walker was more than happy to.
Jones and Walker began their joint investigation into Sallinger at Jones' apartment, starting with the bag full of bloody money Sallinger left behind. There was eight thousand dollars in the bag total. Walker was certain they’d catch him, but Jones knew just how smart he was. They didn't have any kind of evidence to support their claim that Sallinger was a murderer. So, they planned a stakeout. Jones wanted to get him the right way, without the risk of losing the case to coercion, as suggested by Walker who wanted to dangle him off a roof. Walker was their one advantage as Sallinger wasn't yet aware of her.
Jones and Walker staged their stakeout on top of the neighboring building to Sallinger's apartment. Walker remained on top of the building to cover the front while Jones headed around to cover the back. Walker then called Jones to alert her of Sallinger's arrival. She watched through binoculars as he pulled out his bag what appeared to be photos. He then pulled a bureau away from the wall and added the photo to a hidden album. Jones suspected it could be a trophy. Walker wanted to break in and get it, but Jones already had an established plan. Sallinger exited the building, providing Walker with a window of time to get in, get the album, and get out. During which time, Jones would follow Sallinger.

titulo: Jessica Jones — Business as Usual › Meeting Berry
texto:
Jones followed Gregory Sallinger as he stopped by a park bench, where he read a newspaper. Across the street from Sallinger, an altercation ensued between Gor, a pimp, and one of his hookers, Berry. Not long after, Erik Gelden arrived. Jones watched as he and Sallinger had a brief exchange of words, before Gelden approached Gor and handed him some money. Gelden then took Berry inside a nearby hotel, which Jones followed them into.
Jones entered the hotel room to the sight of Berry fighting Gelden, who explained that Brianna, or as she preferred to be called, Berry, was his sister. Jones accused Gelden of being in cahoots with Sallinger, however, he explained that this wasn't the case. He was trying to get Brianna some place safe, and Sallinger got to her first. What Jones saw was Sallinger questioning how Gelden found him. Gelden stated that Sallinger slipped up, but it was he who left broken pieces for Sallinger to find, and now he was threatening Gelden's sister. That's why Gelden was out there. As Berry tried to leave, he attempted to explain that she wasn't safe out there.
Jones returned home to find Walker and Gillian researching together. They found something, but Jones didn't stick around to find out what it was. Instead, she approached Malcolm Ducasse with a job. To house and protect Berry. Initially reluctant, Ducasse eventually agreed. He deduced that they wanted to keep Berry close by because she was Gelden's sister. Ducasse then asked for the specifics, such as who he'd be protecting her from. Gelden was reluctant, revealing to Jones that Ducasse was giving him a headache. A three on a scale from 1–10. Jones, however, decided to trust her gut over Gelden's head.

titulo: Jessica Jones — Business as Usual › The Trainyard Trap
texto:
Jones joined Trish Walker up on the rooftop, where Walker informed her that Gregory Sallinger was sleeping. Jones showed Walker the photo she had taken of Sallinger's closet and the photo that Walker had taken. In one photo, the handsaw hanging in his closet was missing, but it was back in place in the later photo. That connected with something Walker had been thinking about; the vacuum seal bags she found in his apartment. He must've used them to store body parts. Jones had an idea on how to find them, but she needed Walker to get in contact with Maury at the morgue. They would need to borrow something. They lured Sallinger out of his home by throwing a severed hand through his window. Sallinger would in turn return what he believed to be the hand of one of his victim's back to his burial site.
Jones met up with Walker near the train tracks, where she had tracked Sallinger. They caught up to Sallinger who had opened the lid to one of the tanks. They suspected that was where he kept the bodies, but Jones wanted proof. She would investigate while Walker followed Sallinger. Jones climbed on top and entered the tank. Once inside, she found dozens of body parts. However, the tank was booby trapped. Jones tripped the line, which caused the door to lock and the tank to fill with some type of poisonous gas. Jones punched the tank until her hands bled, but she was too weak to break through. Jones, unfortunately, was running out of time. She could barely stand, using the ladder to hold herself up. Luckily, Walker came back for her. She pried the door open and rescued Jones. When asked if she lost Sallinger, Walker replied that she chose Jones.
Jones, still coughing from the attack, thanked Walker for saving her. Walker then admitted that she wished she didn't kill Alisa Jones. Jones said she wished her mother was not a mass murderer. The police were approaching as Jones had reported her discovery of the bodies. However, Walker had to leave as they needed her anonymity.

titulo: Jessica Jones — Business as Usual › Rescuing Erik
texto:
Jones and Trish Walker began their search for Erik Gelden, who had been taken by Gregory Sallinger. Sallinger wanted to know from Jones how they found him. Jones offered to come and explain every mistake Sallinger made if he gave up his location. However, he did no such thing.
Jones rushed over to Sallinger's apartment, where police were all over the scene. So, she circled around back. However, Eddy Costa caught her before she could climb up the fire escape. Still, Jones had to take action and needed to know what Costa had so far, but they didn't have much of anything. He asked Jones about the photos behind the bureau. It was full of landscape photos, meaning Sallinger cleaned it out. Jones claimed that it had photos of his eight victims. Costa corrected Jones and told her there were only seven victims according to the coroner. And they’d identified them all. Jones offered to trade Costa the copies of the photos from the album for the list of victim's names. If she knew which photo wasn't on the list, she could find the eighth victim. As there was another officer present, Costa said no to the trade, but as he was walking off, he intentionally dropped the list for Jones.
Jones reconvened with Walker and together they discussed how to find Gelden. When she called his phone, Jones recalled him yelling out that he was in a commercial something, before Sallinger cut him off. Whatever it was, it would have to be abandoned for Sallinger to do his work. After finding her eighth man, Jones just needed a name, so she broke into Malcolm Ducasse 's apartment as she assumed that he had facial recognition software considering his current employment, which he did. They got a hit which was a ninety-six percent match: Caspar Marx. He was a well-known chef, who was apparently still alive. As Jones was headed out to follow the lead, she met Berry at the door, who asked if they had found Gelden yet. Jones assured Berry they would.
Jones arrived at a restaurant and questioned Marx about Sallinger. She learned that Sallinger could be holding Gelden at Marx's old restaurant, which had since been closed down. Jones and Walker arrived just in time to save Gelden. Jones charged at Sallinger and kicked him over the counter before tending to Gelden. In that time, Sallinger got to his feet and took cover, though Walker was looking for him. Sallinger circled around and charged at Jones with a knife. She knocked him back. Walker then disarmed him and the two of them knocked him out. Walker disposed of the photos Sallinger took of Gelden and then took him back to Alias. Jones stayed behind to make sure the police got Sallinger. Returning home, Jones angrily learned that the charges will not stick as there was no DNA on the bodies.

titulo: Jessica Jones — Business as Usual › Road to Wappinger Falls
texto:
Jones and Trish Walker watched outside the precinct as Jeri Hogarth represented Gregory Sallinger, who was released. Sallinger told the press that Jones falsely accused him of murder as well as the fact that there was a female vigilante. Jones quickly told Walker to run. Sallinger then pointed out towards Jones among the crowd, causing the reporters to chase Jones down the road.
Sallinger’s press conference was gaining a lot of attention, and the phones were going off the hook at Alias Investigations, with people asking about the second vigilante. Jones looked into Sallinger's past to see if he may have slipped up. She looked into his brother's death, which was allegedly a tractor accident. Jones suspected that this may not have been an accident at all and that Donny Sallinger was Gregory's first kill, so she and Trish Walker decided to drive out to his hometown.
Jones and Walker drove to Wappinger Falls to uncover the truth behind Donny's death. Jones entered the police precinct and requested the report. Chief Ronnie Velasco confirmed that Donny was rolled over by the tractor and that Gregory was on a school trip. When Jones questioned why Velasco wouldn't show her the report, she called Jones out, as she was aware of who Jones was. Velasco denied that Sallinger had any involvement in the death of his brother or the seven victims in the train yard. With Velasco refusing to show her the report, Jones went into the restroom, where she texted Walker and told her to cause a distraction. Walker did so by making her car alarm sound off. Once the officers were outside looking to help Walker, Jones hopped the counter and stole Donny's report. Jones and Walker spent the night in a nearby motel. With no foul play detected, Walker began to worry that they were wrong about Donny being Gregory's first kill. They wondered if Donny wasn't the first kill, then who was.

titulo: Jessica Jones — Business as Usual › Meeting the Silvas
texto:
The following morning, Trish Walker presented Jones with a lead. Nathan Silva was on the high school wrestling team. Silva and Gregory Sallinger were friends up until senior year when he went missing.
Jones and Walker arrived at the Silva Residence. Jones felt bad as their son had been missing for fifteen years and Jones was about to rip that wound open. Inside the Silva home, Manuel Silva told Jones that Nathan and Sallinger had one falling out when Nathan started getting recruiting offers. Sallinger was envious as wresting came easy to Nathan. Jones noticed a card with a photo of Nathan on the stand. It read "Nathan will always be with you." Sallinger sent it the Christmas after Nathan went missing. The photo was taken in the backyard, where a gazebo sat. It was built the day Nathan disappeared. The whole team helped out. Manuel thought that Nathan had just skipped out on the work. Ana Silva, Nathan's mother, was done answering questions as it brought too much pain.
Jones, looking outside to the gazebo, asked if Sallinger helped build it. He did. He stayed the entire day, Manuel said. Chief Ronnie Velasco entered the home after getting a call from Ana. Velasco told Jones to leave, instead, Jones headed out back. Jones flipped the gazebo and started digging into the dirt. Velasco drew her weapon and demanded Jones stop digging or else she would shoot. Walker came around back and started filming Velasco. Just as Jones suspected, she found Nathan's body buried beneath the dirt.
As Nathan's body was taken away, Jones called Eddy Costa and told him that Silva was Sallinger's first kill. There would have to be DNA all over it. So, Costa would have to file for jurisdiction over the body. Velasco approached and asked for her files back before thanking Jones.

titulo: Jessica Jones — Business as Usual › Queen of the Ring
texto:
Jones arrived at a wrestling gym having traced Malcolm Ducasse 's phone. She looked inside and saw Gregory Sallinger teaching wrestling to kids. Jones informed Ducasse that they found what they needed upstate to get Sallinger. Although, they couldn't bring him in quite yet. Sallinger noticed Jones watching him from outside the door and invited her in, though Ducasse remained hidden. Jones wanted Sallinger away from the kids he was teaching, but he refused. Sallinger told Jones that she had no discipline and couldn't control herself. Jones realized that he was baiting her to attack him in front of cameras. Instead, she got on the mat and told him to school her.
Sallinger then explained the ground rules to Jones and the match began with Sallinger slamming Jones to the mat. As he laid on top of her, she mentioned Nathan Silva, which got a reaction from Sallinger, who she proceeded to toss several feet back. Sallinger charged for her, but she dodged the attack. Sallinger charged again and Jones continued to slam him. Jones then went on the offense, slamming him again, before leaving. The crowd cheered as Jones exited saying that class was dismissed.

titulo: Jessica Jones — Kilgrave's Influence › Breaking Free
texto:
On January 20, 2014, Kilgrave becomes aware that Reva Connors was previously in possession of a hard drive, which he wished to gain ownership of for unknown reasons. With Jones by his side, Kilgrave put Connors under his power and discovers that she buried the hard drive under concrete. Kilgrave orders Jones to uncover it and after hours of digging, which leads to her hands bleeding, Jones finds the hard-drive and gives it to Kilgrave.
Satisfied that he had gotten what he desired, Kilgrave and the women step outside the warehouse. Kilgrave orders Jones to handle Connors, which Jones obeys by mustering all of her strength and punching Connors in the chest, stopping her heart and killing her instantly. However, the trauma of committing murder horrified Jones so much that she walked away from Kilgrave, ignoring his commands, successfully breaking away from his control. As Kilgrave screamed at Jones to come back to him, a bus swerved to miss Connors' body and instead hit Kilgrave, seemingly killing him.
Jones receives a death certificate which confirmed Kilgrave had been killed in the crash and returned to Trish Walker for comfort. However, the prolonged experience of being under Kilgrave's control left Jones suffering from PTSD and she gave up all hope of becoming a hero. Jones moved from Walker's apartment and found her own place, deciding to use her gifts to open Alias Investigations and earn a living investigating people, mainly men, and women having affairs. Jones became addicted to whiskey and avoided human contact as much as possible, even from her own adoptive sister.

titulo: Jessica Jones — Business as Usual › Sending a Message
texto:
Jones soon saw a trending photo of the masked vigilante. She called Trish Walker, who failed to answer them. So, Jones stopped by the studio to talk to her in person. Jones showed Dorothy Walker the photo from the New York Bulletin of Trish in her disguise, on the bridge. Dorothy was upset that Trish went down this path without her. Jones then got a video message from Gregory Sallinger who was at a café. He stated that by 7:00 pm, a life would end because of Jones, and everyone would see that she was a fraud. While Sallinger was supposed to be under police surveillance, he must have slipped them. Jones made Trish aware of this. The camera from the video was focused on a table, where two men and a woman sat. Given that all his past victims were male, Trish concluded that his next victim must be one of the two men at the table. The video then seemed to erase itself. Dorothy explained that it was an InstaYap video, which only allowed two viewings.
Later, Eddy Costa pulled up as Jones reached Sallinger's apartment. He warned her to walk away as Sallinger had not gone anywhere, but Jones had her doubts.
