Fisk said that Lopez only did what she thought she had to do, which impressed him, and remarked that there must be a part of her that was happy to see Fisk alive.
Lopez disagreed with that, saying that she wanted him dead, but Fisk argued that the expression of relief on her face said otherwise. He expressed his disappointment that Lopez was so quick to assume the worst and turn against Fisk, as she used to see him as a hero, but she said that was no longer the case. Fisk replied that despite everything, he still cared about her and did not want to see her getting hurt. Fisk presented Lopez with wine he had brought, and she told him that she would open it. Fisk explored the house and looked at the picture of Lopez and her family, and once she returned, Lopez nonchalantly said that she poured the wine down the drain, which did not upset Fisk too much.
As the two sat down with cookies from Lopez's favorite bakery, Fisk accidentally dropped some kitchenware and seeing Lopez alerted at him holding a knife, Fisk simply handed it to Lopez. Fisk insisted that he knew everything about Lopez and they cannot trust anyone but each other. Lopez then inquired why Fisk actually came to her, so he proposed her to come back to New York City with him, adding that he is willing to hand over the control of his criminal empire to her in exchange. Seeing Lopez conflicted, Fisk said that he would be waiting at the Choctaw Casino until tomorrow, asking Lopez to consider his offer, before leaving.

titulo: Kingpin — Reunion with Maya Lopez › Maya Lopez's Decision
texto:
On the next night, while Fisk was at the Choctaw Casino, Maya Lopez arrived and held him at gunpoint, as Fisk anticipated her trying to kill him again. Fisk took a seat in the chair and told Lopez that he had always loved her like a daughter, but Lopez replied that all her childhood was only a fantasy that made her view him as a hero, instead of a monster. Fisk argued that at every point, Lopez knew what she was a part of and never questioned why she had to kill all those people. Lopez did not budge and claimed that Fisk isolated her from a normal life but never truly cared about her, implying that he gave her Translator Contact Lens only because he never cared enough to learn ASL.
In response, Fisk lashed out at her that he was always there for her but admitted that he had failed Lopez, the same way his own father failed him. Fisk then showed Lopez a hammer that he kept as a memorabilia of what he had to do to become the man he was now. He told Lopez that his father only felt strong when he was abusing his mother, so Fisk had to become stronger and stop him. Lopez was shocked to find out that Fisk killed his own father, to which Fisk responded that he had to do it to become free and move forward with his life. Fisk then handed the hammer over to Lopez, encouraging her to kill him and free herself like he did, while also freeing Fisk himself.
Lopez hesitated for a few moments, before refusing to go along with Fisk's suggestion and put the hammer away. Fisk remarked that both of them have come the full circle now, adding that he expects her to return with him tomorrow. The next morning, Fisk boarded his private jet and waited for Lopez, however, he was informed by his subordinates that Lopez left Tamaha and they were unable to tail her, which greatly enraged him.

titulo: Kingpin — Reunion with Maya Lopez › Kidnapping Chula Battiest
texto: Fisk later came to a postal office, where he saw Chula Battiest dropping several envelops, so he helped her pick them up. Battiest noted that Fisk was not a local, asking if he came for the powwow, to which he elusively agreed to. Fisk noted that he did not expect to see so many people in town, to which Battiest replied that guests come all over for the Choctaw powwows. Fisk then took notice of Battiest's necklace, which said "I love you" in ASL, and when Battiest asked if Fisk could sign, he said that he was trying for his niece. Battiest said that she learned ASL for her late daughter and Fisk mentioned that he also lost a person he loved which hurt him quite a lot. Battiest told him that she kept it up for her granddaughter, but when Fisk asked about her, he confirmed that they were both talking about Lopez all along.

titulo: Kingpin — Reunion with Maya Lopez › Facing the Pain
texto:
Kingpin then ordered his men to capture Chula Battiest and Bonnie, while the Black Knife Cartel infiltrated the Choctaw Nation Powwow and waited until for further orders. Maya Lopez confronted Kingpin with a gun in her hand, but Kingpin revealed that he had Battiest and Bonnie as his hostages, while his men surrounded Lopez.
With Bonnie acting as an interpreter, Kingpin expressed his disappointment in Lopez, who betrayed him after he offered her everything, but Lopez argued that Kingpin was the one who betrayed her. She insisted that Battiest and Bonnie were her true family and they had nothing to do with this, to which Kingpin replied that now he knew how much it would hurt her when he killed them just like he killed Lopez's father.
Kingpin then ordered his men to attack Lopez, however, she was able to summon the powers of her ancestors and pass them over to Battiest and Bonnie. To Kingpin's shock, the three of them were able to fight back against his men. Kingpin then attempted to charge at Lopez himself, but she was able to stop him by touching his heart with her powers. She then tapped into his mind and sent Kingpin into the memories of his childhood, where he found himself at his old house. Kingpin was able to hear his father beating his mother through the cracked wall, which made him succumb to his trauma.
As Kingpin was on the verge of a breakdown, Lopez appeared in front of him and told Kingpin that he must let go of the pain and anger inside of him. She pleaded with him, saying that he was still her uncle no matter what and he must shut out the voice of his father, but Kingpin screamed that he was not the person Lopez wanted him to be. He then reached for the hammer, to which Lopez asked him to hand it over, but Kingpin was unable to let go of the pain completely. As Lopez restored them to reality, a distraught Kingpin grabbed her hands and demanded her to know what she had done to him. The experience proved to be too much for Kingpin, who then abandoned his plans to kill Lopez and her family and ordered his men to retreat.

titulo: Kingpin — Mayoral Campaign › Stabilizing the Situation
texto:
Fisk boarded his private jet in order to return to New York City and contacted his associates, claiming that the situation must be stabilized before it spiraled out of their control. While talking over the phone, Fisk saw NY1 reporting on the upcoming race for the New York mayor and watched Pat Kiernan and Errol Louis talk about an ideal candidate who would take care of the city's legitimate issues.
As they mentioned that there was still a window of opportunity for a surprise candidate to emerge, Fisk expressed interest in joining the mayoral race. Upon returning home, he spoke with Vanessa and informed her of his mayoral ambitions before he distanced himself from her, leaving Vanessa to continue to run his empire by herself. During this time, Fisk lost weight and gained more muscle, and began wearing darker colored suits once more. Later that year, Fisk learned that Foggy Nelson had been killed by Benjamin Poindexter.

titulo: Kingpin — Mayoral Campaign › Reunion with Vanessa Fisk
texto:
In late 2026, Fisk was notified that he had received the two hundred thousand signatures necessary to officially run for mayor. He enjoyed a small meal before he went to get dressed, and briefly lingered on a white suit before opting for a gray one.
He headed to a warehouse where Vanessa Fisk was conducting a meeting with the Five Families and interrupted it, telling Vanessa that he needed to speak with her. As the other criminals swiftly left, Vanessa chided Wilson for returning after months away and then prematurely ending a Families meeting, while Wilson merely commended her for having kept them in line in his absence while also having garnered their respect.
Wilson stated that he was broken and shattered by Maya Lopez and that he had to put himself back together, but that during his recovery process, his love for Vanessa and his desire to help New York City had been reignited. He notified Vanessa that during his mayoral campaign, his assets could not be perceived as illegal, and Vanessa assured him that she had structured their businesses to elude scrutiny. Wilson then told her that he had the sufficient signatures and that it was time for him to officially declare his mayoral candidacy.

titulo: Kingpin — Mayoral Campaign › Official Candidate
texto:
With the sufficient signatures obtained, Fisk got on television and began speaking about the state of vigilantes in New York City and how they needed to be stopped in order to make the city safer. Fisk then declared that he would be able to fix the system and the city publicly announced this candidacy for mayor of New York City, using the slogan "Fisk Can Fix It." Fisk hired Sheila Rivera to serve as his assistant and political advisor, while Buck Cashman served as his assistant and right-hand man. As he watched the polls, Rivera informed him that rivals Roger Cressna and Diana Montoya were ahead of him, and that he needed to refine his message for the upcoming debate, to which Fisk stated that his message was already clear.
As Cashman stated that Fisk's messaging did not need refining, a young man behind Fisk chimed in and agreed with him, and claimed that Fisk was all over social media, including on The BB Report, and that "Fisk Can Fix It" was trending. Fisk asked the man who he was, who responded that his name was Daniel Blake. Fisk asked Blake why he would vote for him, and Blake replied that Fisk had made something for himself and that he believed he would do the same for New York before profanely stating that Mayor Fisk was the coolest thing he had heard. Fisk asked Rivera where she had found Blake, and Rivera informed Fisk that Blake had single-handedly canvasses over two thousand signatures for Fisk and that he was cheap to employ. Fisk then gave Blake a look and then walked out of the room, followed by Cashman and Rivera.
One night, Fisk participated in the mayoral debate against Cressna, where he informed the public that he had been shot by a vigilante and discussed the dangers of vigilantism. When Cressna stated that he agreed with him, Fisk balked that Cressna was posing and that while Cressna proposed registration for vigilantism, Fisk wanted to treat the problem at its root by outlawing vigilantism.
The next day, Fisk exited a NY1 station and greeted his fans when he noticed Matt Murdock outside. Fisk told Cashman it was fine when he tried to keep him from getting near Fisk. He approached Murdock and remarked that it had been quite some time since they last met. Murdock then asked Fisk if they could have a conversation, and Fisk agreed; Fisk then followed Murdock as the pair walked to Square Diner.

titulo: Kingpin — Mayoral Campaign › Diner Chat with Matt Murdock
texto:
Sitting across from each other in a booth, Fisk listened to Matt Murdock comment on his muscle gain as a result of his weight loss, causing Fisk to tell Murdock that he was not intending to fight him. Fisk then remarked that it was not entirely unpleasant to see Murdock and asked about his life. Fisk briefly mentioned his tutelage of Maya Lopez, resulting in her shooting him in the face, which they both laughed off.
As they continued to talk, they both reflected over how they stopped visiting Hell's Kitchen as much and that they had both improved in their careers. Fisk explained his intentions for becoming mayor, but Murdock was doubtful due to Fisk's multiple attempts to kill him, although Fisk accused Murdock of the same. Murdock insisted that he never tried to kill Fisk, who was unconvinced. Fisk took the opportunity to assure Murdock that he had nothing to do with Foggy Nelson 's death, as per their promise.
Murdock believed that Fisk was using being the mayor of New York to serve his own goals, but Fisk answered that he genuinely wanted to fix the city. Fisk asked Murdock why he stopped being Daredevil, which was due to him trying to kill Benjamin Poindexter. Fisk spoke about dealing with their violent natures and the power it had over them. When Murdock threatened to bring down Fisk if he reverted to his old ways, he responded that when elected mayor, he would not tolerate vigilantes, threatening Murdock to not return as Daredevil. With the two understanding each other, Murdock got up and left the diner.

titulo: Kingpin — Mayor of New York › Successfully Elected Mayor
texto: Having gained the majority of votes, Wilson won the election and became the new mayor of New York. As his campaign team celebrated around him, Wilson looked over to Vanessa Fisk, and the two silently shared a glance at each other. Upon giving a speech about making New York safer, Wilson was joined by Vanessa on the roof, where he revealed that he knew that she having an affair with a man named Adam. Vanessa made Wilson promise that he would not kill Adam, and she then left, leaving Wilson to overlook the city. On December 31, 2026, Fisk gave a speech that was broadcasted, where he denounced vigilantes such as Punisher, Spider-Man, and Daredevil.

titulo: Kingpin — Criminal Enterprise › Rebuilding of Hell's Kitchen
texto:
In the aftermath of the Battle of New York, Fisk lost a lot of his connection and money, which put him in a desperate situation to gather up his power again and to maintain his dignity. Eventually, Fisk saw an opportunity to proceed with his plans to rebuild Hell's Kitchen, as it had been damaged during the Chitauri Invasion. He founded the Union Allied Construction that would oversee a large part of the government contracts while using the company as the façade for the illicit activities and money laundering operations.
Fisk hired James Wesley as his personal assistant who helped him with carrying out his criminal plans. Over the years of working together, the two developed a strong friendship, with Fisk eventually treated him like his own son. Fisk also used Red Hook Port to make substantial profits. By 2014, he had taken full control over Don Rigoletto 's criminal activities. He had recruited Leland Owlsley, the Russian Mafia, Nobu Yoshioka as well as Madame Gao into his organization.
Fisk began making connections all across New York City, as he built a relationship with the Stokes Crime Family in Harlem, who ran the gun running businesses across the city. He also developed a rivalry with various criminal organizations across the city, including the Kitchen Irish. However, some members, such as George, chose to side with Fisk. In order to maintain his desired privacy, Fisk instructed all of his employees to only refer to him as their employer, and never to speak his name out loud.

titulo: Kingpin — Mayor of New York › Creating Good Optics
texto:
While Sheila Rivera outlined the day's agenda, Fisk asked about the desk he was sitting at, wondering if Fiorello La Guardia sat at the same one. Fisk explained that La Guardia was a hero of his father 's, being the only man he respected. Fisk returned to his agenda, expressing his wish to push the meet and greets, but Rivera emphasized the importance of establishing connections within the first few days. Rivera also brought up that his wife 's public absence was hurting his image, so Fisk decided to work on that.
While stuck in traffic with Rivera, Buck Cashman, and Daniel Blake, Fisk was advised by them on where his strongest supporters were located throughout New York. Fisk expressed his desire to want to fix the city, although Rivera told him that he should just maintain the status quo. Learning that a pothole was causing the traffic, Fisk got out of his car and ordered nearby construction workers to get it filled. A crowd of people gathered, and Fisk reiterated his promise to fix things.

titulo: Kingpin — Mayor of New York › Meeting with BB Urich
texto: As a favor for Daniel Blake, Fisk agreed to meet with BB Urich. Fisk remarked that Urich's coverage of his campaign was spot on and he admired that she took him seriously. Fisk then learned that Urich was related to Ben Urich, so Fisk told her that he knew her uncle and that he was a good journalist. Fisk listened to Urich talk about how Commissioner Phil Gallo was resigning, which would hurt Fisk, as many other officers were also going to step down in protest.

titulo: Kingpin — Mayor of New York › Blackmailing Commissioner Gallo
texto:
Fisk arrived at the funeral for Kel Shanahan to speak with Commissioner Phil Gallo about his retirement. Gallo immediately berated Fisk, knowing he has been responsible for the deaths of many other police officers. Fisk attempted to move past the issue, but Gallo explained that he intended to end Fisk's term as mayor. Before walking away, Gallo called Fisk out for not actually loving New York, but was just a monster trying to rewrite his legacy.
Knowing that Gallo would never accept him as mayor, Fisk resorted to his past methods and blackmailed Gallo by getting Buck Cashman to track down Gallo's secret son, using him as leverage. Gallo met with Fisk to declare his retirement, but Fisk revealed his blackmail. Fisk worsened the situation by making major cuts to the NYPD, forcing Gallo to not retire. Fisk then spoke to Cashman about blackmail, claiming that anyone could be swayed by a piece of paper before he referred to his cheesesteak as having been disgusting.

titulo: Kingpin — Mayor of New York › Marriage Counseling
texto: Wilson and Vanessa Fisk agreed to seek marriage counseling, so they met with Heather Glenn. In their first session, Vanessa explained to Glenn how she and Wilson ran their business together, but then Wilson left for a long time, which caused a strain in their marriage. Wilson talked about being attacked by Maya Lopez, and how that required him to distance himself while he recovered. When Glenn asked to hear more from Fisk, he simply stated that he did not want to lose Vanessa.

titulo: Kingpin — Mayor of New York › Five Family Tensions
texto:
During breakfast, Wilson was informed by Sheila Rivera that there was a double homicide at Red Hook Port from a hijacking gone wrong. When Rivera left, Vanessa told Wilson that the Five Families were creating a mess and turning on each other because neither of them were at the head of the table. Vanessa worried that once they killed each other, whoever was left would come after Wilson, but he replied that their former life was no longer a concern for them.
During another session, Wilson and Vanessa spoke privately while Heather Glenn stepped outside, with Vanessa revealing that she sent Buck Cashman to settle the feud between the Five Families. Wilson expressed his concern of not being able to trust Vanessa, but she explained that she wanted to keep the peace. Wilson felt that peace needed to be broken and to let chaos reign so that a stronger order could be built. Vanessa accused Wilson of punishing her for her affair, but Wilson claimed he was not.

titulo: Kingpin — Mayor of New York › Addressing White Tiger
texto: When the trial of Hector Ayala ended in a not-guilty verdict, Fisk called on Daniel Blake to schedule another interview with himself and BB Urich. On the record, he disavowed Ayala and the result of the case, declaring vigilantism an affront to the rule of law. He told Urich that he intended to make good on his campaign promise: to bring justice to New York City 's vigilantes and let the rule of law prevail.

titulo: Kingpin — Mayor of New York › Talking about Adam
texto:
In another session with Heather Glenn, it was suggested they discuss Vanessa Fisk 's affair with Adam, although Wilson was uncomfortable with the matter. Wilson stated that it was a betrayal, but Vanessa responded that Wilson leaving her was also a betrayal.
Wilson listened as Vanessa talked about what drew her to Adam, as well as how her father's behavior crushed her mother and that she did not want to feel the same, as Wilson leaving hurt her. Wilson was surprised to learn this, as Vanessa had never told him. Wilson revealed to Glenn that he confronted Adam, claiming that they just talked and he expressed how important Vanessa was to him. Wilson lied about not knowing where Adam was currently. Glenn the concluded the session by telling them that forgiveness was the only way forward. Before leaving, Glenn asked to speak with Vanessa alone, so Wilson left the room.

titulo: Kingpin — Mayor of New York › Red Hook Pitch
texto:
Fisk brought Sheila Rivera, Daniel Blake, and Buck Cashman to Red Hook Port, where he explained to them his intention to transform it into a new industrial district. Fisk wanted Blake to set up a press conference immediately to make his announcement, but Rivera stopped them, reminding Fisk that there was a process they needed to go through first.
As Rivera explained how city government worked, she brought up the recent mob shooting, which has made people uneasy about the location. Committed to doing things the right way, Fisk asked Rivera on how they needed to start, so Rivera detailed the timeline of steps needed to be completed, which Fisk accepted. Speaking privately with Cashman, Fisk was advised on the situation with the Five Families, being told that it would only end with one of the heads being sentenced or all of them dying.

titulo: Kingpin — Mayor of New York › Dealing with a Leak
texto:
Fisk was taken to Lincoln Middle School, where he sat in a classroom and painfully listened to children sing " We Built This City," much to his displeasure. When they finished, the teacher went to introduce the next song, but Fisk quickly stopped her, telling them they had to leave. Arriving at the Latvian Cultural Center, Sheila Rivera informed Fisk someone had leaked his recycling project, so he ordered her to summon a meeting. Fisk then went upstairs and listened as the Latvian delegation performed a Latvian version of "We Built This City."
Returning to his office at New York City Hall, Fisk yelled at his staff, assuring them that he would find out which one of them leaked the information. Daniel Blake came forward and confessed to being the leak, so Fisk ordered everyone out of the room. Rivera stayed, and before Fisk could say anything, Blake apologized and expressed his deep respect for Fisk, stating that he would still support him no matter what happened to him. Fisk was taken aback by Blake's loyalty, and in a calmed state, Fisk told him that he would not fire Blake, as loyalty was hard to come by. Fisk then threatened Blake that if he ever leaked information again, it would be the last thing he ever did.

titulo: Kingpin — Mayor of New York › Discussing Forgiveness
texto:
During dinner with Vanessa Fisk, she talked about their session with Heather Glenn, which Wilson was aware that Vanessa was asked if she felt safe in her marriage. Vanessa honestly told Wilson that she told Glenn she did feel safe. Vanessa asked Wilson if she should feel safe, so Wilson told her that he had learned many things from his father, but not forgiveness, which he was trying to do. Wilson expressed his desire for things to go back to how they were between them.
Later that night, Fisk made his way down to his basement where he was keeping Adam prisoner in a cage. As Fisk walked through the basement, he passed the Rabbit in a Snowstorm painting, and sat down at a table, where a full meal was prepared for him. As Fisk poured himself a glass of wine, Adam desperately begged Fisk to let him go, but Fisk ignored him. Fisk recalled Glenn's words about forgiveness being the highest form of love to taunt Adam, who continued to demand his freedom.

titulo: Kingpin — Criminal Enterprise › Expanding the Business
texto:
With Lionel McCoy being arrested for drug possession, Fisk sought to get rid of him, as he was proving to be too much of a liability. He had Landman and Zack to represent McCoy and convince him to take a plea deal, so his contacts at the prison could eliminate him. Fisk was driving around New York City with James Wesley, who informed him that they were facing complications regarding McCoy. Fisk changed the topic and talked to Wesley about possibly expanding into Bitcoin, in light of their cooperation with the Russian Mafia.
As Wesley was hesitant about cryptocurrency, Fisk asked him for suggestions, and Wesley mentioned that he had a friend who ran Scene Contempo Gallery and suggested seeking money in art. Fisk did not have much appreciation for art world, finding it pretentious and lacking in meaning, but decided to give it a try. Later, they found out that Landman and Zack managed to clear McCoy of his charges, so they had to get rid of him the other way. Wesley suggested bringing in Buck Cashman, who had skills they could use, which Fisk agreed to.
Fisk then arrived at the art gallery, which was full at the time due to an exhibition. Wesley told Fisk that he did arrange a more private showing, but the people turned up regardless. Fisk decided not to go in yet, but his attention was caught by Vanessa Marianna, who was curating the exhibition, as Fisk continued to watch her from afar for a while.

titulo: Kingpin — Two Worlds Colliding › Visited by Luca
texto: As Sheila Rivera ran through the day's agenda, Fisk expressed his exhaustion with attending so many black tie events. In his office, Fisk found Luca waiting for him, so he gave him five minutes to state his business before leaving. Fisk told Luca that he needed to pay Viktor what he owed, but Luca disrespectfully refused. Fisk doubled the amount, but Luca remained unfazed, telling Fisk to stay out of the crime world before leaving.

titulo: Kingpin — Two Worlds Colliding › Learning about Muse
texto: Fisk later met with Johnny Santini from sanitation, who informed Fisk about the recent murals appearing around the city were made of blood. Fisk summoned Phil Gallo to his office, who explained that the blood was mixed into paint with an epoxy applied on top to make the murals impervious. Gallo revealed that from the blood was from at least sixty victims, and Fisk ordered him not to alert anyone of Muse, at risk of him going into hiding. Fisk then suggested a change of protocol with the NYPD.

titulo: Kingpin — Two Worlds Colliding › Meeting with New York's Elite
texto:
The night, Wilson got dressed for the meeting with New York 's elite and was joined by Vanessa Fisk, who he informed about Luca 's visit. Wilson then explained how politics has its similarities to the crime world, as it was about finding what someone wanted, and either providing it or withholding it to get them to do anything. However, Vanessa explained that it was different tonight, as Wilson had to ask the elite for money, so she educated him on how to deal with them. As Vanessa helped Wilson with his suit jacket, it ripped, as he had put on some weight.
Fisk met with the elite, and he navigated the room, talking with many people about his new project for Red Hook Port. Fisk met with Artemis Sledge and her husband, who were opposed to the idea. Sledge made it clear that she was aware Fisk made a lot of his fortune from business at Red Hook Port, and that the new project was just a self-serving con to enrich himself. Fisk claimed that he only cared about the city, but Sledge stated that despite his supposed power right now, the elite had the control.
Fisk then spoke with Jack Duquesne, who disagreed with Fisk's stance against vigilantes. Duquesne then told Fisk that his project did not align with the elite's interests. Fisk retorted that the elite knew nothing about making things happen, so Duquesne told him not to underestimate the elite, as they could take away his mayorship. Fisk asked if that was a threat, but Duquesne replied that it was a warning. Fisk regrouped with his wife, telling her that the elite were parasites for rejecting his project.

titulo: Kingpin — Two Worlds Colliding › Creating the Anti-Vigilante Task Force
texto:
Fisk was interrupted by Buck Cashman and Daniel Blake, who showed him the recent mural by Muse. Cashman claimed that Muse was mocking the NYPD, which Fisk felt they could use to his benefit. Fisk met with Phil Gallo the next day to reveal his plan to assemble a task force led by him to deal with the Muse case.
Gallo noticed Fisk had selected all of the corrupt cops, and Fisk explained that they would receive privileges like overtime and no body cameras. Fisk and Cashman went to meet with the selected cops, who were gathered at a warehouse. Fisk told them that Muse needed to be stopped, and that they were the ones to do it, claiming they had shown "initiative" in the past, and praised their "creative thinking." Fisk then revealed that they were all founding members of his Anti-Vigilante Task Force and told them to show their faces as they take the city back.

titulo: Kingpin — Two Worlds Colliding › Attacking Adam
texto:
With everything building up inside of him, Fisk went to visit Adam, bringing an ax with him. Fisk walked up to Adam's cell, telling him that his wife would want him to release Adam, but that he could not do that. Fisk expressed that they had a shared experience, and spoke about how using a tool had aided him in fights when he was younger.
Fisk opened the cell and threw the ax to Adam for him to use against Fisk in a fight. Adam grabbed the ax and angrily swung at Fisk, who quickly knocked Adam down. Adam got back up and swung again, but Fisk was able to disarm him and proceeded to smash Adam down onto the table. With Adam subdued, Fisk began savagely beating him, punching his face several times. Fisk ended the fight by bashing Adam's head into a brick pillar. Fisk dragged Adam back into his cell and sat at his bed, looking at the wall.

titulo: Kingpin — Two Worlds Colliding › Daredevil's Return
texto:
Fisk invited Buck Cashman and Daniel Blake to his office and stated that the city was afraid of Muse, especially as nothing had been done about him. Blake and Cashman informed Fisk that Angela Del Toro was saved from Muse by Daredevil.
Fisk was unsettled learning that Daredevil had resurfaced, and later spoke to Cashman about the vigilante's return. Cashman wondered if Daredevil's return could be good for the city, but Fisk ranted about how Daredevil destroyed his empire, claiming that he was unjustly arrested because of him. Cashman told Fisk that going after Daredevil could be seen as an abuse of power, but he replied that he had a duty to protect the city.
Fisk was visited by Angie Kim, who revealed her suspicion that Bastian Cooper was Muse based off of what she had found out about his history. Fisk asked Kim about Daredevil's return, so she confirmed that he was back. Fisk dismissed Kim, telling her that he would handle the Muse case. Connor Powell called Fisk and reported an encounter he had with Daredevil in Muse's lair, and that Heather Glenn was Muse's next target. Fisk ordered the Anti-Vigilante Task Force to find Muse and save Glenn.
Fisk arrived at Glenn's office, where Cole North informed him that Muse had already been killed before the Task Force arrived, stating that Daredevil had been there. Unwilling to let a vigilante be responsible for defeating a serial killer, Fisk told North to take credit for stopping Muse. Fisk set up a press conference, standing alongside the Task Force, to declare that he had kept his promise to the city.

titulo: Kingpin — Two Worlds Colliding › A Marriage Repaired
texto:
Wilson was informed from his wife that Luca intended to kill him, so they set up an ambush, with Vanessa giving Luca Wilson's location at a restaurant. While Wilson was having dinner, Luca approached him from behind but was quickly shot in the head by Buck Cashman. Wilson casually thanked Cashman and then asked him to call Vanessa and see if she wanted any food brought home.
Wilson brought Vanessa to Red Hook Port, where he told her that his project had now received its funding. As they walked, Wilson acknowledged the good Vanessa did for his empire, leading her to wonder why he wanted to throw it away. Wilson clarified that he was simply transforming his empire and that Vanessa's work was responsible for his project coming to fruition. They briefly talked about Luca before Wilson brought up the reason he brought Vanessa to Red Hook Port.
Wilson entered his dungeon and showed Vanessa to the cage he had been keeping Adam in. Wilson noted that he kept his promise and did not kill Adam, who continued to beg for freedom. Wilson yelled at Adam to stop talking and expressed that he could not live without Vanessa. Gesturing at the key and a gun on the table, Wilson witnessed Vanessa pick up the gun and repeatedly shoot Adam, killing him. Wilson held Vanessa, promising to never leave again, and the two then embraced.

titulo: Kingpin — Two Worlds Colliding › Promoting Daniel Blake
texto: Fisk called a meeting in his office to celebrate the recent victories of his Anti-Vigilante Task Force. Sheila Rivera noted the controversy with their excessive force, but Fisk defended that their methods were effective. Fisk acknowledged Daniel Blake 's successful intimidation on BB Urich, and decided to promote him to Deputy Mayor for Communications. Rivera objected, but Fisk dismissed her and revealed that he found out his desk belonged to Fiorello La Guardia.

titulo: Kingpin — Anti-Vigilante Campaign › Black & White Ball
texto:
Wilson hosted an inaugural ball at Gracie Mansion to benefit the Red Hook Port Revitalization Project, with the Anti-Vigilante Task Force stationed as security. In addition to his staff attending, Wilson extended invitations out to BB Urich, Phil Gallo, Heather Glenn, as well as New York 's elite that had previously dismissed him, including Artemis Sledge and Jack Duquesne. Now wearing a white suit, Wilson proudly stood before his guests with Vanessa Fisk.
As Wilson greeted his guests, he noticed the arrival of Matt Murdock. Duquesne went up to Wilson, who asked to speak with him privately. In another room, Wilson listened to Duquesne comment on underestimating him back at the fundraiser before bringing up funding for his project. Duquesne went to refuse, but Wilson cut him off, revealing that he knew Duquesne was the vigilante, Swordsman. Wilson threatened to send his Task Force after him, forcing Duquesne to comply with supporting the project.
Wilson spotted a reporter taking a picture of him, so he ordered Connor Powell to deal with him. Wilson met with more of the elite and proceeded to threaten them into supporting his project. Later on, Wilson saw Murdock heading directly for him, but the confrontation was interrupted when a spotlight was cast on Wilson. Vanessa arrived at Wilson's side and told him it was time for their first dance. The couple took to the middle of the room and began dancing, and were soon joined by others, including Murdock and Glenn. As they all danced, Wilson whispered so only Murdock would hear, stating that there would be consequences for his return as Daredevil.
Buck Cashman informed Wilson that Bullseye had escaped from prison. Hearing this news, Vanessa went to confess something to Wilson, but he stopped her, not wanting Murdock to hear. Murdock bumped into them and began dancing with Vanessa, leaving Wilson with Glenn. Wilson spoke with Glenn, mentioning Murdock's history with vigilantes. Suddenly, Murdock dove in front of Wilson and was shot in the shoulder by Bullseye, saving Wilson's life. Wilson dropped Murdock and retreated to safety with Vanessa.

titulo: Kingpin — Anti-Vigilante Campaign › Putting Plans in Motion
texto:
Wilson and Vanessa Fisk were escorted to their room, where Vanessa went to confess, but Wilson stopped her, revealing that he knew she hired Bullseye to kill Foggy Nelson. Wilson explained that they would be able to move billions through Red Hook Port, with the police and the gangs under his control as the mayor.
Following Bullseye's escape after the attack, Fisk summoned Buck Cashman, Sheila Rivera, Daniel Blake, Phil Gallo, and a few members from the Anti-Vigilante Task Force to his office to order a hunt on Bullseye and all vigilantes. Gallo objected to Fisk's advocation for lethal force. Fisk then ordered for the city to be closed off, but Rivera stated that could only be done if there was a real threat to public safety.
Fisk ended the meeting and told everyone to leave except for Cashman, who informed Fisk that Matt Murdock was in stable condition at Metro-General Hospital. Cashman felt that Murdock saving Fisk complicated matters, but Fisk disagreed and ordered Cashman to kill Murdock. Later, Fisk informed Rivera that the city was at a tipping point and that it needed a push, and ordered her to find anyone in his staff that was not loyal and fire them. Fisk then had the power to the entire city shut off.

titulo: Ulysses Klaue — Arms Dealer › Early Criminal Activities
texto:
Born in the Netherlands, Ulysses Klaue began his criminal activities by operating as an arms dealer and assassin-for-hire primarily in South Africa. Throughout the course of his life, Klaue had an increasingly unstable hatred for Wakanda, as his great-grandfather was killed by a Black Panther in the 19th century. Around this time, he affiliated with a criminal agency known as Intelligencia.
Klaue was paid ten million dollars to assassinate T'Chaka at the Bilderberg Conference when he refused to negotiate about Wakanda's resources. When the attack failed, Klaue was then placed on S.H.I.E.L.D. 's radar as a potential threat to world security.

titulo: Ulysses Klaue — Work with Killmonger › Betrayed and Murdered
texto:
Klaue was taken into an old junkyard where their getaway plane was waiting, as he and Erik Killmonger discussed if he always sold to the CIA like he had done with Everett Ross, as Klaue explained he simply sold to the highest bidder. Klaue had then expressed his thoughts to return to Johannesburg, South Africa to continue all his criminal activities, while also promising that while he would lay low for some time he would still ensure Killmonger would get his money.
While loading the equipment and the artifact on the plane, Killmonger asked to be transported to Wakanda, but due to the friction between him and T'Challa, Klaue had refused. With this, Killmonger then shot Klaue's henchman Limbani through the back of the head. Seeing the betrayal, Klaue then quickly retaliated by taking Linda, Killmonger's girlfriend, hostage as he threatened to execute her. Reassuring Linda that it would be alright, Killmonger shot through her to get to Klaue.
However, the bullet did not successfully go through Linda and Klaue was able to flee for his life. Having been wounded by the impact of the bullet, Klaue ran through the junkyard but struggled to stay on his feet before taking cover and waiting for the perfect shot to execute Killmonger. Whilst hiding behind the wreck of a car, Klaue opened fire on Killmonger but had ended up being shot directly into the stomach instead, falling backwards in utter agony and dropping his gun.
While Klaue bled out, Killmonger approached and revealed the tattoo indicating his royal status after Klaue revealed a brand on his neck as a result of his previous Attack on Wakanda. Realizing that Killmonger was actually N'Jadaka, the claimant for the Wakandan throne, Klaue began laughing at him, having previously thought him nothing more than a deluded American. Annoyed and losing his patience as Klaue had continued to laugh, N'Jadaka then shot Klaue in the head.

titulo: Ulysses Klaue — Legacy › Post-Mortem
texto: With Klaue dead, Erik Killmonger bagged his corpse in a body bag. Upon arriving at Wakanda 's border in the getaway plane, Killmonger presented Klaue's corpse to the Border Tribe leader W'Kabi. Klaue's body was then presented to the Golden Tribe, using it as a token to prove himself worthy of the throne.

titulo: Ulysses Klaue — Arms Dealer › Attack on Wakanda
texto: In 1992, Klaue was hired by Prince N'Jobu of the Golden Tribe to go out and steal a small cache of vibranium, as a means to give vibranium to oppressed minorities. Although his attack was not entirely successful, he managed to steal a quarter-ton of the precious metal which was valued at ten thousand dollars per ounce; over two billion dollars' worth. However, after N'Jobu's involvement resulted in his death at T'Chaka 's claws, Klaue was free to sell the vibranium he had stolen for his own profit. Klaue was eventually found by the Wakandans, who branded his neck with the symbol for 'thief' as punishment for stealing the vibranium, although managed to escape. He then became a fugitive of Wakanda and the personal target of T'Chaka for many years as he remained on the run.

titulo: Ulysses Klaue — Arms Dealer › Meeting Contacts
texto: Operating off of the African coast, Klaue attended arms conventions to sell the vibranium and met Tony Stark, where the two exchanged words. He also met with Baron Wolfgang von Strucker and was made aware of Strucker's involvement with Hydra and that Pietro and Wanda Maximoff received their powers through Strucker's experiments.

titulo: Ulysses Klaue — Arms Dealer › Threatened by the Maximoffs
texto:
In 2015, while onboard his own ship Churchill at the Salvage Yard, Klaue was on the phone with one of his buyers, threatening him for a poor deal, noting that he did not care about all the man's excuses that he was swindled as Klaue had sent six short range missiles and was not satisfied with the result. Klaue threatened the man's life before hanging up.
Just as Klaue was continuing another conversation with a minister about their work together, the lights in the facility were cut out before Klaue could conclude their deal. Unsure what this could mean, Klaue took a handgun and readied himself for a firefight. However, before he could even react, Pietro Maximoff ran into the room and disarmed him of his bullets, moving too fast for Klaue to defend himself as he stood shocked by Maximoff's demonstration of his abilities.
Klaue found himself face to face with Pietro and Wanda Maximoff. Klaue remained confident, mocking the pair for their youth. Klaue explained he was aware of who the pair were, noting that he was saddened to hear of the death of Baron Strucker, teasing the pair when he noticed that they were not aware of Strucker's murder. Klaue continued to mock and belittle the pair before stating he only dealt with the man-in-charge of their current organization.
The man-in-charge turned out to be the artificial intelligence robot named Ultron, who threw Klaue from his office window and told him that there was no man in charge and that he needed his vibranium for his new body. Seeing himself to be vastly outmatched, Klaue relented to Ultron's demands and, with his own mercenary by his side, opened the safe containing the vibranium he had stolen from Wakanda.

titulo: Ulysses Klaue — Arms Dealer › Dealing with Ultron
texto:
Klaue handed Ultron the vibranium he required, but reminded him of its incredible worth and the personal cost he had been through to get it, having been branded by T'Chaka 's soldiers. As Klaue noted that the vibranium was worth billions, Ultron then responded by filling Klaue's World Wide Bank account with billions of dollars, which he hacked from financial databases.
Their alliance was cut short when Klaue overheard Ultron making a comment about keeping his friends and enemies rich and noted that Ultron was quoting Tony Stark, questioning if he was another one of Stark's robotic designs. This comment caused Ultron to go into a rage as he deemed it an insult to be compared to Stark in any way, claiming that Stark's designs were hollow men and insisting Stark was nothing as he furiously grabbed Klaue's arm.
Without warning, the enraged Ultron then sliced off Klaue's left arm, only for the limb to also be cauterized from bleeding due to Ultron's heated metal hand. While Klaue stepped back, unable to quite grasp what had just happened, Ultron then apologized immediately while Klaue and his Mercenary could only stare on in horror at the assault. Despite apologizing, Ultron's rage continued as he demanded not to be compared to Stark and kicked Klaue down the stairs.
Knowing he stood no chance in a battle with Ultron, Klaue made his escape. When the Avengers then arrived to confront Ultron and the Maximoff twins, Klaue escaped the scene, clutching the remainder of his amputated arm. Klaue ordered his own soldiers to kill both the Avengers, Ultron and the Maximoff twins, leading to a battle in which Ultron had escaped with all the Vibranium and Klaue's soldiers were quickly defeated by the combined efforts of the Avengers.

titulo: Ulysses Klaue — Work with Killmonger › Stealing Vibranium Weapons
texto:
In the wake of losing his left arm to Ultron, Klaue had converted a vibranium mining tool from Wakanda into a prosthetic arm. He also became a Soundcloud rapper in his spare time, producing enough content for a mixtape. In 2016, Klaue and Erik Killmonger teamed up to find vibranium weapons to sell onto the black market. Using his cover as a paramedic, Klaue followed Killmonger to the Museum of Great Britain where Killmonger poisoned Fiona Thomas, waiting for Klaue and Limbani to arrive.
As he went to aid the poisoned the museum director, both Klaue and Limbani then pulled out their firearms and executed all but one of the security guards. Putting away his weapon, Klaue then told the guard he would be allowed to go free, but instead Klaue had shot him in the back of the head just while he had tried to flee, telling Killmonger that spreading out the crime scene would help them appear to actually be amateur thieves rather than some professional mercenaries.
Killmonger then took Klaue to see the specific axe on display which they were looking for, with Klaue using his new prosthetic hand to shatter the glass in order to steal it. While Killmonger had looked on, Klaue used this prosthetic to remove the rust before they confirmed that the axe was indeed from Wakanda and had been made from vibranium, telling Killmonger that they would be rich while breaking the axe head from the wooden handle so he could steal it.
Once they had their axe, Killmonger recommended that they sell it quickly, but Klaue indicated that the axe already had a buyer. While both Limbani and Klaue packed the axe away, Killmonger noted that whatever they tried the Wakandans would likely turn up to take him into their custody. As Klaue indicated that this would simply make the deal even more entertaining for him, Killmonger took the opportunity to take an African mask which he liked.
They then escaped with Linda, pulling Killmonger out on a stretcher before making their escape, with Klaue smiling at the easy and highly successful raid of the museum. When their robbery became public knowledge, Klaue resurfaced back on Wakanda's radar, and due to the vibranium used in the Battle of Sokovia traced back to him, Okoye was given information that Klaue was going to Busan, South Korea to negotiate their deal with his buyer for the vibranium artifact.

titulo: Ulysses Klaue — Work with Killmonger › Deal at the Jagalchi Casino
texto:
Now seeking to make himself a large profit off the vibranium axe he had successfully stolen with Erik Killmonger 's assistance, Klaue had made contact with someone interested in purchasing it from him and later traveled all the way to Busan, South Korea with the intention to then trade the Wakandan artifact with their buyer in exchange for his suitcase full of diamonds. Klaue also hired several bodyguards to accompany him.
Once Klaue made his arrival at the Jagalchi Market Casino where the trade would take place, he and his men got out of their cars together as Klaue kissed Sophia to the cheek, who was hiding the casino as he entered, with none of Klaue's bodyguards being unchallenged by the casino's security despite their guns setting off the alarms. Klaue then stepped onto the balcony as he scanned the entire room, looking for the man who he would be making his deal with for the diamonds.
The buyer turned out to be CIA agent Everett Ross as Klaue went downstairs and greeted Ross, who immediately made a sarcastic comment regarding Klaue's impressive entourage. When Ross then questioned if Klaue had a mixtape coming out, Klaue jokingly asked one of his bodyguards to give Ross the Soundcloud link so he could listen to it himself, which Ross turned down, insisting that he did not wish to listen to Klaue's own taste in music. Ross then noted how many people Klaue had brought with him, with which Klaue insisted that they were not there to threaten Ross, rubbing Ross' shoulder as he claimed he could do the deal with Ross all by himself.
Klaue then demanded the diamonds he had been promised, as Ross removed Klaue's hand from his shoulder and had another agent bring them over before requesting the vibranium weapon Klaue had also promised. Klaue proceeded to pull the artifact out from his trousers, jokingly claiming that he had considered buying a fancy suitcase but had decided instead to save some money by instead simply putting the vibranium artifact in a simple paper bag for transportation.
Although the deal started out smooth, it was soon sabotaged by the presence of the Dora Milaje, as Klaue's bodyguards were ambushed by Okoye wielding her Vibranium Spear. Realizing the deal was a set-up, Klaue furiously opened fire on Ross, who then used the briefcase of diamonds as his shield to deflect the shots before taking cover behind a table while Klaue demanded that his men get the diamonds to run before they could be captured or killed by the Wakandans.
As he made his escape, Klaue had managed to shoot several guards coming to stop him while avoiding Nakia, before he charged up the stairs and found himself cornered by T'Challa. Realizing he was out of bullets and cornered, Klaue responded by commenting on how much T'Challa now looked like his father before Klaue then activated his prosthetic arm 's sonic cannon, shooting T'Challa who used a table as cover and was knocked off the balcony.
Due to the blast from his prosthetic arm causing money to explode across the casino while also throwing T'Challa down onto a table below, Klaue overlooked the destruction as well as the money falling around, then made a comedic remark about how he had just "made it rain" before hysterically laughing. He then fled the scene via SUV with his men while still excitedly laughing and celebrating their seemingly successful clash against the Wakandan warriors.

titulo: Ulysses Klaue — Work with Killmonger › Captured by Black Panther
texto:
Delighting over the chaos he had caused, Klaue regrouped with his henchmen and made his hasty escape from their Jagalchi Market Casino, excitedly yelling about how awesome the events had been before getting into his car and driving away with his men. However, Klaue soon noticed that the Wakandans were following his convoy with their own vehicles, as Klaue told his driver to put his music on.
Seeing that Nakia and Okoye were catching up with him, Klaue got onto the radio and ordered his men to split up as they drove through Busan, hoping to lose the Wakandans in all the chaos. As they were being chased down, Klaue saw that his men were shooting at Nakia and Okoye, only for their bullets to have no effect on their vibranium car, before Klaue witnessed Okoye getting to the roof and then using her Vibranium Spear to take out the car just behind Klaue's.
Knowing that they were running out of time before Nakia and Okoye caught up to him, Klaue decided to have some fun as he leaned out of his car window and used his prosthetic arm to then fire a blast of energy at the Wakandan's car, which had completely obliterated it as Okoye and Nakia barely survived. However, Black Panther continued chasing down Klaue, who then furiously gave his driver directions in order to escape before the Panther could catch up with him.
As they turned a sharp corner, Klaue took advantage out being out of sight for a moment as Klaue once again leaned out of his car window and his used prosthetic arm to shoot at the car, which destroyed and caused T'Challa to be launched through the air. With their car destroyed, Klaue then momentarily believed he had gotten away without the Wakandans catching him, only T'Challa to then launch himself through the air and rip the wheel off Klaue's car.
Unable to do anything, Klaue's car dramatically crashed as he was launched into the air and violently smashed down onto the ground. The injured Klaue, still desperate to make his escape, managed to crawl out of the broken car door as he saw that T'Challa was still making his way to him. With little option, Klaue fired another energy blast at T'Challa, who then absorbed the blast with his Panther Habit and then ripped Klaue's prosthetic arm off.
T'Challa reminded Klaue of the Attack on Wakanda, while he had also questioned if Klaue thought his people would ever forget that and all of the lives Klaue had taken, as he furiously beat Klaue down and questioned where he had gotten his prosthetic arm from. Klaue simply claimed that the Wakandans never deserved such technology, calling them savages, which only angered T'Challa even more as he pushed Klaue against his broken car.
Seeing that T'Challa was ready to kill him, Klaue begged for mercy as he saw crowds of people gathering around to watch the confrontation. However, before T'Challa could land the killing blow, Everett Ross arrived on the scene along with Nakia and Okoye, who convinced T'Challa not to kill Klaue while the world was watching them. Knowing that he had survived, Klaue smiled at T'Challa before he was then taken into the CIA 's custody.

titulo: Ulysses Klaue — Work with Killmonger › Everett Ross' Interrogation
texto:
Following his capture, Klaue was taken inside the CIA South Korean Black Site in Busan where he was handcuffed to a chair and awaited his questioning. Soon becoming restless while he was waiting to be questioned by the CIA agents, Klaue began teasing T'Challa through the two way mirror, claiming that he could see T'Challa while making kissing noises.
Eventually, Klaue was rejoined by Everett Ross, while he entertained himself by loudly singing " What Is Love." As the interrogation began, Klaue told Ross not to trust the Wakandans, although Ross insisted that he did not trust anybody due to his job before then asking Klaue about his prosthetic arm and where he had gotten it, to which Klaue explained that it was a mining tool which he made some adjustments to, before promising that he could get Ross one if he wanted.
As Ross asked for whoever supplied him with the arm, Klaue made it clear that T'Challa was who he should be looking at, as he confirmed that it was from Wakanda. Seeing Ross was skeptical of this, Klaue asked what he actually knew of it while Ross explained his belief that Wakanda was nothing more than a third world country. Klaue then told Ross that Wakanda was actually the legendary El Dorado which had been secretly hidden in Africa for centuries, while telling him that Wakanda was actually a technological marvel that stayed hidden.
As he went on, Klaue then noted how Wakanda became rich due to mining the vibranium which gave them incredible technology beyond anything their world had ever seen before. Ross, however, remained unconvinced, noting how Klaue had stolen all Wakanda's vibranium from T'Chaka years earlier, which angered Klaue as he explained that he had stolen a tiny piece while Wakanda still had a mountain filled with vibranium which they were mining for thousands of years.
Klaue told Ross that he was still the only outsider who had managed to get into Wakanda and escape with his life and, seeing that Ross was still unsure about what was said, Klaue recommended that Ross speak to T'Challa and ask him what his Panther Habit was made out of, making it clear that it was actually made out of the vibranium and therefore confirmed what Klaue had been saying to him. With that, Ross thought for a moment before picking up his coffee and walking out of the room, leaving Klaue alone in the interrogation room.
While Ross was gone, Klaue waited in the interrogation room on his own for several minutes, before suddenly the wall behind him was blown open as Erik Killmonger stormed inside the room, shooting at the CIA agents. Klaue yelled out in delight as he watched Killmonger mortally wound Ross who had attempted to save Nakia 's life. While Killmonger continued firing into the room, Linda and Limbani went to Klaue and picked up his chair, carrying him outside to the van.
While Killmonger continued firing, and threw a grenade into the room, Klaue laughed hysterically while joking that Linda and Limbani had taken their time in rescuing him. Just as their crew prepared to drive away, Black Panther and Okoye charged out of the room together as they then made a desperate attempt to stop Klaue's escape, only for Killmonger to then subdue the Panther by firing a grenade, before the crew drove away to safety with Klaue who continued laughing.

titulo: Korath — Mission to Sy'gyl
texto:
While working with Starforce, Korath attended a briefing where Yon-Rogg revealed that the Kree were considering ending their war against Xandar. However, they were first tasked with a mission to go to Sy'gyl and receive plans for a Xandarian weapon from a defector. Vers asked why the Kree would risk the potential peace for such a mission, prompting Korath to note that the Kree would need the upper hand if their attempts at peace failed and Yon-Rogg agreed that the plans would grant them that. Yon-Rogg dismissed the team, and Korath watched the rest of the team left before leaving himself. In the hangar, Vers saw their pilot, Sun-Val, and asked who she was. Yon-Rogg told her that she knew the territory, prompting Vers to ask if she was Xandarian. Korath said that she was Kree and ordered Vers to treat Sun-Val as a member of Starforce. Vers saluted Korath, confusing him.
While flying to Sy'gyl, the team was attacked by Kree fighters mistaking them as Xandarian. Vers suggested that they fire back, causing the entire team to look at her. However, Yon-Rogg agreed it would help avoid suspicion, so he passed the order to Sun-Val. During the ensuing battle, a hole formed in the hull, causing air to leave the ship. However, Vers managed to activate the shield and stop the ship from losing too much air. When they entered Sy'gyl's orbit, Korath agreed to Yon-Rogg's order not to encounter Xandarian resistance. As the ship entered the upper atmosphere, Sun-Val commented on the quality of the ship they were flying. Yon-Rogg yelled back that Korath was the one who picked it, making fun of him. Korath got defensive, saying that it was all they could manage and that it was not his fault if it was not comfortable. Yon-Rogg smiled and told Korath he did well, asking Vers for help explaining what he was doing. Vers attempted to tell Korath that Yon-Rogg was busting his chops, but Korath could not hear her over the engine. When the engines cut out, Vers yelled the phrase again, although Korath did not understand what it meant. As the group prepared for their mission, Yon-Rogg called Vers over, where he and Korath told Vers that she would be infiltrating the base alone, confusing her. Korath scolded Vers for questioning her orders, but Yon-Rogg told him to check on weapons with the others, so he left.
As the ship landed, Yon-Rogg opened the hatch and told Starforce that Minn-Erva would be the only one with a gun. They started traversing the planet when Vers joked to herself and Minn-Erva asked what she said. Yon-Rogg told them to be quiet and communicate with hand signals. When Bron-Char saw something that gave the team pause, Yon-Rogg sent Att-Lass to investigate, and he came back reporting that it was a Xandarian ship. The team continued to follow Att-Lass to the Nar'dath mountain region, where Yon-Rogg showed Vers the layout of the building they would be infiltrating. Vers and Att-Lass agreed that the mission appeared to be easy, prompting Korath to scold Vers for not taking the mission seriously. However, Yon-Rogg stood up to Korath, telling him that she knew how serious the mission was. Vers left for the bunker and Minn-Erva spotted three Nova Corps men, so Korath was ordered to stay with Att-Lass in case others arrived while Yon-Rogg and Bron-Char dealt with the Corpsmen. Minn-Erva reported to Korath and Att-Lass when she lost sight of Yon-Rogg and Bron-Char, to which Korath responded that they could not see them either. A Stealth Bomb was dropped on the bunker, which Korath and Att-Lass managed to recover from as they joined Minn-Erva. Att-Lass suggested they get Vers from the bunker, but Korath insisted that they go to the ship. Along the way, they discovered that Sun-Val had been killed.
At the freighter, Minn-Erva attempted to contact their missing teammates to no avail. Korath ordered Minn-Erva and Att-Lass to prepare the ship to leave, prompting a protest from Att-Lass. Korath explained that, as members of Starforce, they would follow their orders to the letter, so Minn-Erva started to get the ship ready. The three were present when Yon-Rogg, Vers, Bron-Char, and Sun-Val appeared. Sun-Val attacked Vers, but Minn-Erva killed her, revealing her to be a Skrull who replaced Sun-Val after killing her. The team then left Sy'gyl and returned to Hala.

titulo: Korath — Kree-Skrull War › Ambush in Torfa
texto:
In 1995, the Starforce received a mission from the Supreme Intelligence, and were dispatched to Torfa. Korath, along with Carol Danvers, Minn-Erva, Bron-Char, Att-Lass, and Yon-Rogg boarded the Helion to await further instructions and receive details on their mission. As they waited, they talked about the mission, Korath believing it to be a Skrull attack.
Minn-Erva inquired Korath if he ever had an encounter with a Skrull soldier, to which he confirmed this, relating to a time in which he confronted a Skrull who simmed his appearance, noting that it was deeply disturbing. Danvers sarcastically asserted that if he looked more attractive, the encounter would not have been disturbing. Korath looked back at her, maintaining a serious pretense, and claimed that he was not laughing at her joke.
As Vers listened to Korath's admission and personal encounter with the enemy, Att-Lass mentioned that he never displayed any signs of humor and sarcasm, but Korath claimed that he laughed on the inside, and Bron-Char complemented Korath's appearance, stating that he was handsome. After Korath thanked Bron-Char, the team's short banter was ended by the abrupt arrival of Yon-Rogg, who instructed them to stop and proceeded to debrief them on their Kree mission.
Yon-Rogg informed them that their mission was to rescue a Kree spy Soh-Larr, whose cover had been blown on Torfa due to an infestation of Skrulls. As Yon-Rogg mentioned that Soh-Larr's cover was blown in light of the bounty that was issued by Talos, the leader of the Skrulls, Korath was warned that the Kree intelligence would be compromised if Soh-Larr was captured. He then told them of the plan, which would be a stealth operation, not to alert any native Torfan citizens.
They then arrived at Torfa and were released from the ship into the water, where they made their way to the distress signal sent out by Soh-Larr. The mission turned out to be an ambush, as a group of Torfans surrounding them revealed their true Skrull form and attacked. During the fight, Korath used his swords to kill many Skrulls, until they retreated to the Helion by the order of Yon-Rogg. However, the Skrulls managed to capture Vers, a prominent new member of Starforce.

titulo: Korath — Kree-Skrull War › Contacted by Vers
texto: Vers managed to escape Skrull captivity and crash-landed on Earth. She then issued contact with the rest of the team, explaining the events. Yon-Rogg told her to wait and ordered the team to travel to her location. After their contact abruptly ended, Korath speculated that if the Skrulls have captured Vers they have changed her mind about the war, stating that she is compromised, but Yon-Rogg remained confident in her, stating that she is stronger than what Korath thinks.

titulo: Korath — Kree-Skrull War › Contacted by Ronan
texto: Some time later, the Starforce were contacted by Ronan the Accuser, who revealed that the Accusers neutralized the situation on Torfa following the ambush on Torfa. Ronan berated the Starforce for their failure, and demanded from Korath the current location of Carol Danvers, noting that the Skrulls needed to be eliminated. As Korath prepared to say something, Yon-Rogg insisted that they were still searching for her. Ronan threatened the Starforce, and promised that the Accusers would take care if the situation if they didn't.

titulo: Korath — Kree-Skrull War › Battle at Mar-Vell's Laboratory
texto: Having learned that Vers had turned against the Kree and thinking she had the Tesseract, the Starforce, including Korath, began a battle with her at Mar-Vell's Laboratory. Korath tried to use his swords against her, but she broke his sword and defeated him, along with his teammates.

titulo: Korath — Quest for the Orb › Ronan's Enforcer
texto: Eventually, Korath volunteered for an experimental Kree weapons programme to genetically and cybernetically enhance himself, and abandoned Starforce. Korath decided to align himself with Thanos, who allowed him to train with Gamora and Nebula, becoming one of the most dangerous and feared warriors in the universe. As the war was ended and the Accusers were demobilized as well, Korath joined Ronan in his revenge quest on Xandar.

titulo: Korath — Quest for the Orb › Encounter with Star-Lord
texto:
Having made a deal with Ronan the Accuser to assist in his own quest for revenge, Thanos sent Korath to work under the Kree for a time. Under the orders of Ronan, Korath led a platoon of Sakaarans to take Nebula and Gamora to Praxius IX when a lead for the Orb appeared there. The lead turned out to be false, and the party left empty-handed. Following up another lead, Korath traveled to Morag to investigate another possible location of the Orb.
While hunting for the Orb on Morag, Korath found that Peter Quill had already located and successfully stolen the Orb. Korath and his soldiers took him hostage while Quill attempted to talk his way out of the situation by first claiming he was unaware of what he had found, although Korath noted that he was in fact clearly a member of the Ravagers. Quill then tried claiming to be a legendary outlaw going by the name Star-Lord, who Korath had never heard of.
Tired of his foolishness, Korath refused to listen and ordered his squad of Sakaarans to take Quill and the Orb back to Ronan for questioning on board the Dark Aster. However, Quill managed to escape by shooting Korath in the chest with his Quad Blasters and killing his Sakaaran soldiers with a Plasma Sphere. Korath survived due to his own enhanced skin and body armor and attempted to kill his attacker by shooting back at him.
Quill escaped through the hole in the wall and Korath gave chase across the surface of the planet. Quill was just able to get to his ship by using a Gravity Mine to incapacitate Korath's soldiers. While Quill attempted to start his ship, Korath ordered all of his men to build a cannon. By the time the cannon was ready, Quill used his ship to escape back to Xandar as Korath tried and failed to shoot him out of the sky, as he watched furiously as Quill flew away.
Korath returned to the Dark Aster and informed Ronan, Gamora and Nebula of events on Morag and of the outlaw Star-Lord, who his sources had informed him was planning to sell the Orb to Broker on Xandar. Ronan ordered Gamora to travel to Xandar and retrieve the Orb from Quill when he attempted to sell it to Broker, while Korath remained behind and continued to command Ronan's army, being deemed unworthy to find the Orb.

titulo: Korath — Quest for the Orb › Betraying Thanos
texto:
Having successfully retaken the Orb from the traitorous Gamora, Korath was present when Ronan the Accuser presented his prize to the Mad Titan, with Korath holding it up for Thanos to see. However, Ronan decided to betray Thanos and keep the Orb's power to himself, despite Korath warning that Thanos was too powerful to dare challenge.
The Orb's power caused explosions on the Dark Aster as Ronan consumed the power into his Universal Weapon and told Thanos that after he had destroyed Xandar, he would kill the Mad Titan himself. Korath was disturbed by this due to how extremely powerful Thanos is, and questioned his master's decision as he believed that Thanos was the most powerful being in the universe. However, Ronan reassured him that with the Orb's power, Thanos would not pose a threat.

titulo: Korath — Quest for the Orb › Battle of Xandar
texto:
During the Battle of Xandar in which Ronan the Accuser 's forces had attempted to finally exact their revenge against the Xandarians, the Dark Aster was then attacked by the combined forces of the Yondu Ravager Clan and the Nova Corps. Korath led his unit of Sakaaran soldiers in defending the Dark Aster, as they matched through the ship, they encountered Star-Lord, Drax the Destroyer and Groot who had boarded the ship with the intention of killing Ronan and stopping his attack.
A fight ensued between Korath's forces and the Guardians of the Galaxy, in which Korath personally fought Star-Lord, seeking revenge for their earlier battle. Korath soon easily over-powered his human foe and mocked his attempts to kill Ronan and reclaim the Orb. As Quill was thrown across space, Korath stood over him and noted that he would ensure none of them would ever make it to Ronan's location as he and their men would kill them all first.
Their fight was interrupted when Drax the Destroyer defended Quill and attacked Korath. Korath briefly gained the upper hand, but the tables were turned and Korath was pinned against a wall by the incredibly powerful Drax. He then proceeded to finally kill Korath, as he tore out a cybernetic part of his head while reciting his attempt at a metaphor while Korath's body spasmed from the electric shocks and he dropped to the ground dead.
