titulo: Sersi — Creation
texto: Sersi was built and programmed by Arishem the Judge, and was sent to multiple planets to protect and help evolve sentient life forms from the Deviants, powering a Celestial seed inside the planet, which would absorb the energy made from the sentient lifeforms. Eventually, the Emergence would occur, destroying the planet in the process. Upon finishing their mission, the Eternals would be sent back to the World Forge to have their memories erased and reset.

titulo: Sersi — The Emergence › Chosen by Ajak
texto: Sersi, Ikaris, and Sprite traveled to Ajak's Homestead in South Dakota to inform their leader what happened. However, they found her house empty, and Sersi found her corpse out in the back. Ajak's Celestial Communication Sphere rose from her chest and flew into Sersi when the latter was saying her goodbyes, causing Sersi to briefly communicate with Arishem, who told her it was almost time for something. Pressed by Sprite and Ikaris to confirm what happened, Sersi didn't know how to use the sphere properly and can't replicate the event, and Ikaris suggested she may have Mahd Wy'ry like Thena, causing Sersi to look sharply at him.

titulo: Sersi — The Emergence › Reuniting the Eternals
texto:
The trio traveled to Mumbai next and witnessed Kingo shooting a Bollywood dance number for his movie Shaandar Dastan-e-Ikaris. Sersi in particular looked amused as she watched the whole scene, though she grew somber after it ended as they needed to tell Kingo about Ajak 's death.
Aboard Kingo's Jet en route to Australia to retrieve Gilgamesh and Thena, Sersi was interviewed by the Bollywood star, who was making a documentary about the Eternals. Caught offguard because she was busy fiddling with her phone, Sersi listed the many times she turned rocks into other things before Kingo cut her off. Since they did not age, she had taken a picture of Ikaris with an age filter app and showed it to him, thinking he looked quite good even as an old man.
Gilgamesh already slew a Deviant when Sersi and the others arrived to tell him about the recent happenings. She told him of the Deviant in London that Ikaris had difficulty killing. Sersi tried to approach Thena next, though Gilgamesh warned that she's unstable at the moment because of the attack.
Gilgamesh prepared a feast for his visitors. When the conversation shifted to the issue of Ajak's successor, Sersi excused herself from the table to get some air. She investigated Thena's artwork of ominous imagery produced during one of her episodes, and Gilgamesh told Sersi they were depictions of Centuri-Six, a planet where Thena supposedly lived before. Hearing massive global quakes wracked this planet before everyone there was killed, Sersi surmised the global quakes happening to Earth foretold the same disaster. As she wasn't able to use the Celestial Communication Sphere again despite numerous attempts to speak with Arishem, Gilgamesh advised her to relax and listen instead of forcing it.

titulo: Sersi — The Emergence › Learning the Truth
texto:
Following Gilgamesh 's words, Sersi cleared her mind and successfully initiated a lengthy audience with Arishem. She learned about the Eternals ' true nature as synthetic beings sent to cull Arishem's failed experiments the Deviants while making sure the sentient population of Earth grows to trigger the Emergence of a new Celestial. She learned about the place of Celestials in the universe and the sacrifices that come with it. The revelations left her stunned and in tears.
Sharing what she learned with the group, Sersi opined that they had to stop the Emergence: innocents sacrificed for the greater good always turned out to be a mistake. She advocated for a solution where nobody died, like delaying Tiamut the Communicator 's rise while the Eternals looked for ways to transport all humans offworld.

titulo: Sersi — The Emergence › Ambush at Druig's Compound
texto:
Druig 's mind control powers seemed like a way forward for Sersi's preferred solution to the problem, so the group set out to his compound in the Amazon Rainforest to retrieve him. While apprising Druig of recent events Sersi's cellphone rang loudly as Dane was trying to call her, forcing her to put it on silent. Druig was upset and needed time to think, so Sersi told the others to wait for him to come around.
Sersi finally put Dane Whitman on video call during the wait, and she tried to tell him the world was ending. Dane had too many questions about her role in history, like if she was involved in the stories of King Midas, Confucius, and Aristotle, so she just advised him to make amends with his estranged uncle. She lost the signal though, causing her to utter aloud that he's breaking up, at which Ikaris jokingly perked up to confirm what he heard.
Hearing her ex-husband's concerns for her if Arishem found out what they were trying to do, Sersi assured Ikaris she's not afraid of the consequences. She finally asked him why he abandoned her, and Ikaris was about to confess when a flying Deviant snatched him away.
The Deviants have begun attacking the Eternals at Druig's compound. Sersi herded the local humans to Druig's church and fortified the wooden structure by turning it to metal, though a Deviant's tail sent her flying to a house just as she finished. Sersi recovered and assisted Druig in fighting a beast by turning part of a tree trunk to water then turning the tree into metal, which crashed onto the Deviant. Druig was mind-controlling some humans to fire guns in unison at the Deviants, though Sersi convinced him to let them go.
Ikaris went back to assist the team at the camp, though he had trouble dealing with a Deviant that pinned him to the ground. Sersi transformed a tree branch to metal and stabbed the creature, though it retaliated by tossing her into a pool. The Deviant followed underwater, and in desperation Sersi tried to transmute it. Though she thought she could not transform sentient beings, her powers worked, and the Deviant turned into a tree, surprising her.
The skirmish ended with most Deviants killed while Gilgamesh was fatally injured. Following a funeral for the fallen Eternal, Sersi approached Druig and convinced him to come with them again. Druig did not have enough power to subdue a Celestial, so Sersi suggested they need Phastos next for ideas.

titulo: Sersi — The Emergence › Returning to the Domo
texto:
Sersi and Ikaris visited Phastos in Chicago to bring him in again to the fold. The duo became curious about Phastos' domestic life, and tried to observe him discreetly as he interacted with his son Jack. Phastos approached them in the living room, and they both scrambled to look innocent: Sersi grabbed a Star Wars coloring book, which Ikaris snatched away and pretended to read, forcing her to grab a mug. The technopath initially refused to help and claimed he doesn't use his powers anymore, so Ikaris tested it by using his eye beams at a door (it was shielded with Phastos' tech) and banging his fist on the table (it wasn't vibranium, so it broke). Sersi was surprised at both gestures, and Phastos rhetorically asked her how she was able to put up with her ex-husband's behavior for over 5,000 years. In the end, Phastos went with Sersi and Ikaris after some convincing from his husband Ben.
The Eternals went to Iraq next to retrieve the Domo so Phastos could use its lab to brainstorm a solution for the Emergence. He came up with the Uni-Mind which would allow Eternals to share their powers so one of them became strong enough to stop Tiamut. Makkari, who was already inside the ship when the Eternals boarded it, asked what happens if they succeed, and Sersi told her they should find humans a new home on another planet. Sprite was skeptical because of the time frame, though Sersi was hopeful it would go quicker with their help. Kingo had concerns about accidentally killing Tiamut the Communicator and asked Ikaris to vouch for him, though Ikaris deferred to Sersi's authority as Prime Eternal after Ajak.
While Phastos was finishing his designs, Sersi approached Ikaris outside the ship. She found him in the same spot where they first made love outside Babylon millennia ago. She knew Ikaris opposed their plan to stop the Emergence, but she tried to convince him Arishem's way of birthing Celestials was archaic and unnecessarily wasting lives. She resented having to start over and over without memories or free will, always arriving at the same violent end. Ikaris confessed he only wanted to remember their life together whatever happens to them after the Emergence, so Sersi held his hand in response.

titulo: Sersi — The Emergence › Ikaris' Betrayal
texto:
Returning to the Domo, the Celestial Communication Sphere inside Sersi flared up, signalling to her that the Emergence had begun. She badgered Phastos how much longer would figuring out the Uni-Mind take. Later, she found Ikaris putting on his armor in advance, who ominously told her he wanted her to remain ignorant about the Emergence and he regretted Ajak choosing her as their leader. When he sabotaged Phastos' workplace, it dawned on Sersi that Ikaris already knew about the Emergence way before they reunited in London. He confirmed he already knew their true mission to Earth since after they left Babylon, and it was the main reason he abandoned her as he could not bear to tell her the truth. Reduced to tears, Sersi wondered why Ajak chose her instead of Ikaris, and could not believe that Ikaris had their leader killed.
Ikaris, Sprite, Kingo, and Karun Patel. The former two would oppose the others and let the Emergence happen while Kingo didn't want to fight his family over it. Druig suggested they need a backup plan in case he failed, and pointed out Sersi can transform sentient beings now. She vehemently opposed the idea because using her powers would mean killing Tiamut, though Thena convinced her to reconsider, using her great love for humans as her motivation.
Phastos figured out they could use Sersi's communication sphere to facilitate the Uni-Mind, and Sersi allowed him to take it from her to build bracelets for the Eternals still around.

titulo: Sersi — The Emergence › Stopping the Emergence
texto:
Using the Domo to travel to the Emergence point in the Indian Ocean, Sersi, Makkari, and Druig initiated the Uni-Mind near a volcano. Ikaris interrupted the process, took Druig out of commission, and damaged the Domo, causing it to crash. Sersi was in the way of the ship, so Makkari hastily carried her off. The Uni-Mind was initially successful, though without Druig the volcano began erupting again, forcing Sersi to transmute falling molten rocks in her way.
With no other options, Sersi decided to use her powers to stop Tiamut, and ordered Phastos, Makkari, and Thena to keep Ikaris busy. On the way to a vantage point near the volcano, Sprite conjured up an image of Ajak to talk to Sersi, telling her she was not powerful enough and she was not a killer. She was then stabbed in the back by Sprite, who ranted about her hidden jealousy of Sersi and all the things she missed because she was stuck in the body of a child. Fortunately, Druig survived Ikaris' attack and knocked Sprite unconscious, though it still fell to Sersi to execute the backup plan as he could no longer put Tiamut to sleep. Sersi transformed Sprite's dagger to water and kept going.
When Tiamut had risen enough to expose parts of himself, Sersi began turning him to stone. Ikaris could no longer be delayed nor restrained, so he flew to her and attempted to kill her. However, he couldn't do it because he still loved her, allowing Sersi to trigger the Uni-Mind and complete the transmutation. All Eternals on-site joined the Uni-Mind, even Ikaris, Sprite, and Tiamut himself.
In the aftermath, Sersi regenerated her suit and wounds where Sprite stabbed her. She accepted Ikaris' apology for his deeds, and watched him fly off to the sun to commit suicide. She then walked down to the beach to rejoin the other Eternals, and told Phastos how she was able to fully transform the Celestial. She still had some energy left from the link. She offered to turn Sprite human, though she warned her she'll no longer be immortal. Sprite accepted and touched Sersi's outstretched hand.

titulo: Sersi — The Emergence › Taken by Arishem the Judge
texto:
Two weeks later, Sersi saw Sprite off to begin her new life as a human, and told her to visit often. She harbored no hard feelings for Sprite as she understood her reasons, and hugged her farewell. However, she confessed to Kingo she often wondered if killing Tiamut was the right thing to do, and he assured her they all followed their hearts for what they believed was right.
Sersi informed Dane Whitman of their adventures later, noting she still couldn't transform him into a giraffe unless she happened to be in a Uni-Mind again. Dane started telling her about his family history, though Sersi became petrified and unable to move except for her eyes. The clouds parted and Arishem had arrived over Earth, placing restraints on Sersi, Kingo, and Phastos, and flying them off the planet to the palm of his gigantic hand. Hearing their memories were to be analyzed and that Arishem would return to Earth to render judgement, the three could do nothing but dread what came next as their creator transported them all through a spatial distortion.

titulo: Sersi — Protecting Humanity › Ariving in Mesopatamia
texto:
Sersi and the rest of the Eternals were sent to Earth in an inactive state on the Domo. Once awoken, the Eternals were provided with suits to wear before arriving at the planet. During planetfall, Sersi admired the beauty of Earth, and then introduced herself to Ikaris. Not being one of the Eternals' main fighters, Sersi waited as the others fought Deviants menacing a primitive human tribe in Mesopotamia.
When the Deviants attacking the humans were defeated, Sersi disembarked from the Domo, and the Eternals presented themselves to the race they were assigned to protect. As a gesture of goodwill, Sersi picked up a flint knife, transformed it into a more durable blue and gold one, then handed it over to a local boy who recently lost his father to the Deviants.
Sersi took a liking to the humans; mingling with them, assisting them in little ways, learning their customs and languages to talk with them. While the more combat-oriented Eternals subdued Deviant threats to population centers Sersi helped the local women prepare food and used her powers to irrigate the land. When the Eternals settled in Babylon, they held a party. Sersi found herself dancing with the civilians while the other Eternals did their own things.

titulo: Sersi — Protecting Humanity › Marrying Ikaris
texto:
Sersi and Ikaris developed an attraction to each other in their thousands of years of service. In 575 BC, following the defeat of Deviants around Babylon, Sersi indulged Ikaris' assistance in her humanitarian activities, albeit she was amused at his attempts at telling her how beautiful she was in Babylonian. Regardless, she liked him enough to spend the night with him, and they both expressed their love for each other.
In 400 AD, Sersi and Ikaris were married in a lavish ceremony in the Gupta Empire. All of the Eternals were in attendance and beaming with joy, except for Sprite.

titulo: Sersi — Protecting Humanity › Battle of Beijing
texto: In 1520, Sersi and Ikaris were in Beijing when suddenly, they were attacked by a Deviant. Sersi rebuilt the Great Wall of China while Ikaris battled it along with the Sacred Dragon. She exclaimed how she wants to see it when it's finished. She then took a dagger and threw it at the deviant, severing its tongue. After the battle, they went to a mountain where they found a Deviants Nest. They realized that all of the deviants were controlled by one, powerful one named Kappa. They then defeated them, ending the 500 Year War.

titulo: Sersi — Protecting Humanity › Retelling
texto: One day, Sersi was holding the Onikirimaru when Makkari barged into the room saying Ikaris was looking for Sersi. She exclaimed that the sword was hers, but Sersi said it wasn't, but she admittedly doesn't know where it's from. They then asked Sprite who retold the story of Heian-Kyo. The Eternals then took turns asking her to retell stories from the 500 Year War.

titulo: Sersi — Protecting Humanity › Defeating the Deviants
texto:
In 1521 AD, the Eternals engaged Deviants in battle around Tenochtitlan. Phastos explained to Sersi that the beasts would be completely eradicated from Earth once they defeated them. However, a concurrent war between conquistadors and native mesoamericans caused Thena to go berserk. It was Sersi who first noticed something wrong with her, and she would have been fully stabbed had Makkari not raced her out of the way in time. She still injured her shoulder from a glancing strike from Thena's halberd, however.
The Eternals regrouped to a temple in the city to assess Thena's condition. They believed she had Mahd Wy'ry, which Sersi thought was a mythical disease. With the Deviants gone, Ajak advised the Eternals to split up and live a life among the humans until they're called together again, something Sersi took to heart.

titulo: Sersi — Protecting Humanity › Playing Speed
texto:
Sersi and Ikaris went to a forest, where they decided to play a game of speed. Ikaris commented about taking it easy on Ikaris, prompting Sersi to taunt him. Ikaris started the game and Sersi began running as Ikaris flew. Sersi ran by several trees, instantly transforming them into statues of the other Eternals. The statue of Druig toppled over, causing them all to fall, but Ikaris managed to prevent them from crashing.
Sersi continued to taunt Ikaris and transformed a large redwood tree into a statue of Ikaris. However, that statue fell over as well, falling toward Ikaris. Realizing that Ikaris did not see the statue, Sersi ran to touch it and transform it into a pile of feathers, which fell all around the pair. Sersi then took a handful of feathers and turned them into a second place trophy reading "Better luck next time," and the two laughed. Sersi and Ikaris then joined hands and flew to their next adventure together.

titulo: Sersi — Protecting Humanity › Life on Earth
texto:
In the centuries away from her teammates, Sersi became acquainted with several historical figures, such as Charles Darwin. Ikaris and Sersi stayed together until the 1920s, when Ikaris left her for reasons he could not bear to tell her. She waited for her husband to return, but he never came back, so she moved on and had a relationship with a human named Dane Whitman.
By 2024, Sersi was living in London with Sprite. During her job as a museum scientist and teacher, Sersi came across a billboard featuring artifacts that shaped human history, and she recognized the metal knife she gave to the Mesopotamian boy 7,000 years earlier prominently displayed. She took a picture of it before realizing she was late to work. Whitman filled in for her spot until she arrived, and she began teaching a class of children about apex predators. An earthquake occurred in the middle of the lesson, and Sersi instructed the kids to take refuge under their tables. She used her powers to turn a falling fossil into sand, assuring the girl beneath it that she was safe afterward.
Later that night, Sersi and Whitman celebrated the latter's birthday with friends at a bar. During a private moment outside the bar, Sersi gifted him with a ring that had his family crest dating back to the Middle Ages. Whitman asked Sersi to move in with him, and after considering it she declined. Sersi denied she was a wizard like Doctor Strange when Whitman guessed for reasons, because he observed weird things happening during their time together like his water turning to coffee in addition to Sprite telling stories about their past adventures. Sersi tried to downplay these, blaming Whitman's coffee addiction and claiming Ikaris was a "pilot" when Sprite told Dane Sersi's ex-boyfriend could fly. Sprite, who was lurking around the bar, interrupted them, claiming they need to go as it's way past her bedtime.

titulo: Sersi — The Emergence › Return of the Deviants
texto:
Sersi could not move in yet with Dane Whitman because she was still working on revealing to him her and Sprite 's true nature as Eternals. Sprite encouraged her to tell him already during the walk home, since he won't live forever like them. However, they were interrupted by a Deviant rising from the river and attacking them. Sersi screamed at Whitman to run, and delayed the Deviant by turning the concrete beneath it to quicksand and resolidifying it. When the Deviant broke free, Sersi ordered Sprite to keep Dane safe then ran away to divert the creature's attention.
Sersi attempted to face the Deviant alone, though she was joined by multiple illusions of her and Sprite on the scene. This temporarily confused the Deviant, though it eventually figured out where the real Eternals were. It knocked the real Sprite to the ground, and Sersi tried to rescue her, though fortunately Ikaris flew in on time and fought the Deviant. Ikaris and the Deviant collided with an incoming bus, forcing Sersi to turn it into a storm of petals and apologizing to the hassled occupants. Ikaris successfully chased the Deviant off, and in the aftermath Sersi awkwardly watched her ex-husband and current boyfriend meet each other for the first time.
When things quieted down, Sersi divulged her true nature as an Eternal to Whitman, and answered some of his follow-up questions regarding her team's non-interference to events in history, specifically to Thanos and the Infinity War, why they're still around, and what happened between her and Ikaris. Because of the resurgent Deviant threat, Sersi told Whitman she had to go and rejoined Ikaris and Sprite in the search for answers.
Back in her apartment, Sersi watched a WHiH World News report and figured the global earthquakes and Deviant threat must be related. Ikaris apologized for abandoning her, and promised to leave once he's assured that she's safe. Sersi set it aside and suggested they should go to Ajak first as she'll know what to do.

titulo: Shang-Chi — Early Life › Happy Family
texto: Xu Shang-Chi was born to Xu Wenwu and Ying Li and was raised at the Ten Rings Headquarters in the mountains of China. During his childhood, his mother would often tell him about how his father had been the wielder of a set of mythical rings for thousands of years, how she and his father met, and the legend of Ta Lo and the Great Protector. One night, as a bedtime story, Ying told Shang-Chi and his sister, Xu Xialing, about Ta Lo's guardians. Ying told the siblings about the Shishi protecting each other, which Shang-Chi likened to his protection of Xialing, who Ying then compared to the Jiu Wei Hu. Shang-Chi asked if the Jiu Wei Hu was as smart as the Qilin, which Ying described as unique in that it could swim and fly but chose to protect the grass. Ying explained the Fenghuang next, and Shang-Chi asked about the origami she had made. She explained that it depicted Morris, who would always be on their side. Shang-Chi saw a dragon and suggested it was most like him, which Ying agreed with. Shang-Chi said that he wanted to be a dragon when he grew up, and Ying said that he had a different path. Shang-Chi said that Ying's village was great due to all of the creatures and went to sleep while Ying said that it did not have quite everything. One day, after his mother told these stories while folding origami dragons, she gifted Shang-Chi a green pendant necklace telling him that it could lead him home if he ever got lost.

titulo: Shang-Chi — Facing The Past › Reunion with Wenwu
texto:
Shang-Chi, Xu Xialing, and Katy Chen were taken on board the helicopter and flown to the Ten Rings Headquarters. That night, Wenwu had dinner made for Shang-Chi, Chen, and Xialing and sat with them at his dinner table. During dinner, Wenwu told them about a terrorist who had mocked him by the name of Mandarin. Shang-Chi was asked to join Wenwu in his legacy, but Shang-Chi refused.
After dinner, Wenwu explained how he heard his wife's voice calling out to him and brought them to the Dragon statue, where he placed the pendants. This unlocked a small gate that unleashed water that formed a visual of Ta Lo. Wenwu told them that he wanted to go inside Ta Lo in order to rescue his wife. Shang-Chi, along with the others, believed he was mentally unstable. Afterwards, Wenwu ordered Shang-Chi and Xialing to accompany him, but when they refused, he knocked them to the ground and ordered them to be imprisoned. He then had Chen taken into custody as well.

titulo: Shang-Chi — Facing The Past › Escape from the Ten Rings
texto:
Shang-Chi, Katy Chen, and Xu Xialing found themselves in the prison and immediately heard a loud noise coming from somewhere within their containment. Shang-Chi and Chen went together to check it out and found a lit room with a mirror and a man sitting at a drawer. The man saw them and introduced himself as an actor named Trevor Slattery. Slattery told them what caused him to get there and why he was kept alive. Shang-Chi and Chen both were then startled when an unusual creature walked into the room. Slattery told them he was Morris and that he had come from Ta Lo. He then told them that Morris could help them get to Ta Lo, but that there was a low percentage of Morris remembering how too. They were then interrupted when Xialing broke into the room through a secret passageway and told them to follow her.
The passageway led to Headquarters' garage and they decided to take Razor Fist's Car to escape. When they found the car, Slattery was already inside. Chen took the driver's seat, while Shang-Chi and Xialing filed in the back. As they were driving off, Ten Rings agents arrived to stop them. Shang-Chi jumped out of the car to fight them off, and was soon joined by Xialing. Together, they defeated the agents and hopped back inside the car as they made their escape.

titulo: Shang-Chi — Facing The Past › Journey to Ta Lo
texto:
After making their escape, Trevor Slattery interpreted what Morris was saying and by morning, Katy Chen had driven them to the edge of the Bamboo Forest. While driving through the forest, Shang-Chi grew worried after the trees began to move unnaturally and soon the forest appeared to close in on them. Slattery continued giving Chen directions, and they made it to a safe spot, just as the forest did in fact close on them. Slattery then told Chen to drive them through a nearby portal and they were then transported into the alternate dimension of Ta Lo.
As Chen continued to drive them through Ta Lo, Shang-Chi observed mythical creatures such as Shishi, Fenghuang, Jiu Wei Hu, and Qilin. They then came to the end of the road at the Ancient Village. They were greeted by Ying Nan and other Ta Lo natives who recognized Shang-Chi and Xialing due to their mother.

titulo: Shang-Chi — Facing The Past › Training with Ying Nan
texto:
Shang-Chi was then given clothes native to Ta Lo and after getting dressed, he wandered around the village and found Ying Nan practicing her fighting skills in one area. After she saw him watching her, she offered for him to learn how to fight like his mother did.
Ying Nan then demonstrated to Shang-Chi how to fight like his mother did, and afterwards, invited him to try. When he had difficulty, she joined in and aided him. Eventually, he was able to master the skill. That night, he sat by the lake and was joined by Katy Chen, who told him that she had been training with archery and asked how he was doing.

titulo: Shang-Chi — Facing The Past › Battle of Ta Lo
texto:
The next day, Shang-Chi, Katy Chen, and Xu Xialing were given new suits, while Ying Nan and the villagers prepared at the entrance to the Ancient Village. Xu Wenwu then arrived with Razor Fist, the Death Dealer, and the Ten Rings army. As Wenwu confronted the villagers, Ying told him that his wife was not behind the Dark Gate. Wenwu tried to persuade Shang-Chi, but Guang Bo ordered him to leave the village. Wenwu demanded that he gain passage to the Dark Gate, but instead, the villagers readied themselves for battle, seeing no other option. He had ordered his warriors to burn the village down.
As Wenwu made his way through, Xialing told Shang-Chi to go after their father, while the others fought the Ten Rings. Shang-Chi saw Wenwu walking towards his wife's memorial and ran after him. However, Razor Fist blocked Shang-Chi's path, swiping at him with his blade until Xialing kicked him aside. As Shang-Chi found his father, he approached him as they confronted each other. Wenwu threatened Shang-Chi, but Shang-Chi told him he wasn't afraid.
Pushing him aside, Wenwu taunted him as the two fought, eventually kicking Shang-Chi to the ground. Wenwu reprimanded him for his inactions to save his wife as Wenwu pushed Shang-Chi outside of the memorial. The two continued battling each other until Shang-Chi gained the upper hand using a pole, accusing Wenwu of choosing the rings over his mother. Knocking Wenwu down, Shang-Chi told him that his family needed him, but Wenwu used the rings to send Shang-Chi flying into the lake, leaving him in an unconscious state.
An unconscious Shang-Chi floated to the bottom of the lake. However, after regaining consciousness, he nearly drowned but was rescued by the Great Protector. The Great Protector made eye contact with him and lifted him out of the water. When they surfaced, Shang-Chi saw that Soul Eaters had been released from the Dark Gate and were attacking the Ancient Village. The Great Protector quickly killed some along the way as they made it over to the Village.
After the Great Protector dropped Shang-Chi off by the Dark Gate, Shang-Chi found his father and approached him. During their duel, Shang-Chi gets the upper hand and causes Wenwu to lose control of his rings. Shang-Chi then took possession of the rings and pleaded with his father to just be his father, again, giving the rings back to him. However, they were interrupted when the Gates broke and the Dweller-in-Darkness was released. To Shang-Chi's distress, the Dweller captured Wenwu. In order to save Shang-Chi, Wenwu passed the rings on to him, sacrificing himself as the Dweller devoured his soul.
Shang-Chi was then rescued by Xialing and the Great Protector. However, the Dweller caught up to them and nearly killed the Great Protector, but Chen saved her using the bow and arrow. With Xialing and the Great Protector's help, Shang-Chi then used the rings to destroy the Dweller, ending the battle.

titulo: Shang-Chi — Facing The Past › Aftermath of the Battle
texto: Following this, the Great Protector took Shang-Chi and Xialing back to the Ancient Village. Shang-Chi was then met by Katy Chen, who ran over to hug him. That night, Ying Nan led the villagers in a lantern ceremony, detailing how those who have died will always be with them in spirit. As the villagers placed their lanterns by the water one by one, Chen rested on Shang-Chi's shoulders as he looked towards the lights and saw the Great Protector flying above them.

titulo: Shang-Chi — Recruited by Wong
texto:
Shang-Chi and Katy Chen returned to San Francisco and met their friends, Soo and John, at their favourite restaurant. While they were eating, they told their friends about their recent experiences, but Soo and John didn't believe them. However, an Inter-Dimensional Portal appeared behind them and Wong stepped out into the restaurant. He called for Shang-Chi, and when Shang-Chi stood up, he told him and Chen to come with him, much to their friends and the rest of the public's amazement. Shang-Chi and Chen followed Wong and were transported to Kamar-Taj in Nepal.
There they met Carol Danvers and Bruce Banner via holographic call and Wong discussed the rings, telling Shang-Chi that after he used it, it sent out a beacon to a location unknown. Danvers reported that the rings weren't alien technology and Banner said they weren't vibranium and that they were far older than the thousand years for which Wenwu had been using them. Wong told them that whatever they were and whatever their origin was, it was nothing that had yet been documented in the sorcerers' archives.
With no clear knowledge of what the rings were capable of, Wong explained that he wanted to know where the location of the beacon went. Danvers suddenly had to leave to answer an alert, telling Shang-Chi it was nice to meet him. Banner welcomed Shang-Chi and Chen to their world of heroes before signing off.
Wong then told them that their lives had changed and that there was no going back. He told them to get rest, but Shang-Chi suggested they go to a bar and sing karaoke. Shang-Chi and Chen then returned to San Francisco and were joined by Wong, who accompanied them to a bar where they sang karaoke to the "Hotel California" song.

titulo: Shang-Chi — Early Life › Death of Ying Li
texto: The family led a happy life until a past rival of his father, the Iron Gang, attacked their home. While Ying Li was teaching Shang-Chi the special martial arts style of the Ta Lo people, the Gang barged through the front gate. His mother sent him and his sister, Xu Xialing inside, where they watched from a window as their mother was killed by the Iron Gang. He then ran outside and held his mother's body as his father returned home and saw the carnage.

titulo: Shang-Chi — Early Life › Trained by the Ten Rings
texto:
Shang-Chi was present when Xu Wenwu decided to reclaim the rings and rebuild his army. After learning of the identity of his mother 's killers, Shang-Chi accompanied Wenwu to a bar, where Wenwu attacked and killed several Iron Gang members in an attempt to find their leader. Wenwu then told a traumatized Shang-Chi that "A blood debt must be paid in blood" before asking him if he wanted to join him in his quest to kill his mother's killer. Shang-Chi agreed.
Shang-Chi's father soon became distant from him and his sister, due to them reminding him of their mother. Shang-Chi was trained relentlessly between the ages 7 - 14 to become an expert martial arts fighter and assassin. He was eager to please and would often exercise so hard his knuckles would bleed. However, his father was proud of him and would take care of him. Shang-Chi trained well under the tutelage of Death Dealer, and eventually could beat over ten armed enemies at once.

titulo: Shang-Chi — Early Life › Getting Revenge
texto: In 2014, at the age of fourteen, Shang-Chi was tasked by his father to kill the Iron Gang 's leader. Before he left, Shang-Chi told Xu Xialing that he would be back in three days. He successfully killed his target, getting revenge for his mother 's murder, but he decided not to return home and fled to the United States.

titulo: Shang-Chi — Early Life › Moving On
texto:
Shang-Chi moved to San Francisco, California, and changed his name to Shaun to ensure his father would be unable to track him, though he did not realize that he was already being tracked. He enrolled in school, and met Katy Chen, Soo, and John, who became his close friends. Shang-Chi was often bullied in school due to his Asian heritage, with people calling him "Gangnam Style" despite the fact that he was not Korean. Chen combated this bullying by randomly bursting into the song " Hotel California " as a distraction while she stole the bully's keys to his Ford Mustang. Chen, Shang-Chi, and Soo took his Mustang on a joyride. After graduating high school in 2017, Shang-Chi and Chen became valet workers for the Fairmont San Francisco company and Shang-Chi bought his own apartment. Shang-Chi became close to Chen's family during this time, often coming over to the Chen's apartment for breakfast before work.
In 2018, Shang-Chi survived the Snap. Despite the easy job, Shang-Chi and Chen disliked their job as being a valet workers, being bored of doing the same thing all of the time, and hoped to find another job. One day in 2024, Chen decided to take a resident's car for a joyride and pleaded with Shang-Chi to join her. Reluctantly, he went with her.
That night, Shang-Chi and Chen met up with Soo and her husband for dinner, where they discussed how they all met. After Soo told them they should do something with their lives, Shang-Chi and Chen decided to go to karaoke, as opposed to going to sleep. The next day, Shang-Chi went to the Chen Residence to meet up with Chen before work and have breakfast. As they went to leave, Chen's grandmother asked Shang-Chi when he was going to marry Chen, but he told her they were just friends.

titulo: Shang-Chi — Facing The Past › Bus Fight
texto:
Shang-Chi and Katy Chen rode on the bus and were soon confronted by Ten Rings agents. Startled by their presence, Shang-Chi tried to act dismissive until they hurt Chen, forcing him to fight back and reveal his martial arts skills to a very startled Chen. Shang-Chi swiftly knocked down three of the thugs, unaware that Klev, a passenger, was recording the fight. He was then confronted by Razor Fist. Shang-Chi was forced on the defensive to avoid Razor Fist's blade which accidentally destroyed the bus' brakes and the bus driver was accidentally knocked unconscious, and Shang-Chi ran to the driver's seat to drive the bus.
Chen took the driver's seat trying to steer the runaway bus while Shang-Chi continued to fend off Razor Fist. Shang Chi noticed the bus was about to be torn in half and formulated a plan to get rid of the assailants; he tricked Razor Fist into completely breaking the side of the bus he was on while the rest of the passengers moved to the front of the bus while Shang-Chi tossed the other Ten Rings agents off the bus.
Shang-Chi finally instructed Chen to take a hard turn right causing the bus to finally break in half with Razor Fist in it while Shang-Chi jumped back to the front side. As Chen managed to stop the bus by slamming it into a garbage truck, Shang-Chi helped all the passengers exit the broken bus safely. but found out that his pendant had been snatched off his neck during the fight.

titulo: Shang-Chi — Facing The Past › Trip to Macau
texto:
Shang-Chi returned to his apartment and began to pack a bag with his belongings, when Katy Chen arrived. Chen demanded he explain to her what had occurred on the bus, but Shang-Chi told her he had no time and that he had to travel to China.
However, Chen told him to wait for her at the airport, as she felt she needed to go with him. Shang-Chi then left his apartment and headed for the San Francisco airport. There he met Chen and while on the flight, explained to her his past and how he was trained to kill by his father. He also revealed that his name wasn't Shaun, but Shang-Chi, which Chen teased him about, due to the two names sounded very similar. After landing in Macau, they headed for the postcard's origin.

titulo: Shang-Chi — Facing The Past › Fighting His Sister
texto:
Shang-Chi and Katy Chen arrived at the Golden Daggers Club and were taken down an elevator, which seemed unstable. However, after they were dropped off, they were met by Jon Jon who eagerly welcomed them and showed them around the club. Jon Jon led them to the main cage where they watched Wong and the Abomination in a tournament. When Wong won the tournament, Shang-Chi and Chen went to see him in his chamber, but he left along with Abomination before they could speak. Jon Jon then announced that Shang-Chi would be the next contestant.
Shang-Chi was then instructed to take his shirt off and prepare for his opponent. However, when the opponent came into view, he realized that the opponent was Xu Xialing, his sister. Not wanting to fight her, he tried to explain why he was there, but she ignored him.
To his surprise, she demonstrated fighting skills that matched his, despite the fact that she never trained with him. Due to his being distracted and not wanting to fight her, she won the tournament and told him that she wasn't over the fact that he never returned for her years prior.

titulo: Shang-Chi — Facing The Past › Attack on the Golden Daggers
texto:
Shang-Chi followed Xu Xialing and tried to explain to her the reason he was there, but was interrupted when Katy Chen caught up with them. Shang-Chi then told Xialing that he received her postcard and that his pendant had been stolen and hers was in danger. She told him that she hadn't sent him a postcard, but before they could discuss this further, the club was attacked by the Ten Rings agents. Jon Jon led Xialing to safety in an elevator, while Shang-Chi and Chen escaped through the window.
They found themselves on the supports of the building high above ground, and carefully proceeded to walk across. When the agents caught up to them, Shang-Chi told Chen to continue as he fought them off. Some agents chased after Chen and caused her to lose her balance and fall off the building, but she was saved by Xialing.
As they were escaping, Shang-Chi spotted Death Dealer arriving via helicopter and told Xialing to take Chen to safety. He then engaged in a duel against Death Dealer, nearly managing to defeat him, until they were stopped when his father, Xu Wenwu, walked into the area with other agents who had Chen and Xialing in their custody. Wenwu told Death Dealer to stand down and expressed his delight in being reunited with his son. However, Shang-Chi didn't share the same feeling.
